fields.title: Obulamu Buno mu Byawandiikibwa
fields.body_html:
Bwe ntuuka ku nsonga eno ey’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo obw’amazima, obulamu obwo obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda, ebirowoozo bingi nnyo birwanira okwogerwa ne kiba nti kumpi nnemererwa okwogera. Nnaatandikira wa? Kiki ekisinga obukulu okwogerwa? Nnaasobola ntya okuleetera abantu okusoma n’okukkiriza? Ensonga eno ya kitiibwa nnyo, ate ebigambo by’abantu bifaanana ng’ebitalina maanyi! Naye waliwo kye mpalirizibwa okwogera. Waliwo alina okubuulira ekyama kino.

Kubanga kye kyama ky’obuwanguzi obwo obuwangula ensi, ky’okununulibwa okwasuubizibwa okuva mu balabe baffe bonna, buli mwana wa Katonda kw’ayaayaanira era kw’asabira, naye okufaanana ng’okubaddukako emirundi mingi era eri bangi.

Katonda ampe okukibuulira bwe ntyo. Nsuubira nti buli mukkiriza anaasoma ekitabo kino ajja kulaba amazima nga bwe gali mu Yesu.

Era bafune obulamu buno obw’ekitiibwa ku lwabwe. Nkakasa nti buli mwoyo ogwakyuka gwegomba obuwanguzi n’okuwummula. Abasinga bawulira, oluusi, nti bino bwe busika bwabwe. Temusobola kujjukira, abamu ku mmwe, eddoboozi ery’obuwanguzi emyoyo gyammwe lye gyaleekaana bwe mwasooka okumanya Mukama Yesu, ne mulengera ku maanyi ge ag’ekitalo ag’okulokola? Nga mwali mukakafu ku buwanguzi mu kiseera ekyo! Nga kyalabika kyangu okuwangula n’okukirawo ku bw’oyo eyabaagala! Wansi w’obukulembeze bw’Omuduumizi atawangulwangako mu lutalo, mwandiyinzizza mutya n’okulowooza ku kuwangulwa?

Naye era, eri bangi ku mmwe, obumanyirivu bwammwe obw’amazima bubadde bwa njawulo nnyo! Obuwanguzi bubaddewo, naye butono era bwa kaseera buseera, ate okuwangulwa kungi era kwa kabi. Temubadde mu bulamu nga bwe muwulira nti abaana ba Katonda basaanidde okubeera. Wabaddewo okuwummulira mu kutegeera amazima obulungi, awatali kunyiikira. Okunoonya amaanyi n’obulamu bwago. Wabaddewo okusanyukira okumanya ebintu Ebyawandiikibwa bye bijulira, awatali kubifuna mu bulamu, ng’omwoyo gubirabye ddala. Abantu bakkiriza Kristo, boogera ku ye, era bamuweereza, naye tebamumanyi ng’obulamu bw’omwoyo obwa nnamaddala era obw’amazima, abeera omwo emirembe gyonna, era eyeeyoleka omwo bulijjo mu bulungi bwe.

Mwazuula Yesu ng’Omulokozi wammwe era Mukama wammwe, era mugezezaako okumuweereza n’okutumbula omulimu gw’obwakabaka bwe. Musomye Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu n’obwegendereza bungi era mukuŋŋaanyizza mu byo amazima mangi ag’omuwendo, ge mufubye okutambuliramu n’obwesigwa; naye wadde nga mulina okumanya kwonna kuno n’emirimu gyonna gye mukola mu buweereza bwa Mukama, emyoyo gyammwe giyala nga gisirise, era mukaaba emirundi n’emirundi olw’emmere eyo n’amazzi ag’obulamu bye mwalaba nga bisuubizibwa mu Byawandiikibwa eri abakkiriza bonna.

Mu buziba bw’emitima gyammwe, mumanyi nti obumanyirivu bwammwe si bwe bwogerwako mu Byawandiikibwa; nti, ng’omuwandiisi omu ow’edda bw’agamba, eddiini yammwe “bigambo bugambo bwokka bw’ogigeraageranya n’ebyo Abakristaayo abaasooka bye baanyumirwa, bye baalina, era mwe baabeeranga.” Era emyoyo gyammwe ginafuye munda mu mmwe, nga lunaku ku lunaku, n’omwaka ku mwaka, okwolesebwa kwammwe okw’obuwanguzi okwasooka kweyongera okufiirwa ekitangaala, era mwewalirizza okukkiriza nti ekisinga obulungi kye musobola okusuubira mu ddiini yammwe bwe bulamu obw’okulemererwa n’okuwangula nga biddiriŋŋana; essaawa emu nga mwonoona, endala nga mwenenya; ne muddamu okutandika, ate ne mulemererwa nate, ne mwenenya nate.

Kino kye kyokka? Mukama Yesu yalina kino kyokka mu birowoozo bwe yawaayo obulamu bwe obw’omuwendo okubanunula mu buddu bw’ekibi obw’obulumi era obw’obukambwe? Yali agenderera okubawa okununulibwa kuno okw’ekitundu kwokka?

Yali ayagala kubaleka nga mwekulukuunya bwe mutyo nga muzitoowereddwa okuwangulwa n’okuggwaamu amaanyi? Yatya nti obuwanguzi obutakoma bwandimuswazizza ne buleeta ekivume ku linnya lye?

Bwe yalangirira ebigambo ebyo ku kujja kwe n’omulimu gwe yali agenda okukola. Byali bitegeeza ekyo kyokka kye mufunye? Waaliwo ekyakwekebwa mu buli kisuubizo ekyali kigendereddwamu okukiremesa okutuukirira mu bujjuvu? Buli kisuubizo kyalimu ekyakwekebwa ekyali kigenderera okukiggyako okutuukirira kwakyo okujjuvu? Okugamba nti “okulokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe” kwali kutegeeza abatono ku bo bokka? Okugamba nti “atuwanguzisa bulijjo” kwali kutegeeza oluusi lwokka, oba okuba nti “tuwangudde n’okukirawo ku bw’oyo eyatwagala” kwali kutegeeza okuwangulwa n’okulemererwa obutayosa?

Nedda, nedda, emirundi lukumi nedda! Katonda ayinza okulokolera ddala, era agenderera okukikola. Ekisuubizo kye, ekyanywezebwa n’ekirayiro kye, kyali nti atuwe “okulokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe awatali kutya, tulyoke tuweereze mu maaso ge, mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.” Gwe mulimu omunene okukola, naye Omununuzi waffe asobola okugukola. Yajja okuzikiriza ebikolwa bya Setaani, era tuyinza okulowooza, wadde akaseera katono, nti tasobola oba tayagala kutuukiriza bigendererwa bye ye?

Kale, ku ntandikwa ddala, nyweza mu mutima ekintu kino kimu: nti Mukama asobola okukulokola ddala, kaakano, mu bulamu buno, okuva mu buyinza n’obufuzi bw’ekibi, n’okukununula ddala mu mikono gy’abalabe bo. Bw’oba tolowooza nti bw’atyo bw’ali, noonyereza mu Bayibuli yo, okuŋŋaanye buli kirangiriro na buli kigambo ekyogera ku bigendererwa n’ensonga y’okufa kwe ku musaalaba. Ojja kwewuunya okulaba nga bijjuvu bwe bityo.

Buli wamu era bulijjo, omulimu gwe gwogerwako nti kwe kutununula mu bibi byaffe, mu buddu bwaffe, mu bucaafu bwaffe; era tewali wantu wonna waweebwa akabonero nti okununulibwa kuno kwali kwa kitundu era kwa kigero, okwo Ekkanisa kw’egezaako bulijjo okumatira.

Ka nkuwe ennyiriri ntono ez’Ebyawandiikibwa ku nsonga eno. Malayika wa Mukama bwe yalabikira Yusufu mu kirooto, n’amutegeeza okuzaalibwa kw’Omulokozi okwali kujja, yagamba nti, “olimutuuma erinnya Yesu, … kubanga y’alirokola abantu bonna mu bibi byabwe.” Zaakaliya bwe yazaala omwana we, “n’ajjula Mwoyo Mutukuvu” era “n’awa obunnabbi,” n’alangirira nti Katonda akyalidde abantu be okutuukiriza ekisuubizo n’ekirayiro bye yabakolera, era ekisuubizo ekyo kyali nti, “okulokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe awatali kutya, tulyoke tuweereze mu maaso ge, mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.”

Peetero bwe yali abuulira mu kisasi kya Yeekaalu eri Abayudaaya abaali beewuunya, yagamba nti, “Bw’atyo Katonda bwe yalondawo okubatumira Omuweereza we abawe omukisa, buli omu ku mmwe ng’akyuka okuva mu bibi bye.” Pawulo bwe yali abuulira ekkanisa ey’Efeso amazima ag’ekitalo nti Kristo yagyagala nnyo n’atuuka okwewaayo ku lwayo, yeeyongera n’alangirira nti ekigendererwa kye mu kukola bw’atyo kyali kino: “Yaginaaza n’amazzi, n’agitukuza n’ekigambo kye, alyoke yeefunire Ekkanisa ey’ekitiibwa, eteriiko bbala wadde akamogo oba ekintu kyonna ekikyamu, wabula ebeere entukuvu, etuukiridde.”

Pawulo bwe yali ayigiriza Tito, omwana we ddala mu kukkiriza kwe bagabana, ku kisa kya Katonda, yalangirira nti ekigendererwa ky’ekisa ekyo kwe kutuyigiriza okuba “abatya Katonda nga tuli mu mulembe gwa kaakano”; era n’ayongerako, ng’ensonga y’ekyo, nti Kristo “eyeewaayo ku lwaffe, alyoke atununule mu bujeemu bwaffe bwonna,” era yeerongooseze eggwanga ery’enjawulo ku bubwe, “erinyiikirira ebikolwa ebirungi.” Peetero bwe yali akubiriza Abakristaayo be yali awandiikira okutambula mu butukuvu nga Kristo, abagamba nti “Ekyo kye mwayitirwa kubanga ne Kristo yabonyaabonyezebwa ku lwammwe, n’abalekera ekyokulabirako kye musaana okugoberera. Kristo teyakola kibi wadde okwogera ebyobukuusa”; era n’ayongerako nti, “Yesu Kristo yennyini yeetikka ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe bwe yatufiirira ku musaalaba, naffe tulyoke tufe eri ekibi, tube abalamu eri obutuukirivu. Olw’ebiwundu bye, muwonyezebbwa.”

Pawulo bwe yali ageraageranya, mu bbaluwa eri Abaefeso, entambula esaanira Omukristaayo n’entambula y’atakkiriza, abateekerawo amazima nga bwe gali mu Yesu nga ge gano, “mwambulemu obulamu obw’omuntu ow’edda,

avunda olw’okwegomba okw’obulimba. Mufuuke baggya olw’Omwoyo afuga ebirowoozo byammwe,

era mwambale omuntu omuggya, eyatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda mu butuukirivu ne mu kutukuzibwa okw’amazima.” Era bwe yali, mu Abaruumi 6, ng’addamu mu ngeri ey’olubeerera ekibuuzo ky’okweyongera mu kibi, era ng’alaga nga kyali tekikwatagana n’akatono n’omwoyo era n’ekigendererwa ky’obulokozi bwa Yesu bwonna.

Aleeta ensonga y’okufa kwaffe n’okuzuukira kwaffe wamu ne Kristo mu maaso g’omusango gwa Katonda, ng’ekigambo ekitayinza kuwakanyizibwa nti tulina okununulibwa mu kibi mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, n’agamba nti, “Kikafuuwe, kubanga ffe abaafa eri ekibi tuyinza tutya okweyongera okukikola? Oba temumanyi nga bonna bwe baabatizibwa mu Yesu Kristo, baafiira wamu naye? Bwe twabatizibwa twaziikibwa wamu ne Kristo. Nga Kristo bwe yazuukizibwa okuva mu bafu olw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaawe, naffe twafuna obulamu obuggya, era bwe tutyo tutambulirenga mu bulamu obwo obuggya.”(Abaruumi 6:2-3) Bwe twabatizibwa twaziikibwa wamu ne Kristo. Nga Kristo bwe yazuukizibwa okuva mu bafu olw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaawe, naffe twafuna obulamu obuggya, era bwe tutyo tutambulirenga mu bulamu obwo obuggya. Obanga twegatta wamu naye mu kifaananyi eky’okufa kwe, bwe tutyo bwe tulyegattira awamu naye mu kuzuukira kwe. Tumanyi kino nti omuntu waffe ow’edda yakomererwa wamu naye ku musaalaba, omubiri gw’ekibi guleme kuba gwa mugaso, tuleme kuddamu kuba baddu ba kibi. (Abaruumi 6:4-6) Abakristaayo abaagalwa, munaakkiriza obujulirwa bw’Ebyawandiikibwa ku nsonga eno? Ebibuuzo bye bimu ebyatawaanya Ekkanisa mu biseera bya Pawulo bye bikyagitawaanya kaakano: ekisooka, “Tweyongere okwonoona, olwo ekisa kya Katonda kiryoke kyeyongere?” N’eky’okubiri, “Kale amateeka tugaggyewo olw’okukkiriza?” Okuddamu kwaffe ku bino tekunaaba kwa Pawulo okw’amaanyi nti “Kikafuuwe”; n’ebigambo bye eby’obuwanguzi nti mu kifo ky’okugaggyawo amateeka: “Tunyweza manyweze”; era nti “Amateeka ga Musa kye gataayinza kukola, olw’okunafuyizibwa omubiri, Katonda yakikola mu Mwana we yennyini bwe yamutuma mu kifaananyi ky’omubiri ogw’ekibi, n’asalira ekibi omusango mu mubiri. Ekyo kyabaawo, eby’obutuukirivu mu mateeka biryoke bituukirire mu ffe bwe tugondera Omwoyo, ffe abatatambulira mu mubiri naye abatambulira mu Mwoyo.”

Tuyinza okulowooza, wadde akaseera katono, nti Katonda omutukuvu, akyawa ekibi mu mwonoonyi, ayagala okukigumiikiriza mu Mukristaayo, era nti yategeka n’enteekateeka y’obulokozi mu ngeri ekifuula ekitasoboka abo abalokoleddwa okuva mu musango gw’ekibi okufuna okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bwakyo.

Dr. Chalmers ayogera bulungi nti, “Tulina okukuulira ddala ekivume ekyo ekiyitibwa ekibi okuva mu nnyumba ennene ey’omwoyo Katonda gy’asanyukira. Ddala yandibadde nfuga ya kyewuunyo, ekibi okuba nga kikyayibwa Katonda nnyo n’atuuka okussa wansi w’okufa bonna abaakikola, ate bwe baddizibwa mu bulamu, ekibi ne kikkirizibwa okusigalawo ne wansi w’okufa okwo.

Ekyo ekyali edda ekigendererwa ky’ekiruyi ekizikiriza kati kyandifuuse ekintu ekigumiikirizibwa, ekikuumibwa era ekiwanirirwa.

Kaakano ng’ekibonerezo kiggiddwawo, olowooza nti Katonda atakyuka ayinza okuba nga yaleka bw’atyo obukyayi bwe eri ekibi, omuntu, eyazikirizibwa era n’anunulibwa, n’atuuka okweyongera, mu nteekateeka empya, okwemalira mu ekyo ekyamuzikiriza mu nteekateeka enkadde? Katonda eyayagala obutuukirivu n’akyawa obujeemu emyaka kakaaga emabega, talina kwagala kwe kumu eri obutuukirivu n’obukyayi bwe bumu eri obujeemu n’okutuusa kati?

Kaakano nnyingiza omukka ogw’ekisa okuva mu Ggulu, era nsobola okutambula mu maaso ga Katonda mu mirembe n’ekisa; nnaddamu okugezaako okugatta ebintu bibiri ebitakwatagana, ebyolekaganye ng’ebyo — Katonda asiima n’omwonoonyi anyiikira mu kibi? Ffe abaawonyezebwa mu kabenje ak’entiisa bwe katyo, twandyeyongedde tutya mu ekyo ekyasooka okukatuyingizaamu? Omusaalaba gwa Kristo, olw’okukuba okwo kwe kumu okw’amaanyi era okumalirivu kwe gwaggyako ekikolimo ky’ekibi ku ffe, ddala era guggyawo n’obuyinza bwakyo n’okukyagala ku ffe.”

Era si Dr. Chalmers yekka, wabula n’abantu abalala bangi abatukuvu ab’omulembe gwe n’ogwaffe, n’ab’emirembe egyayita edda, bakkiriziganyizza mu kulangirira nti okununulibwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo kwe yatukolera ku musaalaba e Kalvari kununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi era n’okuva mu musango gwakyo, era nti ayinza okulokolera ddala bonna abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe. Omusomesa w’eddiini ow’edda ow’ekyasa eky’ekkumi n’omusanvu, ayogera mu ngeri eyeewuunyisa, agamba nti: “Tewali kintu kikontana na Katonda ng’ekibi, era Katonda tajja kukkiriza kibi kufuga bulijjo omulimu gwe ogusinga, omuntu.

Bwe tulowooza ku maanyi ga Katonda agataliiko kkomo okuzikiriza ekyo ekimukontana, ani ayinza okukkiriza nti Setaani alina okuyimirira bulijjo n’awangula? Tekikwatagana era tekisaana mu kukkiriza okw’amazima abantu okuba Abakristaayo, ate ne bakkiriza nti Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda ow’olubeerera, eyaweebwa obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi, ajja kukkiriza ekibi ne Setaani okubafuga. “Naye mujja kugamba nti tewali muntu ayinza kwenunula na maanyi ge gonna g’alina, era tewali muntu ayinza kubeera mulamu awatali kibi. Tujja kugamba nti, Amiina, ku ekyo. Naye abantu bwe batugamba nti amaanyi ga Katonda bwe gatuyamba okutununula mu kibi, tekisoboka kukolebwa, olwo enjigiriza eyo tetusobola kugigumiikiriza; era nsuubira nammwe temugigumiikiriza.

“Mwandikisiimye singa mbagamba nti Katonda akozesa amaanyi ge okukola ekintu ng’ekyo, naye Setaani n’amulemesa? Nti Katonda tasobola kukikola kubanga Setaani takyagala? Nti tewali ayinza kuba wa ddembe okuva mu kibi kubanga Setaani alina amaanyi mangi bwe gatyo mu bo Katonda n’atasobola kumugobamu? Enjigiriza eno ya nnaku, naye ani atagibuulidde? Mu bigambo ebyangu egamba nti, wadde Katonda ayingira mu nsonga n’amaanyi ge, tekisoboka, kubanga Setaani yasimba ekibi mu muntu nnyo bwe kityo. Omuntu si kitonde kya Katonda, era tasobola kumufuula muggya, n’amugobamu ekibi? Bw’ogamba nti omuntu asimba ekibi, nkkiriza, naye si ku kigero kye kimu.

Kristo Yesu yayingira mu buziba bw’ekikolo ky’obutonde bw’omuntu, n’aweebwa obuyinza okuzikiriza Setaani n’ebikolwa bye, n’okuzza omuntu n’okumununula mu butuukirivu n’obutukuvu. Oba si ekyo, kale kiba kya bulimba nti ‘ayinza okulokolera ddala abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe.’ Tulina okusuula Bayibuli bwe tugamba nti Katonda tasobola kununula muntu mu kibi.

“Tumanyi,” bw’ayongerako, “nti ab’emikwano gyaffe bwe baba mu busibe, nga e Butuluki, oba awalala, tusasula ensimbi zaffe okubanunula; naye tetwandisasudde nsimbi zaffe singa babakuumira mu njegere zaabwe.

Ani atandirowoozezza nti bamubbye okusasula bw’atyo? Ajja kugambibwa nti yakola endagaano ey’okubanunula n’ensimbi nnyingi.

Anaayenunula n’ayitibwa omusibe eyanunulwa, naye n’asigala ng’ayambadde enjegere ze? Okumala ebbanga ki? Okumala ebbanga lyonna ly’alina okuba omulamu. “Kino kyogera ku mibiri, naye kaakano njogera ku myoyo. Nnina okufuula Kristo okuba gye ndi

obununuzi, annunule mu busibe. Ndi musibe wonna wonna? Yee, buli akola ekibi, bw’atyo Kristo bwe yagamba, aba muddu wa kibi, aba muddu wa kibi ddala. Bw’oba wayonoona, oli muddu, omusibe alina okununulibwa mu busibe.

Ani anansasulira omuwendo? Ndi mwavu; sirina kintu; sisobola kwenunula; ani anansasulira omuwendo? Waliwo eyansasulira omuwendo. Ekyo kirungi; ago mawulire malungi; kale nsuubira okuva mu busibe bwange. Erinnya lye ye ani? Ayitibwa Omununuzi? Kale ddala nsuubira emiganyulo gy’okununulibwa kwange, era nti nja kuva mu busibe bwange. Nedda, bo bagamba, olina okusigala mu kibi ebbanga lyonna ly’onoomala ng’oli mulamu.

Kiki! Tetulina kwenunula n’akatono? Omutima guno omukyamu n’okusalawo kuno okukyamu birina okusigalawo bulijjo?

Nnina okuba omukkiriza, naye nga sirina kukkiriza okutuuka ku kutukuzibwa n’okubeera mu bulamu obutukuvu? Tewali buwanguzi bwa kufunibwa, tewali kuwangula kibi? Kirina okumpangula ebbanga lyonna lye ndimala nga ndi mulamu? Kale Omununuzi ki ono, oba mugaso ki gwe nfuna mu bulamu buno, olw’okununulibwa kwange?”

Oyinza okujuliza ebigambo ebifaanana bwe bityo okuva mu Marshall, Romaine, n’abalala bangi, ebiraga nti enjigiriza eno si mpya mu Kkanisa, wadde nga abakkiriza ab’omulembe guno bayinza okuba nga bagyerabidde nnyo.

Ye mboozi y’emu enkadde eyajjuza ennyimba z’obuwanguzi mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku obw’abatukuvu ba Katonda bangi mu mirembe gyonna; era kaakano tugirangirira buggya, ku lw’essanyu eritayogerekeka ery’emyoyo egikooye era egizitoowereddwa. Kale togigaana, omusomi omwagalwa, okutuusa ng’omaze okugyekkaanya obulungi ng’oyita mu kusaba.

Noonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa olabe obanga ebintu bino bwe biri ddala. Saba Katonda azibule amaaso g’amagezi go olw’Omwoyo we, olyoke otegeere “amaanyi ge agasukkiridde agakolera mu ffe abakkiriza, ng’okukola kw’obuyinza bw’amaanyi ge bwe kuli, amaanyi ago ge yakozesa mu Kristo bwe yamuzuukiza mu bafu, n’amutuuza ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo waggulu mu ggulu.”(Abaefeso 1:19-20), Era bw’onootandika okulengera katono ku maanyi gano, yiga okutunula ewala ddala n’obunafu bwo, era, ng’omukwasizza ensonga yo mu mikono gye, mwesige akununule.

Mu Zabbuli 8:6, ekyawandiikibwa kitugamba nti Katonda yatonda omuntu “okufuga ebintu byonna bye wakola n’emikono gyo: byonna wabissa wansi w’ebigere bye.” Okutuukirizibwa kw’ekyo kuli mu 2 Abakkolinso 2:14, omutume gy’akaabira nti, “Katonda yeebazibwe atuwanguzisa bulijjo mu Kristo Yesu, n’akawoowo ak’okumanya, ke tubunyisa wonna.”

Singa omukozi w’ekyuma alangirira nti yakikola okutuukiriza omulimu ogugere, ate bwe kigezesebwa ne kiremwa okutuukiriza omulimu ogwo, ffenna twandigambye ku mukozi oyo nti mulimba.

Kale tetujja kwetantala kulowooza nti tekisoboka ekitonde Katonda kye yatonda okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyalangirirwa kye yakitondera. Naddala ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bijjudde ebigambo ebikakasa nti Kristo akifudde ekisoboka. Ekintu kyokka ekiyinza okulemesa kwe kulemererwa kw’ekitonde kyennyini okukolera wamu n’enteekateeka z’Omutonzi waakyo, era obutakwatagana buno bwe busobola okuggibwawo, olwo Katonda asobola okukola.

Kristo yajja okuleeta okutangirira wakati wa Katonda n’omuntu, okwandisobozesezza Katonda okukolera mu muntu okwagala n’okukola by’ayagala, olw’okumusanyusa.

N’olwekyo tusaana okuba n’obuvumu; kubanga omulimu Kristo gwe yeetikka asobola era ayagala okugutuukiriza. Kale tubeere mu abo “abatambulira mu kkubo ery’okukkiriza, jjajjaffe Ibulayimu kwe yalina,” oyo ayogerwako nti: “Teyabuusabuusa kisuubizo kya Katonda mu butakkiriza, naye yaweebwa amaanyi lwa kukkiriza; n’agulumiza Katonda. Yakakasiza ddala nti Katonda kye yasuubiza asobola okukituukiriza.”
fields.body_text: Bwe ntuuka ku nsonga eno ey’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo obw’amazima, obulamu obwo obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda, ebirowoozo bingi nnyo birwanira okwogerwa ne kiba nti kumpi nnemererwa okwogera. Nnaatandikira wa? Kiki ekisinga obukulu okwogerwa? Nnaasobola ntya okuleetera abantu okusoma n’okukkiriza? Ensonga eno ya kitiibwa nnyo, ate ebigambo by’abantu bifaanana ng’ebitalina maanyi! Naye waliwo kye mpalirizibwa okwogera. Waliwo alina okubuulira ekyama kino. Kubanga kye kyama ky’obuwanguzi obwo obuwangula ensi, ky’okununulibwa okwasuubizibwa okuva mu balabe baffe bonna, buli mwana wa Katonda kw’ayaayaanira era kw’asabira, naye okufaanana ng’okubaddukako emirundi mingi era eri bangi. Katonda ampe okukibuulira bwe ntyo. Nsuubira nti buli mukkiriza anaasoma ekitabo kino ajja kulaba amazima nga bwe gali mu Yesu. Era bafune obulamu buno obw’ekitiibwa ku lwabwe. Nkakasa nti buli mwoyo ogwakyuka gwegomba obuwanguzi n’okuwummula. Abasinga bawulira, oluusi, nti bino bwe busika bwabwe. Temusobola kujjukira, abamu ku mmwe, eddoboozi ery’obuwanguzi emyoyo gyammwe lye gyaleekaana bwe mwasooka okumanya Mukama Yesu, ne mulengera ku maanyi ge ag’ekitalo ag’okulokola? Nga mwali mukakafu ku buwanguzi mu kiseera ekyo! Nga kyalabika kyangu okuwangula n’okukirawo ku bw’oyo eyabaagala! Wansi w’obukulembeze bw’Omuduumizi atawangulwangako mu lutalo, mwandiyinzizza mutya n’okulowooza ku kuwangulwa? Naye era, eri bangi ku mmwe, obumanyirivu bwammwe obw’amazima bubadde bwa njawulo nnyo! Obuwanguzi bubaddewo, naye butono era bwa kaseera buseera, ate okuwangulwa kungi era kwa kabi. Temubadde mu bulamu nga bwe muwulira nti abaana ba Katonda basaanidde okubeera. Wabaddewo okuwummulira mu kutegeera amazima obulungi, awatali kunyiikira. Okunoonya amaanyi n’obulamu bwago. Wabaddewo okusanyukira okumanya ebintu Ebyawandiikibwa bye bijulira, awatali kubifuna mu bulamu, ng’omwoyo gubirabye ddala. Abantu bakkiriza Kristo, boogera ku ye, era bamuweereza, naye tebamumanyi ng’obulamu bw’omwoyo obwa nnamaddala era obw’amazima, abeera omwo emirembe gyonna, era eyeeyoleka omwo bulijjo mu bulungi bwe. Mwazuula Yesu ng’Omulokozi wammwe era Mukama wammwe, era mugezezaako okumuweereza n’okutumbula omulimu gw’obwakabaka bwe. Musomye Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu n’obwegendereza bungi era mukuŋŋaanyizza mu byo amazima mangi ag’omuwendo, ge mufubye okutambuliramu n’obwesigwa; naye wadde nga mulina okumanya kwonna kuno n’emirimu gyonna gye mukola mu buweereza bwa Mukama, emyoyo gyammwe giyala nga gisirise, era mukaaba emirundi n’emirundi olw’emmere eyo n’amazzi ag’obulamu bye mwalaba nga bisuubizibwa mu Byawandiikibwa eri abakkiriza bonna. Mu buziba bw’emitima gyammwe, mumanyi nti obumanyirivu bwammwe si bwe bwogerwako mu Byawandiikibwa; nti, ng’omuwandiisi omu ow’edda bw’agamba, eddiini yammwe “bigambo bugambo bwokka bw’ogigeraageranya n’ebyo Abakristaayo abaasooka bye baanyumirwa, bye baalina, era mwe baabeeranga.” Era emyoyo gyammwe ginafuye munda mu mmwe, nga lunaku ku lunaku, n’omwaka ku mwaka, okwolesebwa kwammwe okw’obuwanguzi okwasooka kweyongera okufiirwa ekitangaala, era mwewalirizza okukkiriza nti ekisinga obulungi kye musobola okusuubira mu ddiini yammwe bwe bulamu obw’okulemererwa n’okuwangula nga biddiriŋŋana; essaawa emu nga mwonoona, endala nga mwenenya; ne muddamu okutandika, ate ne mulemererwa nate, ne mwenenya nate. Kino kye kyokka? Mukama Yesu yalina kino kyokka mu birowoozo bwe yawaayo obulamu bwe obw’omuwendo okubanunula mu buddu bw’ekibi obw’obulumi era obw’obukambwe? Yali agenderera okubawa okununulibwa kuno okw’ekitundu kwokka? Yali ayagala kubaleka nga mwekulukuunya bwe mutyo nga muzitoowereddwa okuwangulwa n’okuggwaamu amaanyi? Yatya nti obuwanguzi obutakoma bwandimuswazizza ne buleeta ekivume ku linnya lye? Bwe yalangirira ebigambo ebyo ku kujja kwe n’omulimu gwe yali agenda okukola. Byali bitegeeza ekyo kyokka kye mufunye? Waaliwo ekyakwekebwa mu buli kisuubizo ekyali kigendereddwamu okukiremesa okutuukirira mu bujjuvu? Buli kisuubizo kyalimu ekyakwekebwa ekyali kigenderera okukiggyako okutuukirira kwakyo okujjuvu? Okugamba nti “okulokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe” kwali kutegeeza abatono ku bo bokka? Okugamba nti “atuwanguzisa bulijjo” kwali kutegeeza oluusi lwokka, oba okuba nti “tuwangudde n’okukirawo ku bw’oyo eyatwagala” kwali kutegeeza okuwangulwa n’okulemererwa obutayosa? Nedda, nedda, emirundi lukumi nedda! Katonda ayinza okulokolera ddala, era agenderera okukikola. Ekisuubizo kye, ekyanywezebwa n’ekirayiro kye, kyali nti atuwe “okulokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe awatali kutya, tulyoke tuweereze mu maaso ge, mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.” Gwe mulimu omunene okukola, naye Omununuzi waffe asobola okugukola. Yajja okuzikiriza ebikolwa bya Setaani, era tuyinza okulowooza, wadde akaseera katono, nti tasobola oba tayagala kutuukiriza bigendererwa bye ye? Kale, ku ntandikwa ddala, nyweza mu mutima ekintu kino kimu: nti Mukama asobola okukulokola ddala, kaakano, mu bulamu buno, okuva mu buyinza n’obufuzi bw’ekibi, n’okukununula ddala mu mikono gy’abalabe bo. Bw’oba tolowooza nti bw’atyo bw’ali, noonyereza mu Bayibuli yo, okuŋŋaanye buli kirangiriro na buli kigambo ekyogera ku bigendererwa n’ensonga y’okufa kwe ku musaalaba. Ojja kwewuunya okulaba nga bijjuvu bwe bityo. Buli wamu era bulijjo, omulimu gwe gwogerwako nti kwe kutununula mu bibi byaffe, mu buddu bwaffe, mu bucaafu bwaffe; era tewali wantu wonna waweebwa akabonero nti okununulibwa kuno kwali kwa kitundu era kwa kigero, okwo Ekkanisa kw’egezaako bulijjo okumatira. Ka nkuwe ennyiriri ntono ez’Ebyawandiikibwa ku nsonga eno. Malayika wa Mukama bwe yalabikira Yusufu mu kirooto, n’amutegeeza okuzaalibwa kw’Omulokozi okwali kujja, yagamba nti, “olimutuuma erinnya Yesu, … kubanga y’alirokola abantu bonna mu bibi byabwe.” Zaakaliya bwe yazaala omwana we, “n’ajjula Mwoyo Mutukuvu” era “n’awa obunnabbi,” n’alangirira nti Katonda akyalidde abantu be okutuukiriza ekisuubizo n’ekirayiro bye yabakolera, era ekisuubizo ekyo kyali nti, “okulokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe awatali kutya, tulyoke tuweereze mu maaso ge, mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.” Peetero bwe yali abuulira mu kisasi kya Yeekaalu eri Abayudaaya abaali beewuunya, yagamba nti, “Bw’atyo Katonda bwe yalondawo okubatumira Omuweereza we abawe omukisa, buli omu ku mmwe ng’akyuka okuva mu bibi bye.” Pawulo bwe yali abuulira ekkanisa ey’Efeso amazima ag’ekitalo nti Kristo yagyagala nnyo n’atuuka okwewaayo ku lwayo, yeeyongera n’alangirira nti ekigendererwa kye mu kukola bw’atyo kyali kino: “Yaginaaza n’amazzi, n’agitukuza n’ekigambo kye, alyoke yeefunire Ekkanisa ey’ekitiibwa, eteriiko bbala wadde akamogo oba ekintu kyonna ekikyamu, wabula ebeere entukuvu, etuukiridde.” Pawulo bwe yali ayigiriza Tito, omwana we ddala mu kukkiriza kwe bagabana, ku kisa kya Katonda, yalangirira nti ekigendererwa ky’ekisa ekyo kwe kutuyigiriza okuba “abatya Katonda nga tuli mu mulembe gwa kaakano”; era n’ayongerako, ng’ensonga y’ekyo, nti Kristo “eyeewaayo ku lwaffe, alyoke atununule mu bujeemu bwaffe bwonna,” era yeerongooseze eggwanga ery’enjawulo ku bubwe, “erinyiikirira ebikolwa ebirungi.” Peetero bwe yali akubiriza Abakristaayo be yali awandiikira okutambula mu butukuvu nga Kristo, abagamba nti “Ekyo kye mwayitirwa kubanga ne Kristo yabonyaabonyezebwa ku lwammwe, n’abalekera ekyokulabirako kye musaana okugoberera. Kristo teyakola kibi wadde okwogera ebyobukuusa”; era n’ayongerako nti, “Yesu Kristo yennyini yeetikka ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe bwe yatufiirira ku musaalaba, naffe tulyoke tufe eri ekibi, tube abalamu eri obutuukirivu. Olw’ebiwundu bye, muwonyezebbwa.” Pawulo bwe yali ageraageranya, mu bbaluwa eri Abaefeso, entambula esaanira Omukristaayo n’entambula y’atakkiriza, abateekerawo amazima nga bwe gali mu Yesu nga ge gano, “mwambulemu obulamu obw’omuntu ow’edda, avunda olw’okwegomba okw’obulimba. Mufuuke baggya olw’Omwoyo afuga ebirowoozo byammwe, era mwambale omuntu omuggya, eyatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda mu butuukirivu ne mu kutukuzibwa okw’amazima.” Era bwe yali, mu Abaruumi 6, ng’addamu mu ngeri ey’olubeerera ekibuuzo ky’okweyongera mu kibi, era ng’alaga nga kyali tekikwatagana n’akatono n’omwoyo era n’ekigendererwa ky’obulokozi bwa Yesu bwonna. Aleeta ensonga y’okufa kwaffe n’okuzuukira kwaffe wamu ne Kristo mu maaso g’omusango gwa Katonda, ng’ekigambo ekitayinza kuwakanyizibwa nti tulina okununulibwa mu kibi mu bulamu obwa bulijjo, n’agamba nti, “Kikafuuwe, kubanga ffe abaafa eri ekibi tuyinza tutya okweyongera okukikola? Oba temumanyi nga bonna bwe baabatizibwa mu Yesu Kristo, baafiira wamu naye? Bwe twabatizibwa twaziikibwa wamu ne Kristo. Nga Kristo bwe yazuukizibwa okuva mu bafu olw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaawe, naffe twafuna obulamu obuggya, era bwe tutyo tutambulirenga mu bulamu obwo obuggya.”(Abaruumi 6:2-3) Bwe twabatizibwa twaziikibwa wamu ne Kristo. Nga Kristo bwe yazuukizibwa okuva mu bafu olw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaawe, naffe twafuna obulamu obuggya, era bwe tutyo tutambulirenga mu bulamu obwo obuggya. Obanga twegatta wamu naye mu kifaananyi eky’okufa kwe, bwe tutyo bwe tulyegattira awamu naye mu kuzuukira kwe. Tumanyi kino nti omuntu waffe ow’edda yakomererwa wamu naye ku musaalaba, omubiri gw’ekibi guleme kuba gwa mugaso, tuleme kuddamu kuba baddu ba kibi. (Abaruumi 6:4-6) Abakristaayo abaagalwa, munaakkiriza obujulirwa bw’Ebyawandiikibwa ku nsonga eno? Ebibuuzo bye bimu ebyatawaanya Ekkanisa mu biseera bya Pawulo bye bikyagitawaanya kaakano: ekisooka, “Tweyongere okwonoona, olwo ekisa kya Katonda kiryoke kyeyongere?” N’eky’okubiri, “Kale amateeka tugaggyewo olw’okukkiriza?” Okuddamu kwaffe ku bino tekunaaba kwa Pawulo okw’amaanyi nti “Kikafuuwe”; n’ebigambo bye eby’obuwanguzi nti mu kifo ky’okugaggyawo amateeka: “Tunyweza manyweze”; era nti “Amateeka ga Musa kye gataayinza kukola, olw’okunafuyizibwa omubiri, Katonda yakikola mu Mwana we yennyini bwe yamutuma mu kifaananyi ky’omubiri ogw’ekibi, n’asalira ekibi omusango mu mubiri. Ekyo kyabaawo, eby’obutuukirivu mu mateeka biryoke bituukirire mu ffe bwe tugondera Omwoyo, ffe abatatambulira mu mubiri naye abatambulira mu Mwoyo.” Tuyinza okulowooza, wadde akaseera katono, nti Katonda omutukuvu, akyawa ekibi mu mwonoonyi, ayagala okukigumiikiriza mu Mukristaayo, era nti yategeka n’enteekateeka y’obulokozi mu ngeri ekifuula ekitasoboka abo abalokoleddwa okuva mu musango gw’ekibi okufuna okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bwakyo. Dr. Chalmers ayogera bulungi nti, “Tulina okukuulira ddala ekivume ekyo ekiyitibwa ekibi okuva mu nnyumba ennene ey’omwoyo Katonda gy’asanyukira. Ddala yandibadde nfuga ya kyewuunyo, ekibi okuba nga kikyayibwa Katonda nnyo n’atuuka okussa wansi w’okufa bonna abaakikola, ate bwe baddizibwa mu bulamu, ekibi ne kikkirizibwa okusigalawo ne wansi w’okufa okwo. Ekyo ekyali edda ekigendererwa ky’ekiruyi ekizikiriza kati kyandifuuse ekintu ekigumiikirizibwa, ekikuumibwa era ekiwanirirwa. Kaakano ng’ekibonerezo kiggiddwawo, olowooza nti Katonda atakyuka ayinza okuba nga yaleka bw’atyo obukyayi bwe eri ekibi, omuntu, eyazikirizibwa era n’anunulibwa, n’atuuka okweyongera, mu nteekateeka empya, okwemalira mu ekyo ekyamuzikiriza mu nteekateeka enkadde? Katonda eyayagala obutuukirivu n’akyawa obujeemu emyaka kakaaga emabega, talina kwagala kwe kumu eri obutuukirivu n’obukyayi bwe bumu eri obujeemu n’okutuusa kati? Kaakano nnyingiza omukka ogw’ekisa okuva mu Ggulu, era nsobola okutambula mu maaso ga Katonda mu mirembe n’ekisa; nnaddamu okugezaako okugatta ebintu bibiri ebitakwatagana, ebyolekaganye ng’ebyo — Katonda asiima n’omwonoonyi anyiikira mu kibi? Ffe abaawonyezebwa mu kabenje ak’entiisa bwe katyo, twandyeyongedde tutya mu ekyo ekyasooka okukatuyingizaamu? Omusaalaba gwa Kristo, olw’okukuba okwo kwe kumu okw’amaanyi era okumalirivu kwe gwaggyako ekikolimo ky’ekibi ku ffe, ddala era guggyawo n’obuyinza bwakyo n’okukyagala ku ffe.” Era si Dr. Chalmers yekka, wabula n’abantu abalala bangi abatukuvu ab’omulembe gwe n’ogwaffe, n’ab’emirembe egyayita edda, bakkiriziganyizza mu kulangirira nti okununulibwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo kwe yatukolera ku musaalaba e Kalvari kununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi era n’okuva mu musango gwakyo, era nti ayinza okulokolera ddala bonna abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe. Omusomesa w’eddiini ow’edda ow’ekyasa eky’ekkumi n’omusanvu, ayogera mu ngeri eyeewuunyisa, agamba nti: “Tewali kintu kikontana na Katonda ng’ekibi, era Katonda tajja kukkiriza kibi kufuga bulijjo omulimu gwe ogusinga, omuntu. Bwe tulowooza ku maanyi ga Katonda agataliiko kkomo okuzikiriza ekyo ekimukontana, ani ayinza okukkiriza nti Setaani alina okuyimirira bulijjo n’awangula? Tekikwatagana era tekisaana mu kukkiriza okw’amazima abantu okuba Abakristaayo, ate ne bakkiriza nti Kristo, Omwana wa Katonda ow’olubeerera, eyaweebwa obuyinza bwonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi, ajja kukkiriza ekibi ne Setaani okubafuga. “Naye mujja kugamba nti tewali muntu ayinza kwenunula na maanyi ge gonna g’alina, era tewali muntu ayinza kubeera mulamu awatali kibi. Tujja kugamba nti, Amiina, ku ekyo. Naye abantu bwe batugamba nti amaanyi ga Katonda bwe gatuyamba okutununula mu kibi, tekisoboka kukolebwa, olwo enjigiriza eyo tetusobola kugigumiikiriza; era nsuubira nammwe temugigumiikiriza. “Mwandikisiimye singa mbagamba nti Katonda akozesa amaanyi ge okukola ekintu ng’ekyo, naye Setaani n’amulemesa? Nti Katonda tasobola kukikola kubanga Setaani takyagala? Nti tewali ayinza kuba wa ddembe okuva mu kibi kubanga Setaani alina amaanyi mangi bwe gatyo mu bo Katonda n’atasobola kumugobamu? Enjigiriza eno ya nnaku, naye ani atagibuulidde? Mu bigambo ebyangu egamba nti, wadde Katonda ayingira mu nsonga n’amaanyi ge, tekisoboka, kubanga Setaani yasimba ekibi mu muntu nnyo bwe kityo. Omuntu si kitonde kya Katonda, era tasobola kumufuula muggya, n’amugobamu ekibi? Bw’ogamba nti omuntu asimba ekibi, nkkiriza, naye si ku kigero kye kimu. Kristo Yesu yayingira mu buziba bw’ekikolo ky’obutonde bw’omuntu, n’aweebwa obuyinza okuzikiriza Setaani n’ebikolwa bye, n’okuzza omuntu n’okumununula mu butuukirivu n’obutukuvu. Oba si ekyo, kale kiba kya bulimba nti ‘ayinza okulokolera ddala abajja eri Katonda ku bubwe.’ Tulina okusuula Bayibuli bwe tugamba nti Katonda tasobola kununula muntu mu kibi. “Tumanyi,” bw’ayongerako, “nti ab’emikwano gyaffe bwe baba mu busibe, nga e Butuluki, oba awalala, tusasula ensimbi zaffe okubanunula; naye tetwandisasudde nsimbi zaffe singa babakuumira mu njegere zaabwe. Ani atandirowoozezza nti bamubbye okusasula bw’atyo? Ajja kugambibwa nti yakola endagaano ey’okubanunula n’ensimbi nnyingi. Anaayenunula n’ayitibwa omusibe eyanunulwa, naye n’asigala ng’ayambadde enjegere ze? Okumala ebbanga ki? Okumala ebbanga lyonna ly’alina okuba omulamu. “Kino kyogera ku mibiri, naye kaakano njogera ku myoyo. Nnina okufuula Kristo okuba gye ndi obununuzi, annunule mu busibe. Ndi musibe wonna wonna? Yee, buli akola ekibi, bw’atyo Kristo bwe yagamba, aba muddu wa kibi, aba muddu wa kibi ddala. Bw’oba wayonoona, oli muddu, omusibe alina okununulibwa mu busibe. Ani anansasulira omuwendo? Ndi mwavu; sirina kintu; sisobola kwenunula; ani anansasulira omuwendo? Waliwo eyansasulira omuwendo. Ekyo kirungi; ago mawulire malungi; kale nsuubira okuva mu busibe bwange. Erinnya lye ye ani? Ayitibwa Omununuzi? Kale ddala nsuubira emiganyulo gy’okununulibwa kwange, era nti nja kuva mu busibe bwange. Nedda, bo bagamba, olina okusigala mu kibi ebbanga lyonna ly’onoomala ng’oli mulamu. Kiki! Tetulina kwenunula n’akatono? Omutima guno omukyamu n’okusalawo kuno okukyamu birina okusigalawo bulijjo? Nnina okuba omukkiriza, naye nga sirina kukkiriza okutuuka ku kutukuzibwa n’okubeera mu bulamu obutukuvu? Tewali buwanguzi bwa kufunibwa, tewali kuwangula kibi? Kirina okumpangula ebbanga lyonna lye ndimala nga ndi mulamu? Kale Omununuzi ki ono, oba mugaso ki gwe nfuna mu bulamu buno, olw’okununulibwa kwange?” Oyinza okujuliza ebigambo ebifaanana bwe bityo okuva mu Marshall, Romaine, n’abalala bangi, ebiraga nti enjigiriza eno si mpya mu Kkanisa, wadde nga abakkiriza ab’omulembe guno bayinza okuba nga bagyerabidde nnyo. Ye mboozi y’emu enkadde eyajjuza ennyimba z’obuwanguzi mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku obw’abatukuvu ba Katonda bangi mu mirembe gyonna; era kaakano tugirangirira buggya, ku lw’essanyu eritayogerekeka ery’emyoyo egikooye era egizitoowereddwa. Kale togigaana, omusomi omwagalwa, okutuusa ng’omaze okugyekkaanya obulungi ng’oyita mu kusaba. Noonyereza mu Byawandiikibwa olabe obanga ebintu bino bwe biri ddala. Saba Katonda azibule amaaso g’amagezi go olw’Omwoyo we, olyoke otegeere “amaanyi ge agasukkiridde agakolera mu ffe abakkiriza, ng’okukola kw’obuyinza bw’amaanyi ge bwe kuli, amaanyi ago ge yakozesa mu Kristo bwe yamuzuukiza mu bafu, n’amutuuza ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo waggulu mu ggulu.”(Abaefeso 1:19-20), Era bw’onootandika okulengera katono ku maanyi gano, yiga okutunula ewala ddala n’obunafu bwo, era, ng’omukwasizza ensonga yo mu mikono gye, mwesige akununule. Mu Zabbuli 8:6, ekyawandiikibwa kitugamba nti Katonda yatonda omuntu “okufuga ebintu byonna bye wakola n’emikono gyo: byonna wabissa wansi w’ebigere bye.” Okutuukirizibwa kw’ekyo kuli mu 2 Abakkolinso 2:14, omutume gy’akaabira nti, “Katonda yeebazibwe atuwanguzisa bulijjo mu Kristo Yesu, n’akawoowo ak’okumanya, ke tubunyisa wonna.” Singa omukozi w’ekyuma alangirira nti yakikola okutuukiriza omulimu ogugere, ate bwe kigezesebwa ne kiremwa okutuukiriza omulimu ogwo, ffenna twandigambye ku mukozi oyo nti mulimba. Kale tetujja kwetantala kulowooza nti tekisoboka ekitonde Katonda kye yatonda okutuukiriza ekigendererwa ekyalangirirwa kye yakitondera. Naddala ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bijjudde ebigambo ebikakasa nti Kristo akifudde ekisoboka. Ekintu kyokka ekiyinza okulemesa kwe kulemererwa kw’ekitonde kyennyini okukolera wamu n’enteekateeka z’Omutonzi waakyo, era obutakwatagana buno bwe busobola okuggibwawo, olwo Katonda asobola okukola. Kristo yajja okuleeta okutangirira wakati wa Katonda n’omuntu, okwandisobozesezza Katonda okukolera mu muntu okwagala n’okukola by’ayagala, olw’okumusanyusa. N’olwekyo tusaana okuba n’obuvumu; kubanga omulimu Kristo gwe yeetikka asobola era ayagala okugutuukiriza. Kale tubeere mu abo “abatambulira mu kkubo ery’okukkiriza, jjajjaffe Ibulayimu kwe yalina,” oyo ayogerwako nti: “Teyabuusabuusa kisuubizo kya Katonda mu butakkiriza, naye yaweebwa amaanyi lwa kukkiriza; n’agulumiza Katonda. Yakakasiza ddala nti Katonda kye yasuubiza asobola okukituukiriza.”

fields.title: Okunnyonnyola Obulamu Buno
fields.body_html:
Mu ssuula eyise, nagezaako okugonjoola ekibuuzo oba Obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obw’Oku Ntikko bwesigamye ku Byawandiikibwa. Obulamu obwo nsinga kubwogerako ng’obulamu obwo Ebyawandiikibwa bye bigamba nti “bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda.” Kale kaakano ekibuuzo ekyo nkitwala ng’ekigonjoddwa. Ebyawandiikibwa bisuubiza abakkiriza ba Yesu obulamu obw’okuwummula okutuukiridde. Bujja kubeera buwanguzi obutakoma, obusukka ku bumanyirivu bw’Abakristaayo obwa bulijjo. Biraga Omulokozi ayinza okutulokola mu maanyi g’ebibi byaffe, nga bw’atulokola mu musango gwabyo.

Ensonga eddako gye tulina okulowoozaako y’eno: obulamu buno obukwekeddwa bwe buli butya? Bwawukana butya ku bumanyirivu obulala obw’Ekikristaayo? Kitegeeza okuleka Mukama okufuga ensonga zaffe n’okwetikka emigugu gyaffe, mu kifo ky’okugezaako okwekolera byonna fekka. Abakristaayo abasinga bafaanana ng’omusajja eyali atambula mu kkubo ng’akaluubirirwa, ng’asitudde omugugu omuzito. Ekigaali ne kimutuukako, omuvuzi waakyo n’amusaba n’ekisa okumuyamba. N’akkiriza n’essanyu lingi. Naye bwe yamala okutuula, omugugu gwe ne gumuzitoowerera. Yali akyagusitudde ku bibegabega bye. Omuvuzi ow’ekisa n’amubuuza nti, “Lwaki tossa wansi mugugu gwo?” “Owange!” omusajja bwe yaddamu, “mpulira nga kikyali kingi nnyo okukusaba okunsitula nze, sisobola n’akulowooza kukuleka kusitula na mugugu gwange.”

Abakristaayo abeekwasizza Mukama Yesu bakyetisse emigugu gyabwe. Batera okukoowa n’okuzitoowererwa mu lugendo lwabwe. Bwe njogera ku “migugu,” ntegeeza buli kintu kyonna ekitweraliikiriza, oba bya mwoyo oba bya nsi eno.

Okusooka byonna, ntegeeza ffe ffennyini. Omugugu ogusinga obuzito gwe tulina okwetikka mu bulamu ye ffe ffennyini. Ekisinga obuzibu okufuga ye ffe ffennyini. Obulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku, enneewulira zaffe, n’obunafu bwaffe n’okwegomba kwaffe okw’enjawulo bye bisinga okututawaanya.

Bitera okututwala mu buddu ne mu kizikiza.

N’olwekyo bw’oba ossa wansi emigugu gyo, ogusooka gw’olina okweggyako ye ggwe wennyini. Olina okukwasa Katonda omuntu wo ow’omunda. Kino kizingiramu okukemebwa kwo, obutonde bwo, n’enneewulira zo. Oluvannyuma, bireke eyo. Ye yakutonda, n’olwekyo akutegeera era amanyi engeri y’okukufuga, era olina okumwesiga okukikola.

Mugambe nti, “Wuuno, Mukama, nkwewaayo gy’oli. Ngezezzaako mu buli ngeri gye nnali nsobola okulowoozaako okwefuga n’okwefuula kye mmanyi nti nnandibadde, naye bulijjo ndemereddwa.

Kaakano nkikuwadde. Nkwegayiridde, ntwala ddala nga wuwo. Kola mu nze byonna by’oyagala era by’osiima. Mbumba, onfuule ekibya nga bw’olaba nga kisaanidde. Nneerekera mu mikono gyo. Nzikiriza nti, nga bwe wasuubiza, ojja kunfuula ekibya eky’ekitiibwa kyo, ‘atukuziddwa, asaanira okukozesebwa mukama we, olw’omulimu omulungi.’” Kaakano olina okuwummula, ng’omwesiga ddala. Ekiddako, olina okussa wansi buli mugugu omulala gwonna: obulamu bwo obw’omubiri, erinnya lyo, omulimu gwo ogw’Ekikristaayo, ennyumba zo, abaana bo, bizinensi yo, n’abaweereza bo. Buli kintu ekikukwatako, eky’omunda oba eky’ebweru.

Abakristaayo bulijjo bakwasa Mukama emmeeme zaabwe olw’emirembe n’emirembe. Bamanyi, awatali kubuusabuusa, nti tebasobola kwekuuma bokka. Naye ebintu eby’obulamu buno babyekuumira bokka. Bagezaako okubyetikka nga balina enneewulira gye batayatula: nti kiba kingi okusaba Mukama okubasitula, era tebasobola kulowooza kumusaba kwetikka na migugu gyabwe.

Nnali mmanyi omukyala Omukristaayo eyalina omugugu omuzito ennyo ogw’ensi eno. Gwamuggyako otulo n’okwagala emmere, era waaliwo akabi nti obulamu bwe bwandigudde olw’omugugu ogwo. Lumu, gwali gumuzitoowereredde nnyo okusinga bulijjo. N’alaba akapapula akatono akaali kayitibwa “Okukkiriza kwa Hannah” ku mmeeza okumpi naye.” Ng’asikiriziddwa omutwe gwako, n’akakwata n’atandika okusoma. Teyamanya nti kagenda kukyusa ddala bumanyirivu bwe bwonna. Emboozi yali ekwata ku mukazi omwavu eyali agumiikirizza ennaku nnyingi.

Lumu, yannyonnyola omugenyi ow’ekisa ebyafaayo by’obulamu bwe. Ku nkomerero, omugenyi n’agamba nti, “Ai Hannah, sitegeera ngeri gye wasobola okugumira ennaku eyenkana awo!” “Saagigumira nze,” bwe yaddamu amangu. “Mukama ye yagyetikka ku lwange.” “Yee,” omugenyi bwe yagamba. “Eyo ye ngeri entuufu.” “Olina okutwala ebizibu byo eri Mukama.”

“Yee,” Hannah bwe yaddamu. “Naye tulina okukola n’okusingawo; tulina okubirekayo. Abantu abasinga,” bwe yeeyongera, “bamutwalira emigugu gyabwe, naye ne bagikomyawo. Basigala beeraliikirira era nga banakuwavu nga bulijjo.” Naye nze ngitwala, ne ngireka gy’ali, ne nzirayo ne ngyerabira. Era okweraliikirira bwe kudda, nkutwala gy’ali nate. Kino nkikola emirundi n’emirundi, okutuusa lwe nneerabira ebinneeraliikiriza ne mbeera mu kuwummula okutuukiridde.”

Mukwano gwange kino kyamukwatako nnyo, n’amalirira okukigezaako. Teyasobola kukyusa bulamu bwe. N’olwekyo, n’abutwala eri Mukama. N’abumukwasa. Oluvannyuma, n’akkiriza nti abututte. N’amulekera ebimweraliikiriza byonna n’okutya kwe kwonna. Okweraliikirira kwe kwakomangawo emirundi mingi. Yakuzzangayo. N’olwekyo, newakubadde ng’ebintu tebyakyuka, emmeeme ye yafuna emirembe egituukiridde. Yawulira nti azudde ekyama eky’omukisa. Okuva olwo, yafubanga obutaddayo kwetikka migugu gye ku bubwe, wadde okwefugira ekintu kyonna ku lulwe. Ekyama kino kyakola eby’amagero mu nsonga ze ez’ebweru. Kyakola n’okusingawo mu nsonga ze ez’omunda, ezaali enzibu okusingawo okufuga.

Yawaayo yennyini yonna eri Mukama. Yamwesiga mu byonna bye yalina. N’olwekyo, n’alekera awo okweraliikirira. Obulamu bwe ne bufuuka obw’essanyu, kubanga yali wuwe. Era buno bwe bwali Obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obw’Oku Ntikko! Kyali kyama kyangu nnyo kye yazuula.

Kyali kino kyokka. Omuntu yali ayinza okugondera ekiragiro kya Katonda mu bigambo bino: “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.” Abafiripi 4:6. Omuntu bw’agondera, ekiva mu ekyo kyandibadde, ng’ekisuubizo bwe kiri, nti “emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.” Waliwo ebirala bingi eby’okwogera ku bulamu buno obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda. Waliwo ebintu bingi ebikwata ku ebyo Mukama Yesu by’akolera abo abamwewaayo. Naye omusingi gw’ensonga guli wano. Emmeeme emanyi ekyama kino erina ekisumuluzo.

Kijja kusumulula eggwanika lya Katonda ery’obugagga. Nsuubira nti nkuleetedde okwegomba obulamu buno obw’omukisa.

Toyagala kweggyako migugu gyo? Teweegomba kukwasa buli kimu ekikwata ku ggwe kennyini atafugika mu mikono gy’oyo ayinza okukufuga? Tokooye? Okuwummula kwe njogerako tekukulabikira kulungi? Ojjukira okuwummula okw’essanyu kwe wawuliranga oluvannyuma lw’olunaku olukooya, nga tonnagenda kwebaka? Nga kyali kinyuma nnyo okuwummuza buli kinywa! Okuleka omubiri gwange okuwummula mu mirembe n’obuteefu obutuukiridde. Okufuba kw’olunaku kwali kukomye okumala essaawa ntono waakiri, n’abakozi baali basudde eri omulimu gw’olunaku. Tewaali kyetaagisa nate kuwanirira mutwe oguluma oba mugongo ogukooye. Weesiga ekitanda ddala. Kyakuwanirira awatali kufuba kwonna. N’owummula. Naye singa wabuusabuusa amaanyi g’ekitanda kyo. Era nga otya nti kijja kumenyeka kikusuule wansi. Wandisobodde okuwummula olwo? Buli kinywa tekyandifubye okukuwanirira? Okukoowa tekwandisinze okw’obutagenda ku kitanda n’akatono?

Ekifaananyi kino kikuyigirize kye kitegeeza okuwummulira mu Mukama. Emmeeme zammwe zigalamire ku ebyo ebirungi by’ayagala, nga emibiri gyammwe bwe gigalamira ku bitanda byammwe ekiro. Muwummuze buli kufuba era muteeke wansi buli mugugu.

Muveeko ku kuwummula kwonna n’okunyumirwa kwonna. Mwesige nti, bw’abawanirira, muli mirembe. Omulimu gwammwe gwokka kuwummula. Ogugwe kubawanirira, era tayinza kulemererwa. Oba, mutwale ekifaananyi ekirala, Mukama waffe kye yakakasa: eky’obulamu bw’omwana, nga bwe kyogerwa nti, “Yesu n’ayita omwana omuto n’amussa mu makkati gaabwe. N’abagamba nti, ‘Ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe mutakyuke kufaanana ng’abaana abato temugenda kuyingira mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu.’” Matayo 18:2-3. Kale, omwana omuto alina mpisa ki, era abeera atya? Abeera mu kukkiriza, era empisa ye esinga obukulu bwe buteefaako. Obulamu bwe kwesiga kumu okuwanvu okuva ku nkomerero y’omwaka okutuuka ku nkomerero y’omwaka. Yeesiga bazadde be, abamulabirira, n’abasomesa be. Yeesiga n’abantu abamu abatasaanidde, olw’obutonde bwe obwesiga. Era okwesiga kwe kuddibwamu n’omutima omugabi. Teyeetegekera kintu na kimu, kyokka afuna buli kimu. Tateekateeka bya nkya. Kyokka ateekateeka obulamu bwe. Amakubo ge gamugguka nga bw’agatuukako, essaawa ku ssaawa, buli lunaku. Ayingira era afuluma mu nnyumba ya kitaawe nga talina kimutawaanya era nga wa ddembe.

Anyumirwa obugagga bwayo, nga talina ky’asasudde okubufuna.

Kawumpuli ayinza okutambula mu nguudo z’ekibuga kye, naye ye takifaako. Enjala, omuliro, n’entalo biyinza okubumbujja okumwetooloola. Naye, mu kulabirirwa kwa kitaawe, awummula mu mirembe egituukiridde. Abeera mu kaseera ka kaakano, ng’akkiriza obulamu nga bwe bujja. Lumu nnakyalira ennyumba y’abagagga eyalimu omwana omu yekka gwe baali batwala ng’owaabwe. Yafunanga okwagala kwonna n’okulabirirwa emitima gy’abantu n’ebintu bye byayinza okuwa. Bwe nnali nnaba omwana oyo ng’ayingira era ng’afuluma, buli lunaku, nnalaba ekifaananyi ky’ekifo kyaffe eky’ekitalo ng’abaana mu nnyumba ya Kitaffe. Omwana yali wa ddembe era wa mutima mwangu, ng’alina obuteefaako obw’essanyu obw’omu buto.

Ne ndowooza nti, “Singa waliwo ekyandinakuwazizza abaagalwa be, kyandibadde kulaba mwana ono ng’eyeeraliikirira ku lulwe.”

Omutima gwa Katonda waffe ogujjudde okwagala tegusinga nnyo okunakuwala olw’abaana be okweraliikirira? Ne ntegeera ensonga lwaki Mukama waffe yali akkaatiriza nti, “Temweraliikiriranga bya bulamu bwammwe.” Ani asinga okulabirirwa obulungi mu buli maka?

Si abaana abato? Era omuto okusinga bonna, omwana omuwere atalina bw’ayinza, si y’afuna omugabo ogusinga obunene? Omuwandiisi omu eyafa gye buvuddeko yagamba nti omwana omuwere “talina ky’afuba so taluka wuzi; naye wabaawo amuliisa, amwambaza, amwagala, era amusanyukira.” Tewali amusanyukira okusinga ye bw’akola.

Kale obulamu buno obw’okukkiriza bwe mpandiikako buli mu kino: okubeera omwana mu nnyumba ya Kitaffe.

Omuntu bw’agamba kino, aba ayogedde ekimala. Kiyinza okufuula obulamu bwonna obukooye era obuzitoowereddwa okuba obw’omukisa n’okuwummula.

Obwesige obutaliimu kweraliikirira obw’abaana bammwe abato bubayigirize engeri y’okubeera ne Katonda. Bubasanyusa era bubawangula emitima. Mwerekere mu mikono gye. “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.”

Abafiripi 4:6-7 Weetegereze ebigambo ‘kintu na kimu’ mu kitundu ekyo waggulu. Bizingiramu buli nsonga yonna eyinza okuleeta okweraliikirira, ey’omunda n’ey’ebweru. Tutera okuwulira nga tunyigirizibwa okukkiriza nti mulimu gwaffe okweraliikirira ku nsonga ezimu.

Tujja kulowooza nti, “kituufu okuleka okweraliikirira kwonna. Mu nsonga ez’omwoyo, okweraliikirira kubi. Naye ku bintu ebimu tulina okweraliikirira. Kyandibadde kibi obuteeraliikirira. Tulina okweraliikirira ku baana baffe, ku abo be twagala, ku kkanisa yaffe, ku mazima, ne ku bizinensi yaffe.” Kyandiraze obutaba na nneewulira ntuufu n’akatono obuteeraliikirira ku bintu ng’ebyo.” Oba, tuyinza okulowooza nti, “Yee, kituufu okwesiga Mukama n’abaagalwa baffe n’ensonga zaffe. Naye tusaanidde okweraliikirira ku bulamu bwaffe obw’omunda, okukkiriza kwaffe, okukemebwa kwaffe, n’ebibi byaffe. Bwe tutaakole tutyo, bo bajja kubirekerera.”

Eky’okuddamu mu birowoozo ng’ebyo, n’ebirala byonna ebibifaanana, tukisanga mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe: “Noolwekyo mbagamba nti, Temweraliikiriranga bya bulamu bwammwe, bye munaalya oba bye munaanywa, wadde ebyokwambala. Kubanga obulamu businga ebyokulya, n’omubiri gusinga ebyambalo.

Mulabire ku nnyonyi ez’omu bbanga! Tezisiga so tezikungula so tezikuŋŋaanyiza mmere mu tterekero, naye Kitammwe ali mu ggulu aziriisa. Naye mmwe temusinga nnyo ennyonyi ezo? Ani ku mmwe, bwe yeeraliikirira, ayinza okwongerayo obulamu bwe akatundu n’akamu? Naye lwaki mweraliikirira ebyokwambala? Mulabire ku malanga ag’oku ttale! Tegaliiko kye geekolera, naye ne Kabaka Sulemaani mu kitiibwa kye kyonna teyagenkana mu kwambala. Naye obanga Katonda ayambaza obulungi bw’atyo omuddo ogw’omu nsiko ogw’ekiseera obuseera, ogubaawo leero ate enkeera ne gwokebwa mu kyoto, talisingawo nnyo okubambaza? Nga mulina okukkiriza okutono! Noolwekyo temweraliikiririranga nga mugamba nti, ‘Tunaalya ki? Oba nti, Tunaanywa ki? Oba nti, Tunaayambala ki?’” Matayo 6:25-31 “Ebyo byonna bannamawanga bye bayaayaanira. Naye Kitammwe ali mu ggulu amanyi ng’ebyo byonna mubyetaaga.

Naye musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako.

“Noolwekyo temweraliikiriranga bya nkya. Kubanga olunaku olw’enkya lulyeraliikirira ebyalwo. Buli lunaku lulina emitawaana gyalwo egimala.” Mu Matayo 6:32-34, Mukama waffe ayolesa obuteeraliikirira buno ng’atugamba okulaba ennyonyi ez’omu bbanga n’amalanga ag’oku ttale, ng’ebyokulabirako by’obulamu bw’ayagala tubeeremu. Tulina, nga tetweraliikirira wadde okutya, okufaanana ng’ennyonyi n’amalanga. Ennyonyi zisanyukira okulabirirwa kwa Katonda ne zifuna emmere. Amalanga gakula mu musana gwe. Enkazaluggya zitwogerere: “Nze ndi nkazaluggya entono, ennyonyi eya wansi. Obulamu bwange bwa mugaso mutono, naye Mukama omwagalwa andabirira. Sirina tterekero wadde eggwanika. Sisiga so sikungula. Ampa omugabo gw’enkazaluggya, naye tampa mpeke n’emu kwetereka. “Mmanyi nti waliwo enkazaluggya nnyingi. Abantu baziraba mu nsi yonna. Naye Kitaffe ali mu ggulu amanyi omu ku ffe bw’agwa wansi. “Newakubadde tuli batono, tetwerabirwa. Newakubadde tuli banafu, tetutya. Kubanga tumanyi nti Mukama omwagalwa akuuma obulamu bw’ebitonde bye yatonda. “Mbuuka waggulu w’emiti egisinga okuziyira ne ntuula ku matabi mangi.” Sirina maapu wadde kampasi, naye sibula kkubo.”

Ku kawungeezi nzinga ebiwaawaatiro byange, wonna we mba. Kitaffe bulijjo atunula. Tewali kabi kanantuukako. Ndi nkazaluggya entono bwe ntyo, ennyonyi eya wansi. Naye mmanyi nti Kitaffe anjagala. Mmwe mulina okukkiriza okutono okusinga ffe?”

Nzikiriza nti, nga bwe wasuubiza, ojja kunfuula ekibya eky’ekitiibwa kyo, ‘atukuziddwa, asaanira okukozesebwa mukama we, olw’omulimu omulungi.’” Kaakano olina okuwummula, ng’omwesiga ddala. Ekiddako, olina okussa wansi buli mugugu omulala gwonna: obulamu bwo obw’omubiri, erinnya lyo, omulimu gwo ogw’Ekikristaayo, ennyumba zo, abaana bo, bizinensi yo, n’abaweereza bo. Buli kintu ekikukwatako, eky’omunda oba eky’ebweru. Abakristaayo bulijjo bakwasa Mukama emmeeme zaabwe olw’emirembe n’emirembe. Bamanyi, awatali kubuusabuusa, nti tebasobola kwekuuma bokka. Naye ebintu eby’obulamu buno babyekuumira bokka. Bagezaako okubyetikka nga balina enneewulira gye batayatula: nti kiba kingi okusaba Mukama okubasitula, era tebasobola kulowooza kumusaba kwetikka na migugu gyabwe. Nnali mmanyi omukyala Omukristaayo eyalina omugugu omuzito ennyo ogw’ensi eno. Gwamuggyako otulo n’okwagala emmere, era waaliwo akabi nti obulamu bwe bwandigudde olw’omugugu ogwo. Lumu, gwali gumuzitoowereredde nnyo okusinga bulijjo. N’alaba akapapula akatono akaali kayitibwa “Okukkiriza kwa Hannah” ku mmeeza okumpi naye.” Ng’asikiriziddwa omutwe gwako, n’akakwata n’atandika okusoma. Teyamanya nti kagenda kukyusa ddala bumanyirivu bwe bwonna. Emboozi yali ekwata ku mukazi omwavu eyali agumiikirizza ennaku nnyingi. Lumu, yannyonnyola omugenyi ow’ekisa ebyafaayo by’obulamu bwe. Ku nkomerero, omugenyi n’agamba nti, “Ai Hannah, sitegeera ngeri gye wasobola okugumira ennaku eyenkana awo!” “Saagigumira nze,” bwe yaddamu amangu. “Mukama ye yagyetikka ku lwange.” “Yee,” omugenyi bwe yagamba. “Eyo ye ngeri entuufu.” “Olina okutwala ebizibu byo eri Mukama.” “Yee,” Hannah bwe yaddamu. “Naye tulina okukola n’okusingawo; tulina okubirekayo. Abantu abasinga,” bwe yeeyongera, “bamutwalira emigugu gyabwe, naye ne bagikomyawo. Basigala beeraliikirira era nga banakuwavu nga bulijjo.” Naye nze ngitwala, ne ngireka gy’ali, ne nzirayo ne ngyerabira. Era okweraliikirira bwe kudda, nkutwala gy’ali nate. Kino nkikola emirundi n’emirundi, okutuusa lwe nneerabira ebinneeraliikiriza ne mbeera mu kuwummula okutuukiridde.” Mukwano gwange kino kyamukwatako nnyo, n’amalirira okukigezaako. Teyasobola kukyusa bulamu bwe. N’olwekyo, n’abutwala eri Mukama. N’abumukwasa. Oluvannyuma, n’akkiriza nti abututte. N’amulekera ebimweraliikiriza byonna n’okutya kwe kwonna. Okweraliikirira kwe kwakomangawo emirundi mingi. Yakuzzangayo. N’olwekyo, newakubadde ng’ebintu tebyakyuka, emmeeme ye yafuna emirembe egituukiridde. Yawulira nti azudde ekyama eky’omukisa. Okuva olwo, yafubanga obutaddayo kwetikka migugu gye ku bubwe, wadde okwefugira ekintu kyonna ku lulwe. Ekyama kino kyakola eby’amagero mu nsonga ze ez’ebweru. Kyakola n’okusingawo mu nsonga ze ez’omunda, ezaali enzibu okusingawo okufuga. Yawaayo yennyini yonna eri Mukama. Yamwesiga mu byonna bye yalina. N’olwekyo, n’alekera awo okweraliikirira. Obulamu bwe ne bufuuka obw’essanyu, kubanga yali wuwe. Era buno bwe bwali Obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obw’Oku Ntikko! Kyali kyama kyangu nnyo kye yazuula. Kyali kino kyokka. Omuntu yali ayinza okugondera ekiragiro kya Katonda mu bigambo bino: “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga.” Abafiripi 4:6. Omuntu bw’agondera, ekiva mu ekyo kyandibadde, ng’ekisuubizo bwe kiri, nti “emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.” Waliwo ebirala bingi eby’okwogera ku bulamu buno obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda. Waliwo ebintu bingi ebikwata ku ebyo Mukama Yesu by’akolera abo abamwewaayo. Naye omusingi gw’ensonga guli wano. Emmeeme emanyi ekyama kino erina ekisumuluzo. Kijja kusumulula eggwanika lya Katonda ery’obugagga. Nsuubira nti nkuleetedde okwegomba obulamu buno obw’omukisa. Toyagala kweggyako migugu gyo? Teweegomba kukwasa buli kimu ekikwata ku ggwe kennyini atafugika mu mikono gy’oyo ayinza okukufuga? Tokooye? Okuwummula kwe njogerako tekukulabikira kulungi? Ojjukira okuwummula okw’essanyu kwe wawuliranga oluvannyuma lw’olunaku olukooya, nga tonnagenda kwebaka? Nga kyali kinyuma nnyo okuwummuza buli kinywa! Okuleka omubiri gwange okuwummula mu mirembe n’obuteefu obutuukiridde. Okufuba kw’olunaku kwali kukomye okumala essaawa ntono waakiri, n’abakozi baali basudde eri omulimu gw’olunaku. Tewaali kyetaagisa nate kuwanirira mutwe oguluma oba mugongo ogukooye. Weesiga ekitanda ddala. Kyakuwanirira awatali kufuba kwonna. N’owummula. Naye singa wabuusabuusa amaanyi g’ekitanda kyo. Era nga otya nti kijja kumenyeka kikusuule wansi. Wandisobodde okuwummula olwo? Buli kinywa tekyandifubye okukuwanirira? Okukoowa tekwandisinze okw’obutagenda ku kitanda n’akatono? Ekifaananyi kino kikuyigirize kye kitegeeza okuwummulira mu Mukama. Emmeeme zammwe zigalamire ku ebyo ebirungi by’ayagala, nga emibiri gyammwe bwe gigalamira ku bitanda byammwe ekiro. Muwummuze buli kufuba era muteeke wansi buli mugugu. Muveeko ku kuwummula kwonna n’okunyumirwa kwonna. Mwesige nti, bw’abawanirira, muli mirembe. Omulimu gwammwe gwokka kuwummula. Ogugwe kubawanirira, era tayinza kulemererwa. Oba, mutwale ekifaananyi ekirala, Mukama waffe kye yakakasa: eky’obulamu bw’omwana, nga bwe kyogerwa nti, “Yesu n’ayita omwana omuto n’amussa mu makkati gaabwe. N’abagamba nti, ‘Ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe mutakyuke kufaanana ng’abaana abato temugenda kuyingira mu bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu.’” Matayo 18:2-3. Kale, omwana omuto alina mpisa ki, era abeera atya? Abeera mu kukkiriza, era empisa ye esinga obukulu bwe buteefaako. Obulamu bwe kwesiga kumu okuwanvu okuva ku nkomerero y’omwaka okutuuka ku nkomerero y’omwaka. Yeesiga bazadde be, abamulabirira, n’abasomesa be. Yeesiga n’abantu abamu abatasaanidde, olw’obutonde bwe obwesiga. Era okwesiga kwe kuddibwamu n’omutima omugabi. Teyeetegekera kintu na kimu, kyokka afuna buli kimu. Tateekateeka bya nkya. Kyokka ateekateeka obulamu bwe. Amakubo ge gamugguka nga bw’agatuukako, essaawa ku ssaawa, buli lunaku. Ayingira era afuluma mu nnyumba ya kitaawe nga talina kimutawaanya era nga wa ddembe. Anyumirwa obugagga bwayo, nga talina ky’asasudde okubufuna. Kawumpuli ayinza okutambula mu nguudo z’ekibuga kye, naye ye takifaako. Enjala, omuliro, n’entalo biyinza okubumbujja okumwetooloola. Naye, mu kulabirirwa kwa kitaawe, awummula mu mirembe egituukiridde. Abeera mu kaseera ka kaakano, ng’akkiriza obulamu nga bwe bujja. Lumu nnakyalira ennyumba y’abagagga eyalimu omwana omu yekka gwe baali batwala ng’owaabwe. Yafunanga okwagala kwonna n’okulabirirwa emitima gy’abantu n’ebintu bye byayinza okuwa. Bwe nnali nnaba omwana oyo ng’ayingira era ng’afuluma, buli lunaku, nnalaba ekifaananyi ky’ekifo kyaffe eky’ekitalo ng’abaana mu nnyumba ya Kitaffe. Omwana yali wa ddembe era wa mutima mwangu, ng’alina obuteefaako obw’essanyu obw’omu buto. Ne ndowooza nti, “Singa waliwo ekyandinakuwazizza abaagalwa be, kyandibadde kulaba mwana ono ng’eyeeraliikirira ku lulwe.” Omutima gwa Katonda waffe ogujjudde okwagala tegusinga nnyo okunakuwala olw’abaana be okweraliikirira? Ne ntegeera ensonga lwaki Mukama waffe yali akkaatiriza nti, “Temweraliikiriranga bya bulamu bwammwe.” Ani asinga okulabirirwa obulungi mu buli maka? Si abaana abato? Era omuto okusinga bonna, omwana omuwere atalina bw’ayinza, si y’afuna omugabo ogusinga obunene? Omuwandiisi omu eyafa gye buvuddeko yagamba nti omwana omuwere “talina ky’afuba so taluka wuzi; naye wabaawo amuliisa, amwambaza, amwagala, era amusanyukira.” Tewali amusanyukira okusinga ye bw’akola. Kale obulamu buno obw’okukkiriza bwe mpandiikako buli mu kino: okubeera omwana mu nnyumba ya Kitaffe. Omuntu bw’agamba kino, aba ayogedde ekimala. Kiyinza okufuula obulamu bwonna obukooye era obuzitoowereddwa okuba obw’omukisa n’okuwummula. Obwesige obutaliimu kweraliikirira obw’abaana bammwe abato bubayigirize engeri y’okubeera ne Katonda. Bubasanyusa era bubawangula emitima. Mwerekere mu mikono gye. “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.” Abafiripi 4:6-7 Weetegereze ebigambo ‘kintu na kimu’ mu kitundu ekyo waggulu. Bizingiramu buli nsonga yonna eyinza okuleeta okweraliikirira, ey’omunda n’ey’ebweru. Tutera okuwulira nga tunyigirizibwa okukkiriza nti mulimu gwaffe okweraliikirira ku nsonga ezimu. Tujja kulowooza nti, “kituufu okuleka okweraliikirira kwonna. Mu nsonga ez’omwoyo, okweraliikirira kubi. Naye ku bintu ebimu tulina okweraliikirira. Kyandibadde kibi obuteeraliikirira. Tulina okweraliikirira ku baana baffe, ku abo be twagala, ku kkanisa yaffe, ku mazima, ne ku bizinensi yaffe.” Kyandiraze obutaba na nneewulira ntuufu n’akatono obuteeraliikirira ku bintu ng’ebyo.” Oba, tuyinza okulowooza nti, “Yee, kituufu okwesiga Mukama n’abaagalwa baffe n’ensonga zaffe. Naye tusaanidde okweraliikirira ku bulamu bwaffe obw’omunda, okukkiriza kwaffe, okukemebwa kwaffe, n’ebibi byaffe. Bwe tutaakole tutyo, bo bajja kubirekerera.” Eky’okuddamu mu birowoozo ng’ebyo, n’ebirala byonna ebibifaanana, tukisanga mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe: “Noolwekyo mbagamba nti, Temweraliikiriranga bya bulamu bwammwe, bye munaalya oba bye munaanywa, wadde ebyokwambala. Kubanga obulamu businga ebyokulya, n’omubiri gusinga ebyambalo. Mulabire ku nnyonyi ez’omu bbanga! Tezisiga so tezikungula so tezikuŋŋaanyiza mmere mu tterekero, naye Kitammwe ali mu ggulu aziriisa. Naye mmwe temusinga nnyo ennyonyi ezo? Ani ku mmwe, bwe yeeraliikirira, ayinza okwongerayo obulamu bwe akatundu n’akamu? Naye lwaki mweraliikirira ebyokwambala? Mulabire ku malanga ag’oku ttale! Tegaliiko kye geekolera, naye ne Kabaka Sulemaani mu kitiibwa kye kyonna teyagenkana mu kwambala. Naye obanga Katonda ayambaza obulungi bw’atyo omuddo ogw’omu nsiko ogw’ekiseera obuseera, ogubaawo leero ate enkeera ne gwokebwa mu kyoto, talisingawo nnyo okubambaza? Nga mulina okukkiriza okutono! Noolwekyo temweraliikiririranga nga mugamba nti, ‘Tunaalya ki? Oba nti, Tunaanywa ki? Oba nti, Tunaayambala ki?’” Matayo 6:25-31 “Ebyo byonna bannamawanga bye bayaayaanira. Naye Kitammwe ali mu ggulu amanyi ng’ebyo byonna mubyetaaga. Naye musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako. “Noolwekyo temweraliikiriranga bya nkya. Kubanga olunaku olw’enkya lulyeraliikirira ebyalwo. Buli lunaku lulina emitawaana gyalwo egimala.” Mu Matayo 6:32-34, Mukama waffe ayolesa obuteeraliikirira buno ng’atugamba okulaba ennyonyi ez’omu bbanga n’amalanga ag’oku ttale, ng’ebyokulabirako by’obulamu bw’ayagala tubeeremu. Tulina, nga tetweraliikirira wadde okutya, okufaanana ng’ennyonyi n’amalanga. Ennyonyi zisanyukira okulabirirwa kwa Katonda ne zifuna emmere. Amalanga gakula mu musana gwe. Enkazaluggya zitwogerere: “Nze ndi nkazaluggya entono, ennyonyi eya wansi. Obulamu bwange bwa mugaso mutono, naye Mukama omwagalwa andabirira. Sirina tterekero wadde eggwanika. Sisiga so sikungula. Ampa omugabo gw’enkazaluggya, naye tampa mpeke n’emu kwetereka. “Mmanyi nti waliwo enkazaluggya nnyingi. Abantu baziraba mu nsi yonna. Naye Kitaffe ali mu ggulu amanyi omu ku ffe bw’agwa wansi. “Newakubadde tuli batono, tetwerabirwa. Newakubadde tuli banafu, tetutya. Kubanga tumanyi nti Mukama omwagalwa akuuma obulamu bw’ebitonde bye yatonda. “Mbuuka waggulu w’emiti egisinga okuziyira ne ntuula ku matabi mangi.” Sirina maapu wadde kampasi, naye sibula kkubo.” Ku kawungeezi nzinga ebiwaawaatiro byange, wonna we mba. Kitaffe bulijjo atunula. Tewali kabi kanantuukako. Ndi nkazaluggya entono bwe ntyo, ennyonyi eya wansi. Naye mmanyi nti Kitaffe anjagala. Mmwe mulina okukkiriza okutono okusinga ffe?”

fields.title: Engeri y’Okuyingira
fields.body_html:
Ngezezzaako okugonjoola ekibuuzo oba obumanyirivu bw’obulamu buno obw’okwesiga okujjuvu bwesigamye ku Byawandiikibwa. Era ndaze katono ku ki bwe buli. Ensonga eddako y’eno: engeri y’okubutuukako n’okububeeramu. Era okusooka, nandigambye nti tetulina kutunuulira bulamu buno obw’omukisa mu ngeri yonna ng’ekintu kye tutuukako olw’okufuba, wabula ng’ekintu kye tuweebwa. Tetuyinza kubukolera, tetuyinza kubulinnyira, tetuyinza kubuwangula; tetulina kye tuyinza kukola wabula okubusaba n’okubufuna. Kye kirabo kya Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Era ekintu bwe kiba kirabo, ekisigalira eri oyo akiweebwa kwe kukitwala n’okwebaza oyo akimuwadde. Tetugamba ku kirabo nti, “Laba kye ntuuseeko,” ne twenyumiriza mu bukugu bwaffe mu kukifuna. Wabula tugamba nti, “Laba omugabi ky’ampadde,” ne twenyumiriza mu kwagala n’obugabi bw’omugabi.

Era buli kimu mu bulokozi bwaffe kirabo. Okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero, Katonda ye mugabi ate ffe tuli bafunyi. Ebisuubizo ebisinga obugagga si bya abo abakola ebikulu. Bya abo “abaliweebwa ekisa kya Katonda n’ekirabo eky’obutuukirivu.” Okumanya obulamu buno obw’omunda, emmeeme eteekwa okuba nga yeetegefu okufuna. Eteekwa okutegeera ddala nti obulamu buno bujja kubeera kirabo kya Katonda mu Kristo Yesu. Tetuyinza kubufuna lwa kufuba kwaffe oba bikolwa byaffe. Kino kijja kwanguyiza nnyo ensonga. Ekibuuzo kyokka ekisigaddewo kiri nti ani alifuna ekirabo kino okuva eri Katonda, era akikkiriza atya. Nandizzeemu nti akiwa emmeeme yokka eyeewaddeyo ddala. Olina okukifuna mu kukkiriza.

Okwewaayo kye kintu ekisooka. Si mu ngeri ya mateeka, wadde okubugula oba okubusaanira. Wabula okuggyawo ebiziyiza, Katonda asobole okubuwa. Okubumba ekibya ekirungi mu kibumba ky’ebbumba, omubumbi ateekwa okuba n’obuyinza bwonna ku kyo. Kiteekwa okugalamira mu mikono gye nga tekirina kye kyekolera. Okufuula emmeeme ekibya eky’ekitiibwa kya Katonda, eteekwa okuba nga “atukuziddwa, asaanira okukozesebwa mukama we, olw’omulimu omulungi.” Eteekwa okumwewaayo ddala era n’esigala mu mikono gye nga terina kye yeekolera. Kino kyeyoleka bulungi okuva ku kulaba okusooka.

Lumu nagezaako okunnyonnyola omusawo w’eddwaliro amakulu n’obwetaavu bw’okwewaayo. Naye yalabika ng’atasobola kutegeera. Ku nkomerero, ne mmugamba nti, “Kale lowooza, ng’otambula mu kulambula abalwadde, n’osanga omusajja akwegayirira omuwonye. Naye tayagala kukubuulira bubonero bwe bwonna wadde okumira eddagala ly’omuwa.

Yandigambye nti, ‘Neetegese okugoberera ebiragiro byo mu nsonga ezimu, nga bwe ndaba nti birungi gye ndi. Naye mu nsonga endala, njagala kugoberera magezi gange.’ Wandikoze ki?” bwe nnamubuuza.

“Okukola ki!” bwe yaddamu ng’anyiize, “okukola ki! Omusajja ng’oyo nnandimuvuddeko mangu ne mmuleka yeerabirire yekka. “Kya lwatu,” bwe yayongerako. “Sandibaddeko kye mmukolera. Ateekwa okugondera ebiragiro byange.” “Kale, abalwadde bateekwa okugondera abasawo okusobola okuwona?” “Okubigondera mu byonna awatali kwekwasa!” bwe yaddamu n’amaanyi. “Era ekyo kye 20 okwewaayo,” bwe nneeyongera. “Katonda ateekwa okuweebwa ensonga yonna, awatali kyekwekeddwa. Ebiragiro bye biteekwa okugonderwa mu byonna.” “Nkirabye,” bwe yaleekaana, — “Nkirabye! Era nja kukikola. Okuva kati Katonda ateekwa okukola nange nga bw’ayagala.”

Abamu bayinza okulowooza nti ekigambo “okwerekera” kye kisinga. Naye kyonna kye tukozesa, tutegeeza okwewaayo okujjuvu eri Katonda. Tumuwa omwoyo gwaffe, emmeeme yaffe, n’omubiri gwaffe. Twagala akole naffe nga bw’ayagala. Tutegeeza nti olulimi lw’emmeeme yaffe mu byonna lulina okwolesa nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe.” Tutegeeza okulekayo okwesalirawo kwonna.

Tutegeeza obulamu obw’obuwulize obutayinza kwewalika. Eri emmeeme etamanyi Katonda, kino kiyinza okulabika ng’ekizibu. Naye eri abo abamumanyi, bwe bulamu obusinga essanyu n’okuwummula. Ye Kitaffe. Atwagala era amanyi ekisinga obulungi. N’olwekyo, by’ayagala bye bintu ebisinga omukisa ebiyinza okututuukako, ka embeera zibe zitya. Sitegeera ngeri Setaani gye yasobola okuziba amaaso g’Ekkanisa ku mazima gano. Naye kirabika abaana ba Katonda batya by’ayagala okusinga ekintu kyonna. By’ayagala ebirungi era ebyagalibwa bitegeeza birungi byokka eri emmeeme zaabwe. Bireeta ekisa ekitaggwaawo, okusaasira okw’omukwano, n’emikisa emingi.

Kale singa nnali nsobola okulaga buli muntu obuwoomi obutakoma obw’ebyo Katonda by’ayagala. Eggulu kye kifo eky’essanyu eritakoma. By’ayagala bikolebwa eyo mu bujjuvu. Obulamu bwaffe bugabana ku ssanyu lino nga by’ayagala bikolebwa mu bwo.

Atwagala, atwagala, era ekyo okwagala kye kwagala bulijjo kiba mukisa eri omwagalwa wakwo. Abamu ku ffe tumanyi okwagala.

Singa twali tusobola, twandiwadde emikisa abaagalwa baffe. Twandibajjuzza buli kirungi n’ekisanyusa mu bulamu, singa twalina obuyinza okutuukiriza kye tubaagaliza.

Era obanga eno y’engeri y’okwagala gye tuli, kale tekisingawo nnyo eri Katonda waffe, oyo ye kennyini kwagala.

Singa twali tusobola okulaba, ne bwe kiba akaseera katono, obuziba bw’okwagala kwe, twandiddukidde mu ebyo by’ayagala ng’eky’obugagga kyaffe ekisinga. Twandibyewaddeyo, nga tujjudde essanyu n’okwebaza olw’enkizo ng’eyo.

Abakristaayo bangi bakkiriza nti Kitaffe ali mu ggulu ayagala kubanakuwaza n’okubaggyako emikisa gyabwe.

Balowooza, abaavu abo, nti bwe banywerera ku kusalawo kwabwe, bayinza okumuziyiza okukikola. Nkwatibwa ensonyi okuwandiika ebigambo bino, naye tulina okwolekera ekintu ekiviirako obulamu bw’abantu bikumi na bikumi okuba obw’ennaku.

Omukyala omu Omukristaayo, eyawuliranga bw’atyo, yabuulira mukwano gwe nga bwe kyali kizibu okugamba nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe,” era nga bwe yatyanga okukikola. Yali maama w’omwana omulenzi omu yekka, eyali omusika w’obugagga obungi, era nga gwe yali asinga okwagala mu mutima gwe. Bwe yamala okumubuulira ebimutawaanya, mukwano gwe n’amugamba nti, “Watya singa Charley wo omuto akuddukira enkya?” N’agamba nti, ‘Maama, nsazeewo okukuleka okukola nange nga bw’oyagala okuva kati.’

Nja kukugonderanga bulijjo. “Njagala onkolere ky’olaba nga kye kisinga obulungi.”

Mmanyi nti onjagala, era nja kwesiga okwagala kwo. Wandimuwulidde otya? Wandyegambye nti, ‘Aa, kaakano nfunye omukisa okunakuwaza Charley?

Nja kumuggyako ebimusanyusa byonna, era nja kujjuza obulamu bwe buli kintu ekizibu era ekitali kisanyusa kye nnaasobola okufuna. Nja kumuwaliriza okukola ebintu ebisinga obuzibu. Oluvannyuma, nja kumuwa ebiragiro ebya buli ngeri ebitasoboka.” “Nedda, nedda, nedda!” maama bwe yaleekaana ng’anyiize. “Omanyi nti sandikikoze. Nnandimuwambaatidde ku mutima gwange ne mmunywegera nnyo. Nnandijjuzza obulamu bwe ebintu ebisinga obuwoomi n’obulungi.” “Era ggwe osinga Katonda okuba ow’ekisa n’okwagala?” mukwano gwe bwe yamubuuza. “Aa, nedda,” bwe yaddamu. “Ndabye ensobi yange. Sijja kutya kugamba nti ‘By’oyagala bikolebwe,’ eri Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, nga bwe saagala Charley wange okutya okukingamba.”

Ebyo Katonda waffe by’ayagala, ebisaanira okusinzibwa, bisinga obulungi n’obuwoomi obulamu obulungi, oba mikwano, oba ssente, oba ettutumu, oba okuwummula, oba okugaggawala. Bimulisa essaawa ez’ekizikiza n’ekitiibwa eky’obwakatonda. Biyiwa omusana ogwakaayakana ku makubo agasinga okuba ag’ekizikiza. Oyo abifudde obwakabaka bwe afuga bulijjo; era tewali kiyinza kumugendera bubi. Enkizo ey’ekitiibwa ekuggukira. Eddaala erisooka okuyingira mu bulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda kwe kwewaayo okujjuvu. Saagala okitunuulire ng’ekiragiro ekizibu era eky’obukambwe. Olina okukikola n’essanyu, n’okusiima, n’omwoyo ogujjudde. Olina okuyingira mu kye mpita oludda lw’enkizo olw’okwewaayo. Nkukakasa, okuva mu bumanyirivu obw’omukisa, nti kye kifo ekisinga essanyu ky’olisanga.

Okukkiriza kye kintu ekiddako. Okukkiriza kwetaagisa nnyo okufuna ekirabo kyonna. Mikwano gyaffe giyinza okutuwa ekintu mu bujjuvu bwakyo, naye tekiba kyaffe okutuusa nga tukkirizza nti bakituwadde ne tukyetwalira. Kino kisinga nnyo okuba ekituufu ku birabo eby’omu birowoozo oba eby’omwoyo byokka. Omuntu omulala ayinza okutwagala awatali kkomo. Naye, okutuusa nga tukikkirizza, tekifuuka kyaffe. Ndowooza Abakristaayo abasinga bakimanyi kino ku kusonyiyibwa kwabwe.

Bamanyi nti okubuulira ku Yesu okusonyiwa ebibi kwandigenze mu maaso emirembe gyonna, naye okusonyiyibwa okwo tekwandibadde kwabwe okutuusa nga bakwetwalidde. Baalina okusooka okukukkiriza. Naye, mu kubeera mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo, kino bakyerabira. Balowooza nti, oluvannyuma lw’okulokolebwa olw’okukkiriza, kaakano balina okubeera mu bulamu olw’ebikolwa. Mu kifo ky’okweyongera okufuna, kaakano balina okutandika okukola. Kino kifuula ekigambo kyaffe nti obulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda buyingirwamu lwa kukkiriza okulabika ng’ekitategeerekeka ddala gye bali.

Kyokka kirangiriddwa lwatu nti “Nga bwe mwaweebwa Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe, mutambulirenga mu ye.” Twamufuna lwa kukkiriza, era lwa kukkiriza kwokka; bwe tutyo bwe tulina okutambulira mu ye lwa kukkiriza, era lwa kukkiriza kwokka. Okukkiriza kwaffe mu bulamu buno obukwekeddwa kwe kumu n’okukkiriza okwatuggya mu bwakabaka bw’ekizikiza ne kututwala eri Omwana wa Katonda. Kwesigama bwesigami ku kintu kirala. Edda twakkiriza nti Yesu ye Mulokozi waffe okuva mu musango gw’ekibi. Okukkiriza kwaffe ne kukifuula bwe kityo. Kaakano, tulina okukkiriza nti ye Mulokozi waffe okuva mu maanyi g’ekibi. Okukkiriza kwaffe kujja kukifuula bwe kityo. Twamwesiga olw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, ne bufuuka bwaffe. Kaakano, tulina okumwesiga olw’okutukuzibwa kwaffe, era nakwo kujja kuba kwaffe. Edda twamutwala ng’Omulokozi atulokola mu biseera eby’omu maaso okuva mu bibonerezo by’ebibi byaffe. Kaakano, tulina okumutwala ng’Omulokozi atulokola mu kiseera kino okuva mu buddu bw’ebibi byaffe.

Edda yali Mununuzi waffe, kaakano agenda kuba Bulamu bwaffe. Edda yatuggya mu kinnya. Kaakano, agenda kututuuza mu bifo eby’omu ggulu wamu naye. Kino nkyogera nga nsinziira ku bujulizi obw’obumanyirivu era obw’omu nkola.

Mmanyi, mu by’enjigiriza n’amateeka, nti buli mukkiriza aweebwa byonna mu kukyuka kwe. Naye mu bumanyirivu, tewali kintu kibeera kikye okutuusa lw’akyetwalira mu kukkiriza. “Nga bwe nasuubiza Musa, buli we munaalinnyanga ekigere, mbawaddewo.” Yoswa 1:3. “Yeebazibwe Katonda era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, atuwadde mu Kristo buli mukisa gwonna ogw’omwoyo oguva mu ggulu,” Abaefeso 1:3. Naye, okutuusa nga tubikkiriza, si byaffe. “olw’okukkiriza kwammwe,” bulijjo kye kkomo era lye tteeka.

Naye okukkiriza kuno kwe njogerako kuteekwa okuba okukkiriza okwa kaakano. Tewali kukkiriza abantu kwe bakozesa mu biseera eby’omu maaso okugasa ekintu kyonna. Omuntu ayinza okukkiriza emirembe gyonna nti mu kiseera ekimu eky’omu maaso ebibi bye birisonyiyibwa, naye talifuna mirembe. Ateekwa okutuuka ku kukkiriza okwa kaakano, n’agamba mu kukkiriza nti, “Ebibi byange bisonyiyiddwa kaakano,” nga tannasobola kubeera mu bulamu obuggya. Era, tewali kukkiriza okunoonya okununulibwa mu kibi mu biseera eby’omu maaso okuyinza okuyingiza emmeeme mu bulamu bwe tunnyonnyola. Omulabe asanyukira okukkiriza kuno okw’omu maaso. Amanyi nti tekulina maanyi kutuukiriza kintu kyonna.

Naye akankana n’adduka omukkiriza bw’agamba nti wa ddembe okuva mu buyinza bwe. Mu bufunze: okuyingira mu bulamu buno obw’omukisa obw’okuwummula n’obuwanguzi, olina okutambula amadaala abiri. Erisooka, weewaayo ddala mu byonna.

Ery’okubiri, beera n’okukkiriza okujjuvu.

Ebizibu byo ka bibe bitya, amadaala gano abiri gajja kukuyamba. Bw’onoogatambula, n’oganywererako, gajja kukutuusa mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obusingako obulungi. Kino oyinza okukikakasa. Bw’onooteeka ebirala byonna ku bbali, n’ossa omwoyo ku nsonga zino zombi, ojja kweyongerayo mangu. Ojja kutuuka ku mwalo emmeeme yo gw’eyagala amangu okusinga bw’olowooza kaakano nti kiyinzika.

Nnina okuddamu amadaala gano, waleme okubaawo nsobi? Oli mwana wa Katonda, era oyagala nnyo okumusanyusa.

Oyagala Omulokozi wo ow’omuwendo, era wetamiddwa era okooye ekibi ekimunakuwaza. Weegomba omuntu yenna okukununula mu buyinza bwakyo. Byonna by’ogezezzaako bilemye. Mu kuggwaamu essuubi, kaakano weebuuza oba, ng’abantu bano abasanyufu bwe bagamba, Mukama ayinza era ajja kukulokola. Omanyi mu mmeeme yo nti asobola. Okukulokola mu balabe bo bonna kye kigendererwa kye.

Kale mwesige. Mukwase ensonga yo. Leka byonna era kkiriza nti agitwala. Ng’omanyi bw’ali n’ebyo bye yayogera, weetwalire nti akuwa obulokozi obujjuvu kaakano. Ku ntandikwa, wakkiriza nti yakununula mu musango gw’ekibi kubanga yagamba bw’atyo. Kaakano, kkiriza nti akununula mu buyinza bw’ekibi kubanga agamba bw’atyo. Okukkiriza kwo kaakano kwekwate amaanyi amaggya mu Kristo. Wamwesiga ng’Omulokozi wo eyafa, kaakano mwesige ng’Omulokozi wo omulamu. Nga bwe yajja okukununula mu kibonerezo eky’omu maaso, bw’atyo era yajja okukununula mu buddu obwa kaakano. Nga bwe yajja okwetikka ebibi byo ku lulwo, azze okubeeza obulamu bwe mu ggwe.

Mu nsonga zombi tolina maanyi n’akatono. Okweggyako ebibi byo kyandikwetaagisizza amaanyi ge gamu ago, nga bwe kyandikwetaagisa kaakano okutuuka ku butuukirivu obw’omu nkola. Kristo, era Kristo yekka, y’ateekwa okukukolera byombi.

Omugabo gwo kwe kumukwasa ensonga eyo, oluvannyuma n’okkiriza nti agikola.

Omukyala omu kaakano amanyiddwa ennyo, bwe yali mu kizikiza ekinene, yanoonya okuyingira. N’agamba mukwano gwe eyali agezaako okumuyamba nti, “Mwenna mugamba nti, ‘Weerekere, era weesige.’ Naye simanyi bwe kikolebwa.” Nandyagadde okikole mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka, ndabe bw’okikola.” Nnina okukikola mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka ku lulwo?

“Mukama Yesu, oyinza era ojja kunnunula mu byonna ebinneeraliikiriza n’ebizibu by’obulamu bwange obw’Ekikristaayo. Wafa okunfuula ow’eddembe, si mu biseera eby’omu maaso, wabula kaakano era wano.” oli wa maanyi okusinga Setaani. Oyinza okunkuuma, ne mu bunafu bwange, obutagwa mu mitego gye wadde okumugondera. Era, Mukama, nja kukwesiga okunkuuma. Ngezezzaako okwefuga, era ndemereddwa, ne nfuna okusubwa okw’amaanyi. Siriiko kye nsobola n’akatono; n’olwekyo, nja kukwesiga kaakano. Nja kukwewaayo gy’oli; siriiko kye nsigaza. Omubiri, emmeeme, n’omwoyo, nkwewaayo, ekibumba ky’ebbumba ekitaliiko mugaso. Nfuula kyonna okwagala kwo n’amagezi go kye bisalawo. Era kaakano, ndi wuwo.

Okkiriza kye nkuwa. Amaanyi go gatutte omutima gwange omunafu era omusirusiru. Otandise okukola mu nze okwagala n’okukola by’osiima. Nkwesiga ddala, era nkwesiga kaakano! Otya okutambula eddaala lino? Kirabika nga kya mangu nnyo, nga kubuuka mu kizikiza? Tomanyi nti amadaala g’okukkiriza bulijjo “gagwa ku bbanga erirabika ng’eritaliimu kantu, naye ne gasanga olwazi wansi”? Omusajja eyali alina okukka mu luzzi ng’akozesa omuguwa, yazuula, n’atya nnyo, bwe yali amaze okukka wansi nnyo, nti omuguwa gwali mumpi. Yali atuuse ku nkomerero yaagwo, naye nga, okusinziira ku kubalirira kwe, akyali nga fuuti amakumi asatu okuva ku ntobo y’oluzzi. Teyamanya kya kukola. Yali talina maanyi wadde obukugu okulinnya omuguwa, era okuta omuguwa kwandimumenyaamenya ebitundutundu.

Emikono gye ne gitandika okuggwaamu amaanyi. N’asalawo okuta omuguwa n’asisinkana ekyali kimulindiridde. N’akkiriza nti agenda kuzikirira, n’alekera ddala omuguwa. N’agwa! Okutuuka ku ntobo y’oluzzi kyali — yinsi ssatu! Bw’oba ng’ebigere byo bigenda kukwata ku “lwazi wansi,” olina okuta buli kye wekwatako n’ogwa mu Katonda. Kubanga tewali kkubo lirala.

Era okukikola kaakano kuyinza okukuwonya emyezi n’emyaka egy’okufuba n’okukoowa. Mu bigo byonna eby’edda mu Bungereza mwabangamu ekifo ekiyitibwa ekyekuumiro. Kye kyali ekifo ky’ekigo ekisinga amaanyi era ekisinga okukuumibwa. Kyakwekangamu abanafu n’abatalina bwe bayinza mu biseera eby’akabi. Singa wali mukazi atya era atalina bw’ayinza mu kigo ekizingiziddwa, wandigumye okwekweka eyo?

Wandityeko okukikola? Tulina okutya okwekweka mu maanyi ag’okukuuma ag’Omukuumi waffe ow’Obwakatonda?

Tabongoota so teyeebaka. Yasuubiza okukuuma amagenda gaffe n’amadda gaffe, kaakano n’emirembe gyonna.
