Oyo abifudde obwakabaka bwe afuga bulijjo; era tewali kiyinza kumugendera bubi. Enkizo ey’ekitiibwa ekuggukira. Eddaala erisooka okuyingira mu bulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda kwe kwewaayo okujjuvu. Saagala okitunuulire ng’ekiragiro ekizibu era eky’obukambwe. Olina okukikola n’essanyu, n’okusiima, n’omwoyo ogujjudde. Olina okuyingira mu kye mpita oludda lw’enkizo olw’okwewaayo. Nkukakasa, okuva mu bumanyirivu obw’omukisa, nti kye kifo ekisinga essanyu ky’olisanga. Okukkiriza kye kintu ekiddako. Okukkiriza kwetaagisa nnyo okufuna ekirabo kyonna. Mikwano gyaffe giyinza okutuwa ekintu mu bujjuvu bwakyo, naye tekiba kyaffe okutuusa nga tukkirizza nti bakituwadde ne tukyetwalira. Kino kisinga nnyo okuba ekituufu ku birabo eby’omu birowoozo oba eby’omwoyo byokka. Omuntu omulala ayinza okutwagala awatali kkomo. Naye, okutuusa nga tukikkirizza, tekifuuka kyaffe. Ndowooza Abakristaayo abasinga bakimanyi kino ku kusonyiyibwa kwabwe. Bamanyi nti okubuulira ku Yesu okusonyiwa ebibi kwandigenze mu maaso emirembe gyonna, naye okusonyiyibwa okwo tekwandibadde kwabwe okutuusa nga bakwetwalidde. Baalina okusooka okukukkiriza. Naye, mu kubeera mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo, kino bakyerabira. Balowooza nti, oluvannyuma lw’okulokolebwa olw’okukkiriza, kaakano balina okubeera mu bulamu olw’ebikolwa. Mu kifo ky’okweyongera okufuna, kaakano balina okutandika okukola. Kino kifuula ekigambo kyaffe nti obulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda buyingirwamu lwa kukkiriza okulabika ng’ekitategeerekeka ddala gye bali. Kyokka kirangiriddwa lwatu nti “Nga bwe mwaweebwa Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe, mutambulirenga mu ye.” Twamufuna lwa kukkiriza, era lwa kukkiriza kwokka; bwe tutyo bwe tulina okutambulira mu ye lwa kukkiriza, era lwa kukkiriza kwokka. Okukkiriza kwaffe mu bulamu buno obukwekeddwa kwe kumu n’okukkiriza okwatuggya mu bwakabaka bw’ekizikiza ne kututwala eri Omwana wa Katonda. Kwesigama bwesigami ku kintu kirala. Edda twakkiriza nti Yesu ye Mulokozi waffe okuva mu musango gw’ekibi. Okukkiriza kwaffe ne kukifuula bwe kityo. Kaakano, tulina okukkiriza nti ye Mulokozi waffe okuva mu maanyi g’ekibi. Okukkiriza kwaffe kujja kukifuula bwe kityo. Twamwesiga olw’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, ne bufuuka bwaffe. Kaakano, tulina okumwesiga olw’okutukuzibwa kwaffe, era nakwo kujja kuba kwaffe. Edda twamutwala ng’Omulokozi atulokola mu biseera eby’omu maaso okuva mu bibonerezo by’ebibi byaffe. Kaakano, tulina okumutwala ng’Omulokozi atulokola mu kiseera kino okuva mu buddu bw’ebibi byaffe. Edda yali Mununuzi waffe, kaakano agenda kuba Bulamu bwaffe. Edda yatuggya mu kinnya. Kaakano, agenda kututuuza mu bifo eby’omu ggulu wamu naye. Kino nkyogera nga nsinziira ku bujulizi obw’obumanyirivu era obw’omu nkola. Mmanyi, mu by’enjigiriza n’amateeka, nti buli mukkiriza aweebwa byonna mu kukyuka kwe. Naye mu bumanyirivu, tewali kintu kibeera kikye okutuusa lw’akyetwalira mu kukkiriza. “Nga bwe nasuubiza Musa, buli we munaalinnyanga ekigere, mbawaddewo.” Yoswa 1:3. “Yeebazibwe Katonda era Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, atuwadde mu Kristo buli mukisa gwonna ogw’omwoyo oguva mu ggulu,” Abaefeso 1:3. Naye, okutuusa nga tubikkiriza, si byaffe. “olw’okukkiriza kwammwe,” bulijjo kye kkomo era lye tteeka. Naye okukkiriza kuno kwe njogerako kuteekwa okuba okukkiriza okwa kaakano. Tewali kukkiriza abantu kwe bakozesa mu biseera eby’omu maaso okugasa ekintu kyonna. Omuntu ayinza okukkiriza emirembe gyonna nti mu kiseera ekimu eky’omu maaso ebibi bye birisonyiyibwa, naye talifuna mirembe. Ateekwa okutuuka ku kukkiriza okwa kaakano, n’agamba mu kukkiriza nti, “Ebibi byange bisonyiyiddwa kaakano,” nga tannasobola kubeera mu bulamu obuggya. Era, tewali kukkiriza okunoonya okununulibwa mu kibi mu biseera eby’omu maaso okuyinza okuyingiza emmeeme mu bulamu bwe tunnyonnyola. Omulabe asanyukira okukkiriza kuno okw’omu maaso. Amanyi nti tekulina maanyi kutuukiriza kintu kyonna. Naye akankana n’adduka omukkiriza bw’agamba nti wa ddembe okuva mu buyinza bwe. Mu bufunze: okuyingira mu bulamu buno obw’omukisa obw’okuwummula n’obuwanguzi, olina okutambula amadaala abiri. Erisooka, weewaayo ddala mu byonna. Ery’okubiri, beera n’okukkiriza okujjuvu. Ebizibu byo ka bibe bitya, amadaala gano abiri gajja kukuyamba. Bw’onoogatambula, n’oganywererako, gajja kukutuusa mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obusingako obulungi. Kino oyinza okukikakasa. Bw’onooteeka ebirala byonna ku bbali, n’ossa omwoyo ku nsonga zino zombi, ojja kweyongerayo mangu. Ojja kutuuka ku mwalo emmeeme yo gw’eyagala amangu okusinga bw’olowooza kaakano nti kiyinzika. Nnina okuddamu amadaala gano, waleme okubaawo nsobi? Oli mwana wa Katonda, era oyagala nnyo okumusanyusa. Oyagala Omulokozi wo ow’omuwendo, era wetamiddwa era okooye ekibi ekimunakuwaza. Weegomba omuntu yenna okukununula mu buyinza bwakyo. Byonna by’ogezezzaako bilemye. Mu kuggwaamu essuubi, kaakano weebuuza oba, ng’abantu bano abasanyufu bwe bagamba, Mukama ayinza era ajja kukulokola. Omanyi mu mmeeme yo nti asobola. Okukulokola mu balabe bo bonna kye kigendererwa kye. Kale mwesige. Mukwase ensonga yo. Leka byonna era kkiriza nti agitwala. Ng’omanyi bw’ali n’ebyo bye yayogera, weetwalire nti akuwa obulokozi obujjuvu kaakano. Ku ntandikwa, wakkiriza nti yakununula mu musango gw’ekibi kubanga yagamba bw’atyo. Kaakano, kkiriza nti akununula mu buyinza bw’ekibi kubanga agamba bw’atyo. Okukkiriza kwo kaakano kwekwate amaanyi amaggya mu Kristo. Wamwesiga ng’Omulokozi wo eyafa, kaakano mwesige ng’Omulokozi wo omulamu. Nga bwe yajja okukununula mu kibonerezo eky’omu maaso, bw’atyo era yajja okukununula mu buddu obwa kaakano. Nga bwe yajja okwetikka ebibi byo ku lulwo, azze okubeeza obulamu bwe mu ggwe. Mu nsonga zombi tolina maanyi n’akatono. Okweggyako ebibi byo kyandikwetaagisizza amaanyi ge gamu ago, nga bwe kyandikwetaagisa kaakano okutuuka ku butuukirivu obw’omu nkola. Kristo, era Kristo yekka, y’ateekwa okukukolera byombi. Omugabo gwo kwe kumukwasa ensonga eyo, oluvannyuma n’okkiriza nti agikola. Omukyala omu kaakano amanyiddwa ennyo, bwe yali mu kizikiza ekinene, yanoonya okuyingira. N’agamba mukwano gwe eyali agezaako okumuyamba nti, “Mwenna mugamba nti, ‘Weerekere, era weesige.’ Naye simanyi bwe kikolebwa.” Nandyagadde okikole mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka, ndabe bw’okikola.” Nnina okukikola mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka ku lulwo? “Mukama Yesu, oyinza era ojja kunnunula mu byonna ebinneeraliikiriza n’ebizibu by’obulamu bwange obw’Ekikristaayo. Wafa okunfuula ow’eddembe, si mu biseera eby’omu maaso, wabula kaakano era wano.” oli wa maanyi okusinga Setaani. Oyinza okunkuuma, ne mu bunafu bwange, obutagwa mu mitego gye wadde okumugondera. Era, Mukama, nja kukwesiga okunkuuma. Ngezezzaako okwefuga, era ndemereddwa, ne nfuna okusubwa okw’amaanyi. Siriiko kye nsobola n’akatono; n’olwekyo, nja kukwesiga kaakano. Nja kukwewaayo gy’oli; siriiko kye nsigaza. Omubiri, emmeeme, n’omwoyo, nkwewaayo, ekibumba ky’ebbumba ekitaliiko mugaso. Nfuula kyonna okwagala kwo n’amagezi go kye bisalawo. Era kaakano, ndi wuwo. Okkiriza kye nkuwa. Amaanyi go gatutte omutima gwange omunafu era omusirusiru. Otandise okukola mu nze okwagala n’okukola by’osiima. Nkwesiga ddala, era nkwesiga kaakano! Otya okutambula eddaala lino? Kirabika nga kya mangu nnyo, nga kubuuka mu kizikiza? Tomanyi nti amadaala g’okukkiriza bulijjo “gagwa ku bbanga erirabika ng’eritaliimu kantu, naye ne gasanga olwazi wansi”? Omusajja eyali alina okukka mu luzzi ng’akozesa omuguwa, yazuula, n’atya nnyo, bwe yali amaze okukka wansi nnyo, nti omuguwa gwali mumpi. Yali atuuse ku nkomerero yaagwo, naye nga, okusinziira ku kubalirira kwe, akyali nga fuuti amakumi asatu okuva ku ntobo y’oluzzi. Teyamanya kya kukola. Yali talina maanyi wadde obukugu okulinnya omuguwa, era okuta omuguwa kwandimumenyaamenya ebitundutundu. Emikono gye ne gitandika okuggwaamu amaanyi. N’asalawo okuta omuguwa n’asisinkana ekyali kimulindiridde. N’akkiriza nti agenda kuzikirira, n’alekera ddala omuguwa. N’agwa! Okutuuka ku ntobo y’oluzzi kyali — yinsi ssatu! Bw’oba ng’ebigere byo bigenda kukwata ku “lwazi wansi,” olina okuta buli kye wekwatako n’ogwa mu Katonda. Kubanga tewali kkubo lirala. Era okukikola kaakano kuyinza okukuwonya emyezi n’emyaka egy’okufuba n’okukoowa. Mu bigo byonna eby’edda mu Bungereza mwabangamu ekifo ekiyitibwa ekyekuumiro. Kye kyali ekifo ky’ekigo ekisinga amaanyi era ekisinga okukuumibwa. Kyakwekangamu abanafu n’abatalina bwe bayinza mu biseera eby’akabi. Singa wali mukazi atya era atalina bw’ayinza mu kigo ekizingiziddwa, wandigumye okwekweka eyo? Wandityeko okukikola? Tulina okutya okwekweka mu maanyi ag’okukuuma ag’Omukuumi waffe ow’Obwakatonda? Tabongoota so teyeebaka. Yasuubiza okukuuma amagenda gaffe n’amadda gaffe, kaakano n’emirembe gyonna.

fields.title: Ebizibu ku Kwewaayo
fields.body_html:
Abakristaayo basaanidde okumanya enkwe z’omulabe. Aziyiza buli ddaala omwoyo ly’atambula nga gukula. Naddala akola nnyo bw’alaba omukkiriza ng’azuukusiddwa okuyaayaanira obutuukirivu — abakkiriza ng’abo baagala okufuna obujjuvu bwonna obuli mu Mukama Yesu Kristo. Ekimu ku bizibu ebisooka by’abateeka mu kkubo kikwata ku kwewaayo. Oyo anoonya obutukuvu ayigirizibwa okwewaayo. Agezaako okukikola. Naye amangu ddala n’asanga ekizibu. Alowooza nti akikoze. Kyokka tawulira njawulo yonna.

Tewali kirabika nga kikyuse nga bwe yali asuubira. Asoberwa, era ng’aggwaamu essuubi n’abuuza nti, “Nnaamanya ntya nti nneewaddeyo?”

Wano, okukemebwa okusinga obukulu kwe kw’enneewulira. Bulijjo kufuba okwekulembeza, era emirundi mingi kutuuka ku kye kwagala.

Omwoyo tegusobola kukkiriza nti gwewaddeyo okutuusa nga gwewulidde nga gwewaddeyo. Tegusobola kukkiriza nti Katonda agututte, kubanga tegukiwulira. Nga bulijjo, gusoosa enneewulira, okukkiriza ne kuddirira. Naye etteeka lya Katonda lyangu: mu buli kintu okukkiriza kusooka, enneewulira ne ziddirira. Okugezaako okukyusa kino tekirina mugaso.

Okusobola okuziyiza okukemebwa kuno ku nsonga y’okwewaayo, beera ku ludda lwa Katonda. Kulembeza okukkiriza okusinga enneewulira. Weewaayo eri Mukama mu bujjuvu, awatali kwesigaliza kintu. Kozesa okutegeera kw’olina kaakano. Saba Omwoyo Omutukuvu akubikkulire buli kintu kyonna mu mutima gwo oba mu bulamu bwo ekikontana ne Katonda. Bw’akulaga ekintu kyonna, kiwe Mukama amangu ddala, era ogambe ku kyo nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe.” Bw’atakulaga kintu, olwo olina okukkiriza nti tewali kintu, era otegeere nti omuwadde byonna. Oluvannyuma olina okukkiriza nti akutwala. Tolindirira kuwulira nti weewaddeyo oba nti akututte. Kkiriza bukkiriza, era okibale nga bwe kiri.

Singa obadde wa kuwa mukwano gwo ettaka, wandibadde olina okulimuwa, ye n’alikkiriza olw’okukkiriza. Tewali asobola kukwasa munne ttaka mu ngalo. Okuliwaayo n’okulikkiriza kiba kikolwa kya mu birowoozo, bwe kityo nsonga ya kukkiriza. Singa owa mukwano gwo ettaka olunaku olumu, oyinza okwebuuza oba ddala walimuwadde, era oba yalitwala. Olwo oyinza okuwulira nga weetaaga okuddamu okumuwa ku lunaku olwaddirira. Ku lunaku olwokusatu, bw’oba ng’okyabuusabuusa, wandiddamu nate okulimuwa. Wandikoze bw’otyo buli lunaku okumala emyezi oba emyaka.

Mukwano gwo yandirowoozezza ki? Era ebirowoozo byo byandibadde bitya oluvannyuma lw’ebyo byonna?

Mukwano gwo yandibuusabuusizza oba ddala wali oyagala okumuwa. Ggwe wandibadde otabuddwatabuddwa nga tomanyi oba ettaka lyali lyo, lirye, oba lya muntu mulala. Kale, si bw’otyo bw’okoze eri Katonda ku nsonga eno ey’okwewaayo? Omaze emyezi ng’omwewa buli lunaku. Naye buli mulundi, weebuuza oba ddala wamwewa, era oba yakusembeza. Olw’okuba tewawulira njawulo, oluvannyuma lw’okubuusabuusa okungi, wasalawo nti tekyakolebwa.

Omukkiriza omwagalwa, okutabulwa kuno kujja kubeerawo emirembe gyonna okuggyako ng’okumalawo n’okukkiriza. Olina okutwala ensonga eno nti ewedde. Olwo lwokka lw’oyinza okusuubira enneewulira yo okukyuka. Etteeka ly’ebiweebwayo eri Mukama likakasa nti buli ekimuweebwa kifuuka kitukuvu. Kyawulibwa, era tekiyinza kukozesebwa mu kigendererwa kirala kyonna. Okukikola bw’otyo kyandibadde kunyooma.

“buli kintu ekiwongere ddala mu ngeri eyo kinaabanga kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda.” Ekiwongere kiyinza okuba, “oba muntu oba kisolo”; “tewaabengawo ku bintu ebyo bitundibwa oba okununulibwa.”

Abayisirayiri bwe baamalanga okuwaayo ekiwongere eri Mukama, baakibalanga nga kya Mukama. Tewali yagumanga kukiddizaawo. Oyo eyawangayo ayinza okuba nga yawaayo ekirabo kye nga takyagala nnyo era nga talina bunyiikivu. Naye bwe yamalanga okuwaayo, ensonga n’eva mu mikono gye. Olw’etteeka lya Katonda yennyini, ekirabo kyafuukanga “kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda.”

Si kigendererwa ky’oyo eyawaayo ekyakifuulanga ekitukuvu, wabula obutukuvu bw’Oyo eyakiweebwa. Kubanga kye “ekyoto kyennyini ekifuula ekirabo ekyo okuba ekitukuvu.” Era ekiweebwayo bwe kyamalanga okuteekebwa ku kyoto, okuva mu kaseera ako kyabanga kya Mukama.

Nsobola okulowooza ku muntu eyali amaze okuwaayo ekirabo. Oluvannyuma ayinza okubuusabuusa oba yakiwaayo n’omutima ogw’amazima era mu bwesimbu. Yandiddayo eri kabona, ng’atawaanyizibwa olw’obwesimbu bwe. Nkakasa nti kabona yandimusirisizza amangu ddala. Yandimugambye nti, “Simanyi kigendererwa kyo mu kuwaayo ekiweebwayo kyo.”

Ekikakafu kiri nti wakiwaayo, era nti kya Mukama, kubanga buli ekiwongere kitukuvu nnyo gy’ali. “Kaakano kikeereye okukiddizaawo.” Si kabona yekka, naye Isirayiri yonna yandyewuunyizza omuntu, ng’amaze okuwaayo ekirabo kye, n’agezaako okukiddizaawo. Kyokka buli lunaku, Abakristaayo abanyiikivu, abandikankanye olw’obunyoomi bw’Omuyudaaya ng’oyo, bakola ekikolwa ekifaanana bwe kityo. Beewaayo eri Mukama, ate ne beddiza olw’obutakkiriza. Olw’okuba Katonda talabika na maaso, kizibu okuwulira nti kye tukola naye kya ddala.

Singa bwe twewaayo twali tusobola okumulaba, kyandiwulise nga kya ddala. Twandimanye nti tuwadde ekigambo kyaffe era nti tetuyinza kukiddizaawo, ne bwe twandyagadde kyenkana ki. Kyandibadde gye tuli n’amaanyi ag’okusiba ng’ekisuubizo ekyogeddwa eri mukwano gwaffe ow’oku nsi. Eri omuntu ow’ekitiibwa, ekisuubizo ng’ekyo bulijjo kirina amaanyi ago.

Twetaaga okulaba nti okubeerawo kwa Katonda bulijjo kintu kya ddala ekikakafu. Buli kikolwa ky’omwoyo gwaffe kikolebwa mu maaso ge ddala. Ekigambo kye twogera mu kusaba kiba kyogeddwa gy’ali ddala, nga bwe kyandibadde singa amaaso gaffe gamulaba n’emikono gyaffe ne gimukwatako.

Olwo tetujja kuddamu kubeera na ndowooza za kibuuzibuuzi ku nkolagana yaffe naye. Tujja kuwulira obuzito bwa buli kigambo kye twogera mu maaso ge. Mmanyi nti abamu bajja kugamba nti, “Aa, weewaawo. Naye singa yali ayogera nange n’aŋŋamba nti yantwala bwe nneewaayo gy’ali, olwo nandikikkirizza.”

Nedda, mazima tewandikikkirizza. Kubanga emirundi mingi tayogera kino okutuusa ng’omwoyo gusoose okulaga obwesigwa bwagwo nga gukkiriza ky’amaze okwogera. Oyo akkiriza y’alina obujulirwa, so si oyo abuusabuusa. Era mu kiragiro kye kyennyini gye tuli eky’okwewaayo gy’ali nga ssaddaaka ennamu, yeetadde mu buvunaanyizibwa okutusembeza.

Siyinza kulowooza ku muntu ow’ekitiibwa ng’asaba munne okumuwa ekintu ky’abuusabuusa okutwala. N’okusingawo, siyinza kulowooza ku muzadde ow’okwagala ng’akola bw’atyo eri omwana we omwagalwa. “Mwana wange mpa omutima gwo, n’amaaso go geekalirize amakubo gange.” Engero 23:26. Kino kikakasa ekitaliimu kubuusabuusa. Kitegeeza nti mu kaseera omutima lwe guweebwayo, gutwalibwa Oyo eyalagira guweebweyo. Kale tulina okubeera n’obwesige obusingirayo ddala. Bwe twewaayo eri Mukama nga bw’alagira, olwo atusembeza. Okuva mu kaseera ako, tuli babe.

Waliwo endagaano ya ddala ekoleddwa. Tesobola kumenyebwa nga ffe tetwetiisizza buswavu. Tumanyi nti ye tagenda kugimenya. Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 26:17-19 kiraga engeri Katonda gy’akolamu: “Ku lunaku lwa leero oyatudde nga Mukama bw’ali Katonda wo, era nga naawe bw’onootambuliranga mu makubo ge, era ng’onookuumanga ebiragiro bye n’amateeka ge gonna, era ng’onoomugonderanga. Ku lunaku lwa leero Mukama alangiridde nga bw’oli owuwe, eggwanga lye ku bubwe ery’omuwendo omungi nga bwe yasuubiza, era nga ojjanga kukwatanga ebiragiro bye byonna. Alangiridde nga bw’anaakujjuzanga ettendo n’okwatiikirira n’ekitiibwa okusukkirira amawanga gonna ge yatonda, era ng’olibeera eggwanga ettukuvu eri Mukama Katonda wo, nga bwe yasuubiza.”

Twatula nti Mukama ye Katonda waffe. Tujja kutambulira mu makubo ge era tukwate ebiragiro bye. Ye alangirira nti tuli babe, era tulina okukwata ebiragiro bye byonna. Era okuva mu kaseera ako, atufuula babe. Eno ye yali enkola ye bulijjo, era bw’ekyali. “buli kintu ekiwongere ddala mu ngeri eyo kinaabanga kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda.” Kino kyeyoleka bulungi nnyo nti tekirina kubuusibwabuusibwa. Naye bw’oba ng’okyabuusabuusa, ka nkulage ekigambo ekiri mu Ndagaano Empya. Kitunuulira ensonga eno mu ngeri ndala, naye ndowooza nti kigimalirawo ddala. Kiri mu 1 Yokaana 5:14-15, era kigamba nti: “Noolwekyo tulina obuvumu nti bwe tugenda gy’ali ne tumusaba ekintu kyonna, ye nga bw’asiima atuwulira. Era bwe tutegeera nti atuwulira bwe tumusaba, buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa.”

Katonda ayagala weewaayo gy’ali mu bujjuvu? Tewali kyakuddamu kirala okuggyako kimu, kubanga yakiragira. Era si y’ayagala okukola mu ggwe okukwagazisa n’okukusobozesa okukola by’asiima? Ne kino kirina eky’okuddamu kimu kyokka, kubanga yalangirira nti kye kigendererwa kye. Kale omanyi nti ebintu bino biri nga bw’ayagala. N’olwekyo, olw’ekigambo kya Katonda, olina okumanya nti akuwulira. Kaakano olina okweyongerayo. Olina okumanya nti ofunye bye wamusaba.

Nti obifunye — nzogera — so si nti olibifuna, oba nti oyinza okubifuna, wabula nti obirina kaakano ddala mu mikono gyo. Bw’etyo ffe bwe tufuna ebisuubizo olw’okukkiriza, nga bali “be baafuna ebyasuubizibwa.” Bw’etyo bwe tugamba nti, “olw’okukkiriza mu Kristo tufunye ekisa kya Katonda” ekituweereddwa mu Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Era mu ngeri eno yokka mwe tumanyira nti n’emitima gyaffe ginaazibwa, nga Katonda bwe yakola ku balala: “bwe baamala okukkiriza, obulamu bwabwe n’abunaaza.”

Olwo tusobola okubeera abalamu, okuyimirira, n’okutambula olw’okukkiriza. Njagala okunnyonnyola ensonga eno mu ngeri etegeerekeka era ey’omugaso, waleme kubaawo n’omu agyetawaanyaamu nate. Kale, ka nziremu kye olina okukola mu mwoyo gwo okumalawo okubuusabuusa kwo ku kwewaayo.

Nsuubira nti weesiga Mukama Yesu okukusonyiwa ebibi byo. Nsuubira nti omanyi kye kitegeeza okubeera mu maka ga Katonda n’okubeera omusika wa Katonda olw’okukkiriza mu Kristo. Era kaakano owulira ng’ekyoyo kimeruka mu mwoyo gwo eky’okufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi kya Mukama wo. Olina okwewaayo gy’ali mu bujjuvu.

Olwo lwokka lw’ayinza okukola mu ggwe byonna by’asiima. Wagezaako okukikola, naye n’otobaamu buwanguzi. Kaakano njagala okukuyamba. Kaakano olina okuddamu okujja gy’ali. Weewaayo wenna eri by’ayagala, mu bujjuvu nga bw’osobola.

Olina okumusaba akulage, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we, obujeemu bwonna obukwese. Bw’atakubikkulira kintu, kkiriza nti tewali. Okwewaayo kwo kujjuvu. Kale tulina okutwala ensonga eno nti ewedde. Weewaddeyo eri Mukama. Okuva kaakano, tokyali wuwo. Towulirizanga kirowoozo kyonna ekikontana na kino. Bw’oneebuuzanga oba weewaddeyo mu bujjuvu, langirira nti weewaddeyo. Era tokikubaganyangako birowoozo n’akatono.

Kigobe buli kirowoozo ng’ekyo awatali kulonzalonza era n’okumalirira okunywevu.

Wakigenderera mu kiseera ekyo, okyakigenderera kaakano, era okituukirizza. Enneewulira zo ziyinza okuleekaanira okwewaayo kuno, naye okusalawo kwo kulina okunywera. Katonda atunuulira ekigendererwa kyo, so si by’owulira ku kyo. N’olwekyo, okusalawo kwo kye kyokka ky’olina okufaako. Bw’omala okwewaayo, tokubuusabuusanga era tokuddizangayo. Ekiddako, kkiriza nti Katonda atwala ebyo by’owaddeyo. Bibale nti bibye. Si nti biriba bibye mu kiseera eky’omu maaso, wabula nti bibye kaakano; era nti atandise okukola mu ggwe okukwagazisa n’okukusobozesa okukola by’asiima. Era wano olina okuwummulira. Tolina kirala kya kukola. Kaakano oli wa Mukama, oli mu mikono gye ddala. Yeetisse obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okukulabirira n’okukufuga. Ng’ekigambo kye bwe kigamba, ajja kukola mu ggwe, “atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo.”

Naye wano olina okunywerera ddala. Bw’obuusabuusa okwewaayo kwo, oba nti Katonda akukkirizza, okukkiriza kwo kujja kusagaasagana. Okukkiriza okusagaasagana kuleeta obulamu obutali bunywevu, era Katonda tasobola kukola. Naye bw’oba ng’okyesiga nti akola, omulimu gwe gukukyusa. Gukufuula okufaanana Kristo, okuva mu kitiibwa okutuuka mu kitiibwa, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we ow’amaanyi. Kaakano, mu kaseera kano ddala, weewaayo gy’ali mu bujjuvu? Oddamu nti weewaawo. Kale, mukwano gwange omwagalwa, bala nti oli wuwe. Akututte. Akola mu ggwe okukwagazisa n’okukusobozesa okukola by’asiima. Era weeyongere okukibala bw’otyo.

Kijja kukuyamba okussa ebirowoozo byo mu bigambo. Weegambe ggwe kennyini era ogambe ne Katonda nti, “Mukama, ndi wuwo. Nneewaayo gy’oli, era nzikiriza nti ontwala.” Nneerekera gy’oli. “Kola mu nze byonna by’osiima ng’okwagala kwo bwe kuli. Nja kugalamira bugalamizi mu mikono gyo, nkwesige.” Kino kifuule ekikolwa ky’okusalawo kwo buli lunaku.

Emirundi mingi buli lunaku, kiddeemu, kibeere embeera yo ey’olubeerera mu maaso ge. Kyeyatulire ggwe kennyini. Kyatule eri Katonda wo. Kyatule eri mikwano gyo. Bulijjo langirira nti Mukama ye Katonda wo. Weewaayo okutambulira mu makubo ge n’okukwata amateeka ge.

Olwo ojja kukizuula nti akulangiridde okuba omu ku bantu be ab’enjawulo. Olina okukwata ebiragiro bye byonna, obeere “eggwanga ettukuvu eri Mukama Katonda wo, nga bwe yasuubiza.”

Wano oyinza okusanga ng’amateeka matono amangu gakuyamba. Nkuwa amagezi okugakozesa mu kusaba kwo okwa buli lunaku. Galina okugezesa omwoyo okutuusa lwe tutegeera obulungi ensonga eno.

I. Yatula lwatu okukkiriza kwo mu Kristo ng’Omulokozi wo. Era yatula nti okkiriza nti akutabaganyizza ne Katonda, nga 2 Abakkolinso 5:18-19 bwe kigamba: “Ebintu byonna biva eri Katonda eyatukomyawo gy’ali nga tuyita mu Kristo, era ne tuweebwa obuweereza obw’okutabaganya. Kubanga Katonda yali mu Kristo, ng’atabagana n’abantu, nga tababalira, bibi byabwe, n’atuteresa ffe obubaka obw’okutabaganya.”

II. Yatula awatali kubuusabuusa nti Katonda ye Kitaffe. Oli mwana we gwe yanunula era gwe yasonyiwa, nga Abaggalatiya 4:5 bwe kigamba: yajja okununula abaali bafugibwa amateeka, “tulyoke tufuuke abaana.”

III. Weewaayo ddala eri Mukama, omubiri, emmeeme, n’omwoyo. Mugonderenga mu buli kintu ky’omanyi nti ky’ayagala, nga Abaruumi 12:12 bwe kigamba: “nga musanyukira mu kusuubira, nga mugumiikiriza mu kubonaabona era nga munyiikira mu kusaba.”

IV. Kkiriza, ne bwe kiba nga byonna bikontana, nti Katonda atwala ky’omukwasizza. Ajja kukola mu ggwe, okuggyako ng’olemesa ekisa kye. Laba 2 Abakkolinso 6:17-18: “Noolwekyo muve wakati mu bo, mubeeyawuleko, bw’ayogera Mukama. Temukwata ku bitali birongoofu, nange nnaabaaniriza. Era nnaabeeranga Kitammwe, nammwe ne mubeeranga batabani bange ne bawala bange, bw’ayogera Mukama Ayinzabyonna.” ne Abafiripi 2:13: “Kubanga Katonda yakolera mu mmwe, era yabaagazisa n’abasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, olw’okumusanyusa.”

V. Tokozesanga nneewulira zo okugezesa enkolagana yo ne Katonda. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, ssa omwoyo ku kusalawo kwo ne ku kukkiriza kwo.

Era emitendera gino gyonna gy’otambulira kaakano gitwale nga giwedde, newaakubadde omulabe ayinza okugifuula okulabika ng’egitali bwe gityo. Abaebbulaniya 10:22-23: “tusembere awali Katonda n’omwoyo ogw’amazima ogujjudde okukkiriza nga tulina emitima egitukuzibbwa okuva mu ndowooza embi, era nga n’emibiri gyaffe ginaazibbwa n’amazzi amatukuvu.

Kale tunyweze essuubi lye twatula nga tetusagaasagana, kubanga eyasuubiza mwesigwa.”

VI. Tobuusabuusanga, era toggwaamu maanyi, mu mbeera yonna. Jjukira nti okuggwaamu amaanyi kwonna kuva eri Setaani, era gaana okukukkiriza; nga Yokaana 14:1 bwe kigamba: “Omutima gwammwe tegweraliikiriranga. Mukkiriza Katonda, era nange munzikirize.” Olunyiriri 27: “Mbalekera emirembe, era mbawa emirembe gyange. Emirembe gye mbawa tegiringa egy’ensi. Noolwekyo temutyanga era temweraliikiriranga.”

VII. Kulaakulanya empisa ey’okwatula okukkiriza kwo mu bigambo ebitegeerekeka. Ddamunga emirundi mingi nti, “Ndi wa Mukama yenna.

Kaakano akola mu nze okunjagazisa n’okunsobozesa okukola by’asiima,” nga Abaebbulaniya 13:21 bwe kigamba: “abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe.

Amiina.”
fields.body_text: Abakristaayo basaanidde okumanya enkwe z’omulabe. Aziyiza buli ddaala omwoyo ly’atambula nga gukula. Naddala akola nnyo bw’alaba omukkiriza ng’azuukusiddwa okuyaayaanira obutuukirivu — abakkiriza ng’abo baagala okufuna obujjuvu bwonna obuli mu Mukama Yesu Kristo. Ekimu ku bizibu ebisooka by’abateeka mu kkubo kikwata ku kwewaayo. Oyo anoonya obutukuvu ayigirizibwa okwewaayo. Agezaako okukikola. Naye amangu ddala n’asanga ekizibu. Alowooza nti akikoze. Kyokka tawulira njawulo yonna. Tewali kirabika nga kikyuse nga bwe yali asuubira. Asoberwa, era ng’aggwaamu essuubi n’abuuza nti, “Nnaamanya ntya nti nneewaddeyo?” Wano, okukemebwa okusinga obukulu kwe kw’enneewulira. Bulijjo kufuba okwekulembeza, era emirundi mingi kutuuka ku kye kwagala. Omwoyo tegusobola kukkiriza nti gwewaddeyo okutuusa nga gwewulidde nga gwewaddeyo. Tegusobola kukkiriza nti Katonda agututte, kubanga tegukiwulira. Nga bulijjo, gusoosa enneewulira, okukkiriza ne kuddirira. Naye etteeka lya Katonda lyangu: mu buli kintu okukkiriza kusooka, enneewulira ne ziddirira. Okugezaako okukyusa kino tekirina mugaso. Okusobola okuziyiza okukemebwa kuno ku nsonga y’okwewaayo, beera ku ludda lwa Katonda. Kulembeza okukkiriza okusinga enneewulira. Weewaayo eri Mukama mu bujjuvu, awatali kwesigaliza kintu. Kozesa okutegeera kw’olina kaakano. Saba Omwoyo Omutukuvu akubikkulire buli kintu kyonna mu mutima gwo oba mu bulamu bwo ekikontana ne Katonda. Bw’akulaga ekintu kyonna, kiwe Mukama amangu ddala, era ogambe ku kyo nti, “By’oyagala bikolebwe.” Bw’atakulaga kintu, olwo olina okukkiriza nti tewali kintu, era otegeere nti omuwadde byonna. Oluvannyuma olina okukkiriza nti akutwala. Tolindirira kuwulira nti weewaddeyo oba nti akututte. Kkiriza bukkiriza, era okibale nga bwe kiri. Singa obadde wa kuwa mukwano gwo ettaka, wandibadde olina okulimuwa, ye n’alikkiriza olw’okukkiriza. Tewali asobola kukwasa munne ttaka mu ngalo. Okuliwaayo n’okulikkiriza kiba kikolwa kya mu birowoozo, bwe kityo nsonga ya kukkiriza. Singa owa mukwano gwo ettaka olunaku olumu, oyinza okwebuuza oba ddala walimuwadde, era oba yalitwala. Olwo oyinza okuwulira nga weetaaga okuddamu okumuwa ku lunaku olwaddirira. Ku lunaku olwokusatu, bw’oba ng’okyabuusabuusa, wandiddamu nate okulimuwa. Wandikoze bw’otyo buli lunaku okumala emyezi oba emyaka. Mukwano gwo yandirowoozezza ki? Era ebirowoozo byo byandibadde bitya oluvannyuma lw’ebyo byonna? Mukwano gwo yandibuusabuusizza oba ddala wali oyagala okumuwa. Ggwe wandibadde otabuddwatabuddwa nga tomanyi oba ettaka lyali lyo, lirye, oba lya muntu mulala. Kale, si bw’otyo bw’okoze eri Katonda ku nsonga eno ey’okwewaayo? Omaze emyezi ng’omwewa buli lunaku. Naye buli mulundi, weebuuza oba ddala wamwewa, era oba yakusembeza. Olw’okuba tewawulira njawulo, oluvannyuma lw’okubuusabuusa okungi, wasalawo nti tekyakolebwa. Omukkiriza omwagalwa, okutabulwa kuno kujja kubeerawo emirembe gyonna okuggyako ng’okumalawo n’okukkiriza. Olina okutwala ensonga eno nti ewedde. Olwo lwokka lw’oyinza okusuubira enneewulira yo okukyuka. Etteeka ly’ebiweebwayo eri Mukama likakasa nti buli ekimuweebwa kifuuka kitukuvu. Kyawulibwa, era tekiyinza kukozesebwa mu kigendererwa kirala kyonna. Okukikola bw’otyo kyandibadde kunyooma. “buli kintu ekiwongere ddala mu ngeri eyo kinaabanga kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda.” Ekiwongere kiyinza okuba, “oba muntu oba kisolo”; “tewaabengawo ku bintu ebyo bitundibwa oba okununulibwa.” Abayisirayiri bwe baamalanga okuwaayo ekiwongere eri Mukama, baakibalanga nga kya Mukama. Tewali yagumanga kukiddizaawo. Oyo eyawangayo ayinza okuba nga yawaayo ekirabo kye nga takyagala nnyo era nga talina bunyiikivu. Naye bwe yamalanga okuwaayo, ensonga n’eva mu mikono gye. Olw’etteeka lya Katonda yennyini, ekirabo kyafuukanga “kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda.” Si kigendererwa ky’oyo eyawaayo ekyakifuulanga ekitukuvu, wabula obutukuvu bw’Oyo eyakiweebwa. Kubanga kye “ekyoto kyennyini ekifuula ekirabo ekyo okuba ekitukuvu.” Era ekiweebwayo bwe kyamalanga okuteekebwa ku kyoto, okuva mu kaseera ako kyabanga kya Mukama. Nsobola okulowooza ku muntu eyali amaze okuwaayo ekirabo. Oluvannyuma ayinza okubuusabuusa oba yakiwaayo n’omutima ogw’amazima era mu bwesimbu. Yandiddayo eri kabona, ng’atawaanyizibwa olw’obwesimbu bwe. Nkakasa nti kabona yandimusirisizza amangu ddala. Yandimugambye nti, “Simanyi kigendererwa kyo mu kuwaayo ekiweebwayo kyo.” Ekikakafu kiri nti wakiwaayo, era nti kya Mukama, kubanga buli ekiwongere kitukuvu nnyo gy’ali. “Kaakano kikeereye okukiddizaawo.” Si kabona yekka, naye Isirayiri yonna yandyewuunyizza omuntu, ng’amaze okuwaayo ekirabo kye, n’agezaako okukiddizaawo. Kyokka buli lunaku, Abakristaayo abanyiikivu, abandikankanye olw’obunyoomi bw’Omuyudaaya ng’oyo, bakola ekikolwa ekifaanana bwe kityo. Beewaayo eri Mukama, ate ne beddiza olw’obutakkiriza. Olw’okuba Katonda talabika na maaso, kizibu okuwulira nti kye tukola naye kya ddala. Singa bwe twewaayo twali tusobola okumulaba, kyandiwulise nga kya ddala. Twandimanye nti tuwadde ekigambo kyaffe era nti tetuyinza kukiddizaawo, ne bwe twandyagadde kyenkana ki. Kyandibadde gye tuli n’amaanyi ag’okusiba ng’ekisuubizo ekyogeddwa eri mukwano gwaffe ow’oku nsi. Eri omuntu ow’ekitiibwa, ekisuubizo ng’ekyo bulijjo kirina amaanyi ago. Twetaaga okulaba nti okubeerawo kwa Katonda bulijjo kintu kya ddala ekikakafu. Buli kikolwa ky’omwoyo gwaffe kikolebwa mu maaso ge ddala. Ekigambo kye twogera mu kusaba kiba kyogeddwa gy’ali ddala, nga bwe kyandibadde singa amaaso gaffe gamulaba n’emikono gyaffe ne gimukwatako. Olwo tetujja kuddamu kubeera na ndowooza za kibuuzibuuzi ku nkolagana yaffe naye. Tujja kuwulira obuzito bwa buli kigambo kye twogera mu maaso ge. Mmanyi nti abamu bajja kugamba nti, “Aa, weewaawo. Naye singa yali ayogera nange n’aŋŋamba nti yantwala bwe nneewaayo gy’ali, olwo nandikikkirizza.” Nedda, mazima tewandikikkirizza. Kubanga emirundi mingi tayogera kino okutuusa ng’omwoyo gusoose okulaga obwesigwa bwagwo nga gukkiriza ky’amaze okwogera. Oyo akkiriza y’alina obujulirwa, so si oyo abuusabuusa. Era mu kiragiro kye kyennyini gye tuli eky’okwewaayo gy’ali nga ssaddaaka ennamu, yeetadde mu buvunaanyizibwa okutusembeza. Siyinza kulowooza ku muntu ow’ekitiibwa ng’asaba munne okumuwa ekintu ky’abuusabuusa okutwala. N’okusingawo, siyinza kulowooza ku muzadde ow’okwagala ng’akola bw’atyo eri omwana we omwagalwa. “Mwana wange mpa omutima gwo, n’amaaso go geekalirize amakubo gange.” Engero 23:26. Kino kikakasa ekitaliimu kubuusabuusa. Kitegeeza nti mu kaseera omutima lwe guweebwayo, gutwalibwa Oyo eyalagira guweebweyo. Kale tulina okubeera n’obwesige obusingirayo ddala. Bwe twewaayo eri Mukama nga bw’alagira, olwo atusembeza. Okuva mu kaseera ako, tuli babe. Waliwo endagaano ya ddala ekoleddwa. Tesobola kumenyebwa nga ffe tetwetiisizza buswavu. Tumanyi nti ye tagenda kugimenya. Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 26:17-19 kiraga engeri Katonda gy’akolamu: “Ku lunaku lwa leero oyatudde nga Mukama bw’ali Katonda wo, era nga naawe bw’onootambuliranga mu makubo ge, era ng’onookuumanga ebiragiro bye n’amateeka ge gonna, era ng’onoomugonderanga. Ku lunaku lwa leero Mukama alangiridde nga bw’oli owuwe, eggwanga lye ku bubwe ery’omuwendo omungi nga bwe yasuubiza, era nga ojjanga kukwatanga ebiragiro bye byonna. Alangiridde nga bw’anaakujjuzanga ettendo n’okwatiikirira n’ekitiibwa okusukkirira amawanga gonna ge yatonda, era ng’olibeera eggwanga ettukuvu eri Mukama Katonda wo, nga bwe yasuubiza.” Twatula nti Mukama ye Katonda waffe. Tujja kutambulira mu makubo ge era tukwate ebiragiro bye. Ye alangirira nti tuli babe, era tulina okukwata ebiragiro bye byonna. Era okuva mu kaseera ako, atufuula babe. Eno ye yali enkola ye bulijjo, era bw’ekyali. “buli kintu ekiwongere ddala mu ngeri eyo kinaabanga kitukuvu nnyo eri Mukama Katonda.” Kino kyeyoleka bulungi nnyo nti tekirina kubuusibwabuusibwa. Naye bw’oba ng’okyabuusabuusa, ka nkulage ekigambo ekiri mu Ndagaano Empya. Kitunuulira ensonga eno mu ngeri ndala, naye ndowooza nti kigimalirawo ddala. Kiri mu 1 Yokaana 5:14-15, era kigamba nti: “Noolwekyo tulina obuvumu nti bwe tugenda gy’ali ne tumusaba ekintu kyonna, ye nga bw’asiima atuwulira. Era bwe tutegeera nti atuwulira bwe tumusaba, buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa.” Katonda ayagala weewaayo gy’ali mu bujjuvu? Tewali kyakuddamu kirala okuggyako kimu, kubanga yakiragira. Kale omanyi nti ebintu bino biri nga bw’ayagala. N’olwekyo, olw’ekigambo kya Katonda, olina okumanya nti akuwulira. Kaakano olina okweyongerayo. Olina okumanya nti ofunye bye wamusaba. Si nti biriba bibye mu kiseera eky’omu maaso, wabula nti bibye kaakano; era nti atandise okukola mu ggwe okukwagazisa n’okukusobozesa okukola by’asiima. Era wano olina okuwummulira. Tolina kirala kya kukola. Kaakano oli wa Mukama, oli mu mikono gye ddala. Yeetisse obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okukulabirira n’okukufuga. Ng’ekigambo kye bwe kigamba, ajja kukola mu ggwe, “atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo.” Naye wano olina okunywerera ddala. Bw’obuusabuusa okwewaayo kwo, oba nti Katonda akukkirizza, okukkiriza kwo kujja kusagaasagana. Okukkiriza okusagaasagana kuleeta obulamu obutali bunywevu, era Katonda tasobola kukola. Naye bw’oba ng’okyesiga nti akola, omulimu gwe gukukyusa. Gukufuula okufaanana Kristo, okuva mu kitiibwa okutuuka mu kitiibwa, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we ow’amaanyi. Kaakano, mu kaseera kano ddala, weewaayo gy’ali mu bujjuvu? Oddamu nti weewaawo. Kale, mukwano gwange omwagalwa, bala nti oli wuwe. Akututte. Akola mu ggwe okukwagazisa n’okukusobozesa okukola by’asiima. Era weeyongere okukibala bw’otyo. Kijja kukuyamba okussa ebirowoozo byo mu bigambo. Weegambe ggwe kennyini era ogambe ne Katonda nti, “Mukama, ndi wuwo. Nneewaayo gy’oli, era nzikiriza nti ontwala.” Nneerekera gy’oli. “Kola mu nze byonna by’osiima ng’okwagala kwo bwe kuli. Nja kugalamira bugalamizi mu mikono gyo, nkwesige.” Kino kifuule ekikolwa ky’okusalawo kwo buli lunaku. Emirundi mingi buli lunaku, kiddeemu, kibeere embeera yo ey’olubeerera mu maaso ge. Kyeyatulire ggwe kennyini. Kyatule eri Katonda wo. Kyatule eri mikwano gyo. Bulijjo langirira nti Mukama ye Katonda wo. Weewaayo okutambulira mu makubo ge n’okukwata amateeka ge. Olwo ojja kukizuula nti akulangiridde okuba omu ku bantu be ab’enjawulo. Olina okukwata ebiragiro bye byonna, obeere “eggwanga ettukuvu eri Mukama Katonda wo, nga bwe yasuubiza.” Wano oyinza okusanga ng’amateeka matono amangu gakuyamba. Nkuwa amagezi okugakozesa mu kusaba kwo okwa buli lunaku. Galina okugezesa omwoyo okutuusa lwe tutegeera obulungi ensonga eno. I. Yatula lwatu okukkiriza kwo mu Kristo ng’Omulokozi wo. Era yatula nti okkiriza nti akutabaganyizza ne Katonda, nga 2 Abakkolinso 5:18-19 bwe kigamba: “Ebintu byonna biva eri Katonda eyatukomyawo gy’ali nga tuyita mu Kristo, era ne tuweebwa obuweereza obw’okutabaganya. Kubanga Katonda yali mu Kristo, ng’atabagana n’abantu, nga tababalira, bibi byabwe, n’atuteresa ffe obubaka obw’okutabaganya.” II. Yatula awatali kubuusabuusa nti Katonda ye Kitaffe. Oli mwana we gwe yanunula era gwe yasonyiwa, nga Abaggalatiya 4:5 bwe kigamba: yajja okununula abaali bafugibwa amateeka, “tulyoke tufuuke abaana.” III. Weewaayo ddala eri Mukama, omubiri, emmeeme, n’omwoyo. Mugonderenga mu buli kintu ky’omanyi nti ky’ayagala, nga Abaruumi 12:12 bwe kigamba: “nga musanyukira mu kusuubira, nga mugumiikiriza mu kubonaabona era nga munyiikira mu kusaba.” IV. Kkiriza, ne bwe kiba nga byonna bikontana, nti Katonda atwala ky’omukwasizza. Ajja kukola mu ggwe, okuggyako ng’olemesa ekisa kye. Laba 2 Abakkolinso 6:17-18: “Noolwekyo muve wakati mu bo, mubeeyawuleko, bw’ayogera Mukama. Temukwata ku bitali birongoofu, nange nnaabaaniriza. Era nnaabeeranga Kitammwe, nammwe ne mubeeranga batabani bange ne bawala bange, bw’ayogera Mukama Ayinzabyonna.” ne Abafiripi 2:13: “Kubanga Katonda yakolera mu mmwe, era yabaagazisa n’abasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, olw’okumusanyusa.” V. Tokozesanga nneewulira zo okugezesa enkolagana yo ne Katonda. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, ssa omwoyo ku kusalawo kwo ne ku kukkiriza kwo. Era emitendera gino gyonna gy’otambulira kaakano gitwale nga giwedde, newaakubadde omulabe ayinza okugifuula okulabika ng’egitali bwe gityo. Abaebbulaniya 10:22-23: “tusembere awali Katonda n’omwoyo ogw’amazima ogujjudde okukkiriza nga tulina emitima egitukuzibbwa okuva mu ndowooza embi, era nga n’emibiri gyaffe ginaazibbwa n’amazzi amatukuvu. Kale tunyweze essuubi lye twatula nga tetusagaasagana, kubanga eyasuubiza mwesigwa.” VI. Tobuusabuusanga, era toggwaamu maanyi, mu mbeera yonna. Jjukira nti okuggwaamu amaanyi kwonna kuva eri Setaani, era gaana okukukkiriza; nga Yokaana 14:1 bwe kigamba: “Omutima gwammwe tegweraliikiriranga. Mukkiriza Katonda, era nange munzikirize.” Olunyiriri 27: “Mbalekera emirembe, era mbawa emirembe gyange. Emirembe gye mbawa tegiringa egy’ensi. Noolwekyo temutyanga era temweraliikiriranga.” VII. Kulaakulanya empisa ey’okwatula okukkiriza kwo mu bigambo ebitegeerekeka. Ddamunga emirundi mingi nti, “Ndi wa Mukama yenna. Kaakano akola mu nze okunjagazisa n’okunsobozesa okukola by’asiima,” nga Abaebbulaniya 13:21 bwe kigamba: “abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.”

fields.title: Ebizibu ku Kukkiriza
fields.body_html:
Oluvannyuma lw’okwewaayo, eddaala eriddako kwe kukkiriza. Kwe kufulumya omwoyo mu ddungu ery’obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo ne kuguyingiza mu ensi ekulukuta amata n’omubisi gw’enjuki. Era wano, nga ku ddaala erisooka, omulabe mukugu nnyo mu kuleeta ebizibu n’ebiziyiza. Omwana wa Katonda, bw’alaba obujjuvu obuli mu Yesu ku lulwe, ayaayaanira okubufuna. Naye buli musomesa gw’abuuza amugamba nti okukkiriza kwokka kwe kuyinza okubufuna. Kyokka okukkiriza kye kyama gy’ali. Ekigambo ekyo, mu kifo ky’okumuyamba, kifuula ensonga okuba enzibu era enkalubo okusinga bwe yali.

“Mazima kiteekwa okuba olw’okukkiriza,” bw’agamba, “kubanga mmanyi nti buli kintu mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo kiba lwa kukkiriza. Naye ekyo kye kikifuula ekizibu bwe kityo, kubanga sirina kukkiriza, era simanyi na kye kuli, wadde engeri y’okukufuna.” Era bw’asoberwa olw’ekizibu kino, n’agwa mu kuggwaamu essuubi. Obuzibu buno buva mu butategeera bulungi kukkiriza. Mu mazima, okukkiriza kye kintu ekisinga obwangu mu nsi, era ekisinga okwanguyira okufuna.

Ndowooza endowooza yo ku kukkiriza ebadde efaanana bw’eti. Okulaba ng’ekintu ekirina ekifaananyi. Kiyinza okuba ekikolwa eky’eddiini eky’omwoyo oba embeera ey’ekisa mu mutima. Kintu kya kukwatibwako. Bw’oba nakyo, osobola okukisanyukira. Osobola okukikozesa ng’olupapula olukuyisa okutuuka mu kisa kya Katonda, oba ng’ensimbi ez’okugula ebirabo bye. Obadde osaba okukkiriza. Wasuubira okufuna ekintu ekiri bwe kityo. Naye tewafunanga kintu kyonna.

N’olwekyo, okakasa nti tolina kukkiriza. Naye mu mazima, okukkiriza si kintu kya ngeri eyo n’akatono.

Si kintu kya kukwatibwako n’akatono.

Kwe kukkiriza Katonda bukkiriza, era, ng’okulaba, tekuliiko kye kuli nga kwawuddwa ku ekyo kye kukkiriza. Okutunula munda mu ggwe okulaba oba olina okukkiriza kufaanana bufaanana n’okuzibiriza amaaso n’otunula munda okulaba oba olina okulaba. Olaba ekintu, n’omanya nti osobola okulaba; okkiriza ekintu, n’omanya nti olina okukkiriza. Kubanga ng’okulaba bwe kuli okulaba kwokka, n’okukkiriza bwe kuli okukkiriza kwokka. Ekyetaagisa kyokka mu kulaba kwe kulaba ekintu nga bwe kiri. Bwe kityo, ekyetaagisa kyokka mu kukkiriza kwe kukkiriza ekintu nga bwe kiri.

Amaanyi tegali mu kukkiriza kwo, wabula mu kintu ky’okkiriza. Bw’okkiriza amazima, olokolebwa; bw’okkiriza obulimba, obula. Okukkiriza kwe kumu mu mbeera zombi. Ebikkirizibwa bye bikontana ddala. Kino kye kireeta enjawulo ennene ennyo. Obulokozi bwo tebujja lwa kuba nti okukkiriza kwo kukulokola. Bujja kubanga kukugatta n’Omulokozi alokola. Okukkiriza kwo mazima kye kiyunzi kyokka.

Kale nkwegayiridde, laba obwangu bw’okukkiriza. Kwe kukkiriza Katonda bw’agamba nti waliwo ky’atukoledde, oba ky’anaatukolera. Olwo tulina okumwesiga okukikola. Kyangu nnyo ne kiba nti kizibu okukinnyonnyola.

Omuntu yenna bw’ambuuza kye kitegeeza okwesiga omuntu okunkolera omulimu, nsobola okumuddamu kino kyokka: kitegeeza okumuleka agukole. Mpulira nga tekyetaagisa nze kennyini okugukola. Ffenna twali twesizza abalala n’emirimu emikulu. Twawulira okuwummula okutuukiridde mu bwesige obwo, kubanga twali tukakasa abo abaagukwata. Emirundi emeka bamaama gye beesiga abalezi okukuuma abaana baabwe abato ab’omuwendo, nga tebalina na katono ka kweraliikirira?

Ffenna twesiga abafumbi, abavuzi b’amagaali, abavuzi b’eggaali y’omukka n’abakulira eggaali, n’obulamu bwaffe n’obulamu obulungi. Tukikola nga tetutya. Abaweereza bano abasasulwa bandisobodde okutuzikiriza mu kaseera katono singa baayagala, oba singa baali bagayaavu.

Ebyo byonna tubikola, era tetubikubiraako nduulu. Emirundi mingi twesiga abantu nga tumaze naabo akaseera katono. Twetaaga kumanya bumanya engeri abantu gye bali n’empisa eza bulijjo ez’omu bantu. Tetuwulira nti tukola kintu kya kitalo. Naawe ekyo kyonna okikoze, omusomi omwagalwa, era okikola bulijjo. Tewandisobodde kubeera mulamu mu nsi eno okumala olunaku lumu singa tewandisobodde kwesiga bantu bannaabo. Era tekikujjira mu mutwe okugamba nti tosobola.

Naye kyokka togaya kugamba, bulijjo, nti tosobola kwesiga Katonda wo! Nkusaba olowooze ng’okola mu nkolagana yo n’abantu nga bw’okola mu nkolagana yo ey’omwoyo. Lowooza nti enkya otandika ng’olina ekirowoozo kino mu mutwe: nti tosobola kwesiga muntu yenna, kubanga tolina kukkiriza. Ku kyenkya wandigambye nti, “Sisobola kulya kintu kyonna ku mmeeza eno. Sirina kukkiriza. Sisobola kukkiriza nti omufumbi tateeze butwa mu kaawa. Oba nti omusala w’ennyama tasindise nnyama erwadde.” Bw’otyo wandifudde enjala. Oluvannyuma wandigambye nti, “Sisobola kulinnya ggaali y’omukka. Sirina kukkiriza, n’olwekyo sisobola kwesiga muntu yenna.”

Wandibadde olina okutambula n’ebigere buli wamu. Wandikooye nnyo. Era tewandisobodde kutuuka mu bifo bingi bye wandituuseemu ng’oyita mu ggaali y’omukka. Mikwano gyo oba omukozi wo ow’ebyobusuubuzi bwe bandikuleetedde ebiwandiiko, wandigambye nti, “Nsonyiwa, naye sisobola kubakkiriza. Sirina kukkiriza era sisobola kwesiga muntu yenna.” Bw’osoma olupapula lw’amawulire, wandibadde olina okululeka. Wandigambye nti, “Sisobola kukkiriza kigambo na kimu kye lwogera. Sirina kukkiriza. Sikkiriza nti waliwo Kwiini, kubanga sinnamulabako. Era sikkiriza nti Ayalandi weeri, kubanga sinnagendayo.” “Era sirina kukkiriza, kale mazima sisobola kukkiriza kintu kyonna kye sinneewuliramu na kukwatako nze kennyini. Kizibu kinene, naye sisobola kukiziyiza, kubanga sirina kukkiriza.”

Lowooza ku lunaku ng’olwo. Lwandikuleetedde akabi kanene. Lwandirabise ng’obusirusiru eri buli eyandikulabye olunaku lwonna. Kimanye nti mikwano gyo bandiwulidde nga bavumiddwa. Abaweereza bo bandivudde ku mulimu. Olwo weebuuze kino: Obanga kibi nnyo bwe kityo obutesiga bantu bannaabo, kale kiri kitya okugamba Katonda nti tosobola kumwesiga?

Ogamba nti kizibu kinene, naye tosobola kukiziyiza; tolina kukkiriza. Osobola okwesiga bantu bannaabo naye n’otosobola kwesiga Katonda wo? Nti osobola okukkiriza “obujulirwa bw’abantu”, naye n’otosobola kukkiriza “obujulirwa bwa Katonda”? Nti osobola okukkiriza ebyo abantu bye bategeeza, naye n’otokkiriza Katonda by’ategeeza? Weesiga bantu bannaabo abanafu era abalemererwa n’ebintu byo ebisinga omuwendo. Kyokka otya okukwasa emmeeme yo Omulokozi ow’omukisa.

Yayiwa omusaayi gwe okukulokola. “ayinza okulokolera ddala” — akulokolera ddala ggwe.

Mazima, omukkiriza omwagalwa, erinnya lyo lyennyini liraga nti osobola okukkiriza. N’olwekyo tolyetantala nate kwekwasa butaba na kukkiriza. Kubanga kino kitegeeza, mazima, nti tolina kukkiriza mu Katonda. Tosabibwa kubeera na kukkiriza mu ggwe kennyini. Singa wakubeera nakwo, gyandibadde mbeera mbi nnyo ey’omwoyo. Nkwegayiridde, bw’olowooza oba bw’oyogera ebintu bino, maliriza sentensi. Gamba nti, “Sirina kukkiriza mu Katonda, sisobola kukkiriza Katonda.” Nkakasa nti kino amangu kijja kukutiisa nnyo n’otoyinza kukyeyongerako.

Naye ogamba nti, sisobola kukkiriza awatali Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Kale kirungi; onoosalawo nti obutaba na kukkiriza kwo kuva ku Mwoyo ow’omukisa okulemererwa okukola omulimu gwe? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, olwo ggwe toliiko musango.

Tolina kwewulira ng’osaliddwa omusango. Okukukubiriza kwange kwonna okukkiriza tekugasa. Naye nedda! Tolaba nti, bw’oyimirira ku ndowooza eyo nti tolina kukkiriza era tosobola kukkiriza, oli ng’oyo “amufudde mulimba”? Era olaga obutesiga Mwoyo Omutukuvu n’akatono. Kubanga bulijjo mwetegefu okutubeera mu bunafu bwaffe.

Tetwetaaga kumulindirira n’akatono; ye bulijjo y’atulindirira. Nnina okukkiriza okujjuvu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu.

Bulijjo mwetegefu okukola omulimu gwe. Kale mbagamba mmwe mwenna nti: musobola okukkiriza kaakano, mu kaseera kano. Bw’otokkiriza, si nsobi ya Mwoyo, wabula yiyo ggwe.

Kale, okusalawo kwo kuteeke ku ludda lw’okukkiriza. Gamba nti, “Mukama, nja kukkiriza, era nzikiriza,” era weeyongere okukyogera. Nywerera ku kukkiriza, ne bwe kiba nga buli kirowoozo eky’okubuusabuusa kikukema. Mu butakkiriza bwo, weesuule ku kigambo kya Katonda n’ebisuubizo bye. Gumira okwesiga amaanyi ga Mukama Yesu agalokola. Obanga wali weesizza mukwano gwo ekintu eky’omuwendo, nkukubiriza kaakano weekwase ggwe kennyini. Kwasa Mukwano gwo ow’omu ggulu ebyo by’omwoyo gwo. Tobuusabuusanga nate, nedda, nedda, NEDDA!

Era jjukira nti okwesiga n’okweraliikirira tebiyinza kutabagana, okusinga amafuta n’amazzi. Ekyo wandikiyise okwesiga? Bw’osaba mukwano gwo akukolere ekintu, ate n’omala emisana n’ekiro ng’weeraliikirira oba anaakikola bulungi. Ekyo oyinza okukiyita okwesiga? Emmeeme yo ogitadde mu mikono gya Mukama. Naye omala essaawa buli lunaku n’ekiro, ng’ojjudde okweraliikirira nga bw’obuusabuusa ekyo. Omukkiriza bw’aba ddala yeesiga ekintu, alekera awo okweraliikirira ku kintu ekyo ky’ateresezza.

Era bw’aba yeeraliikirira, obwo bwe bukakafu obweyoleka nti teyeesiga. Bwe tugezesa n’etteeka lino, nga waliwo okwesiga okwa ddala okutono ennyo mu Kkanisa ya Kristo! Tekyewuunyisa nti Mukama waffe yabuuza ekibuuzo ekinakuwaza nti, “Omwana w’Omuntu, bw’alijja, alisanga okukkiriza ku nsi?” Alisanga emirimu mingi n’obunyiikivu. Walibaawo emitima mingi egyewaddeyo. Naye alisanga okukkiriza? Kye kintu ky’asinga okutwala nga kya muwendo. Kibuuzo kikulu nnyo, era nnandyagadde buli mutima gw’Omukristaayo gukifumiitirizeeko. Naye obulamu bwaffe obwayita ka bubeere nga bumala. Twagabana ku butakkiriza bw’ensi. Kale ffe abamanyi Mukama waffe ow’omukisa, ka tukakase amazima ge.

Obwesigwa bwe businga ebigambo. Tulina, n’emitima gyaffe, okumwesiga mu bujjuvu.

Nzijukira, nga nkyali mu ntandikwa y’obulamu bwange obw’Ekikristaayo, okukubiriza okumu kwe nnasanga mu kitabo ky’ebigambo by’okubuulira eby’edda. Kwasiikuula buli kiwuubaalo kyange eky’obwesigwa n’eky’okwagala. Kwakubiriza bonna abaagala Mukama Yesu okulaga abalala nga bw’asaanira, nga bayita mu kukkiriza kwabwe okunywevu mu ye. Nzijukira nga emmeeme yange yakaaba olw’okuyaayaana. Nnayaayaanira okutambulira mu makubo ago ag’ekizikiza. Obutesiga kwange okujjuvu kwandibadde nkizo ey’omukisa era ey’ekitiibwa.

“lino ekkubo temuliyitangamu” — oboolyawo bw’oli bw’otyo. Naye leero nkizo yo ey’essanyu okulaga, nga bw’otolagangako, obwesige bwo obwesigwa mu Mukama. Tandika naye obulamu obw’okukkiriza, obubeerwamu n’okwesiga okujjuvu ng’okw’omwana omuto. Wamwesiga mu bintu bitono, era teyakulemererwa. Kaakano mwesige mu buli kintu. Laba oba tagenda kukukolera kusinga byonna by’oyinza okusaba oba okulowooza. Tekiriba lwa maanyi go, wabula lwa maanyi ge ag’ekitalo. Ago ge galikola mu ggwe byonna by’asiima mu kwagala kwe okw’omukisa.

Weesiga Mukama okufuga obutonde bwonna n’ebitonde byonna. Ensonga yo eyinza okuba enzibu okusinga ebyo?

Teweetaaga kweraliikirira ngeri gy’agifugamu. Okubuusabuusa okutasaana ng’okwo kuggweewo! Weesige Katonda wo. Laba ebizibu byonna bwe binaabulawo amangu ennyo mu maaso g’okusalawo okunywevu okw’okukkiriza. Weesige mu kizikiza, mu kitangaala, ekiro, n’enkya. Ojja kukizuula nti, newaakubadde okukkiriza kuyinza okutandika ng’okufuba okw’amaanyi, kujja kufuuka empisa ey’obutonde ey’omwoyo.

Byonna bisoboka eri Katonda. Makko 9:23: “Obanga osobola! Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza.” “Okukkiriza, mu biseera eby’edda, kwe kwakola eby’abo ‘abaawangula bakabaka olw’okukkiriza, be baakola eby’obutuukirivu, be baafuna ebyasuubizibwa, era be baabuniza obumwa bw’empologoma, be baazikiza omuliro ogw’amaanyi, be baawona obwogi bw’ekitala. Be baaweebwa amaanyi okuva mu bunafu, era be baafuuka abazira ab’amaanyi mu ntalo, ne bagoba amaggye g’amawanga.’ Era okukkiriza kusobola okukikola nate.” Mukama waffe agamba nti, “Olw’okukkiriza kwammwe okutono. Kubanga ddala ddala mbagamba nti, bwe muba n’okukkiriza okufaanana ng’akaweke ka kaladaali, mwandiyinzizza okugamba olusozi luno nti, ‘Vvaawo wano,’ era ne luvaawo era tewandibaddewo kye mulemwa.” Matayo 17:20. Bw’oba oli mwana wa Katonda, oteekwa okuba n’okukkiriza waakiri okwenkana akaweke ka kaladaali. N’olwekyo toyinza kuddamu kugamba nti tosobola kwesiga kubanga tolina kukkiriza. Gamba nti, “Nsobola okwesiga Mukama wange, era nja kumwesiga. Amaanyi gonna ag’ensi oba ag’omu ggeyeena tegalimpaliriza kubuusabuusa Omununuzi wange ow’ekitiibwa era omwesigwa!”

Ekintu ekisinga obukulu mu kyasa kino, okusumululwa kw’abaddu baffe, lye ssomo ddene ku kukkiriza. Abaddu baafuna eddembe lyabwe olw’okukkiriza, nga naffe bwe tuteekwa okufuna eryaffe. Baafuna amawulire amalungi nti gavumenti yali erangiridde eddembe lyabwe. Baafuuka ba ddembe mu kaseera Ekirango lwe kyafulumizibwa.

Naye tebaakikkiriza ddala okutuusa lwe baawulira amawulire amalungi. Ekituufu kyalina okusooka. Naye baalina okukkiriza nga ekituufu tekinnabagasa. Enneewulira yandiddiridde ku nkomerero. Eno ye nkola ya Katonda bulijjo, era ye nkola ey’amagezi ag’obuntu.

I. Ekituufu.

II. Okukkiriza.

III. Enneewulira.

Naye omuntu akyusa enkola eno n’agamba nti: I. Enneewulira. II. Okukkiriza. III. Ekituufu. Singa abaddu baagoberera enkola y’omuntu ku ddembe lyabwe, bandisigadde mu buddu okumala ekiseera. Bandigaanye okukikkiriza okutuusa nga bakiwulidde. Nnawulira ku mbeera emu ng’eyo. Mu kibuga eky’ewala eky’Obukiikaddyo, omukyala ow’e Bukiikakkono yasanga, emyaka ebiri oba esatu oluvannyuma lw’olutalo, abaddu abataali beetwalidde ddembe lyabwe. Bwe yayogera nti ab’e Bukiikakkono baabawa eddembe, omukyala omukadde omuddugavu n’assaayo omwoyo. Omukyala omukadde n’amusalako n’ekibuuzo ng’ayaayaana.

“Ayi, nnyabo, tuli ba ddembe?”

“Mazima muli ba ddembe,” omukyala n’addamu.

“Ayi, okakasa?” omukyala omukadde n’akalambira, ng’ayaayaana nnyo.

“Weewaawo, nkakasa,” omukyala n’addamu, nga eddoboozi lye linywevu era likakafu. “Naye kiyinzika nti obadde tokimanyi?”

“Kale,” omukyala omukadde n’agamba, “twawulira nti tuli ba ddembe, ne tubuuza mukama waffe, n’agamba nti tetuli, ne tutya okugenda. Ate ne tuddamu okuwulira nti tuli ba ddembe, ne tugenda eri omukulu w’amagye, n’agamba nti tusigale ne mukama waffe ow’edda. Bwe tutyo tubadde tetukakasa. Oluusi twalowooza nti tuli ba ddembe, ate oluusi nti tetuli. Naye kaakano, nnyabo, bw’oba okakasa nti tuli ba ddembe, oyinza okuntegeeza byonna ku nsonga eno?” Bwe yalaba nti kyali kyetaago kya ddala, omukyala n’annyonnyola byonna omukyala oyo omwavu.

Yamubuulira ku lutalo, ku ggye ery’e Bukiikakkono, ne ku Abraham Lincoln. Yamubuulira ku Kirango kye eky’Okusumulula Abaddu n’eddembe lye kyaleeta.

Omuddu oyo omwavu yawuliriza ng’ayaayaana nnyo. Yawulira amawulire amalungi. Yagakkiriza. Era olugero bwe lwaggwa, n’afuluma mu kisenge ng’alina empisa ey’omuntu atafugibwa muntu yenna, ng’agenda ayogera nti, — “Ndi wa ddembe! Sikyasigala na mukama oyo ow’edda!” Yali afunye eddembe lye ku nkomerero, era yali alifunye olw’okukkiriza. Gavumenti yali emulangiridde nga wa ddembe dda nnyo. Naye ekyo tekyamugasa. Yali takkirizanga kirango ekyo. Amawulire amalungi tegaamugasa, kubanga oyo eyagawulira yali tagatabudde na kukkiriza — nga bali abaawulira ekigambo naye “baalema okukkiriza ekigambo kye baawulira, era tebaalina kye baagasibwa.” Naye kaakano yakkiriza, era olw’okukkiriza, n’agumira okwebala nga wa ddembe. Era kino tekyava ku nkyukakyuka yonna mu ye oba mu mbeera ze, wadde ku nneewulira yonna ey’omu mutima gwe. Wabula kyava ku kuba nti yeesiga omulala — oyo eyajja gy’ali n’amawulire ag’eddembe lye.

Nneetaaga okulaga engeri kino gye kitukwatako? Mu bubaka bwa mirundi kikumi, Katonda alangiridde eddembe lyaffe. Atukubiriza okwerowooza nga ba ddembe. Kale okukkiriza kwo kukwate ekirango kye, era kakase nti kya mazima. Langirira gy’oli ggwe kennyini, eri mikwano gyo, ne mu kyama ky’omwoyo gwo eri Katonda, nti oli wa ddembe. Gaana okuwuliriza n’akaseera akamu ebigambo eby’obulimba ebya mukama wo ow’edda nti okyali muddu we. Waleme kubaawo kikumalamu maanyi, wadde enneewulira ez’omunda oba obubonero obw’ebweru. Nywerera ku by’okkiriza wadde nga buli kimu kikuziyiza. Nkusuubiza, ku buyinza bwa Mukama waffe, nti ojja kulaba nga kikolebwa ng’okukkiriza kwo bwe kuli.

Mu kusinza kwonna kwe tuyinza okuleetera Katonda waffe, tewali kumuwoomera nga kuno — okwesiga kwaffe okujjuvu okwewaayo ddala. Tewali kumuleetera kitiibwa kingi bwe kityo. Mu buli ssaawa ey’ekizikiza, jjukira kino: “mujja kusanga ebizibu bya ngeri nnyingi okumala akaseera.” Kiri bwe kityo. “Kubanga okugezesebwa kw’okukkiriza kwammwe, kwa muwendo mungi nnyo okusinga zaabu egezebwa mu muliro n’ekakasibwa, kulyoke kusaanire ettendo n’ekitiibwa n’okugulumizibwa ku lunaku luli Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo lw’alirabikirako.”
fields.body_text: Oluvannyuma lw’okwewaayo, eddaala eriddako kwe kukkiriza. Kwe kufulumya omwoyo mu ddungu ery’obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo ne kuguyingiza mu ensi ekulukuta amata n’omubisi gw’enjuki. Era wano, nga ku ddaala erisooka, omulabe mukugu nnyo mu kuleeta ebizibu n’ebiziyiza. Omwana wa Katonda, bw’alaba obujjuvu obuli mu Yesu ku lulwe, ayaayaanira okubufuna. Naye buli musomesa gw’abuuza amugamba nti okukkiriza kwokka kwe kuyinza okubufuna. Kyokka okukkiriza kye kyama gy’ali. Ekigambo ekyo, mu kifo ky’okumuyamba, kifuula ensonga okuba enzibu era enkalubo okusinga bwe yali. “Mazima kiteekwa okuba olw’okukkiriza,” bw’agamba, “kubanga mmanyi nti buli kintu mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo kiba lwa kukkiriza. Naye ekyo kye kikifuula ekizibu bwe kityo, kubanga sirina kukkiriza, era simanyi na kye kuli, wadde engeri y’okukufuna.” Era bw’asoberwa olw’ekizibu kino, n’agwa mu kuggwaamu essuubi. Obuzibu buno buva mu butategeera bulungi kukkiriza. Mu mazima, okukkiriza kye kintu ekisinga obwangu mu nsi, era ekisinga okwanguyira okufuna. Ndowooza endowooza yo ku kukkiriza ebadde efaanana bw’eti. Okulaba ng’ekintu ekirina ekifaananyi. Kiyinza okuba ekikolwa eky’eddiini eky’omwoyo oba embeera ey’ekisa mu mutima. Kintu kya kukwatibwako. Bw’oba nakyo, osobola okukisanyukira. Osobola okukikozesa ng’olupapula olukuyisa okutuuka mu kisa kya Katonda, oba ng’ensimbi ez’okugula ebirabo bye. Obadde osaba okukkiriza. Wasuubira okufuna ekintu ekiri bwe kityo. Naye tewafunanga kintu kyonna. N’olwekyo, okakasa nti tolina kukkiriza. Naye mu mazima, okukkiriza si kintu kya ngeri eyo n’akatono. Si kintu kya kukwatibwako n’akatono. Kwe kukkiriza Katonda bukkiriza, era, ng’okulaba, tekuliiko kye kuli nga kwawuddwa ku ekyo kye kukkiriza. Okutunula munda mu ggwe okulaba oba olina okukkiriza kufaanana bufaanana n’okuzibiriza amaaso n’otunula munda okulaba oba olina okulaba. Olaba ekintu, n’omanya nti osobola okulaba; okkiriza ekintu, n’omanya nti olina okukkiriza. Kubanga ng’okulaba bwe kuli okulaba kwokka, n’okukkiriza bwe kuli okukkiriza kwokka. Ekyetaagisa kyokka mu kulaba kwe kulaba ekintu nga bwe kiri. Bwe kityo, ekyetaagisa kyokka mu kukkiriza kwe kukkiriza ekintu nga bwe kiri. Amaanyi tegali mu kukkiriza kwo, wabula mu kintu ky’okkiriza. Bw’okkiriza amazima, olokolebwa; bw’okkiriza obulimba, obula. Okukkiriza kwe kumu mu mbeera zombi. Ebikkirizibwa bye bikontana ddala. Kino kye kireeta enjawulo ennene ennyo. Obulokozi bwo tebujja lwa kuba nti okukkiriza kwo kukulokola. Bujja kubanga kukugatta n’Omulokozi alokola. Okukkiriza kwo mazima kye kiyunzi kyokka. Kale nkwegayiridde, laba obwangu bw’okukkiriza. Kwe kukkiriza Katonda bw’agamba nti waliwo ky’atukoledde, oba ky’anaatukolera. Olwo tulina okumwesiga okukikola. Kyangu nnyo ne kiba nti kizibu okukinnyonnyola. Omuntu yenna bw’ambuuza kye kitegeeza okwesiga omuntu okunkolera omulimu, nsobola okumuddamu kino kyokka: kitegeeza okumuleka agukole. Mpulira nga tekyetaagisa nze kennyini okugukola. Ffenna twali twesizza abalala n’emirimu emikulu. Twawulira okuwummula okutuukiridde mu bwesige obwo, kubanga twali tukakasa abo abaagukwata. Emirundi emeka bamaama gye beesiga abalezi okukuuma abaana baabwe abato ab’omuwendo, nga tebalina na katono ka kweraliikirira? Ffenna twesiga abafumbi, abavuzi b’amagaali, abavuzi b’eggaali y’omukka n’abakulira eggaali, n’obulamu bwaffe n’obulamu obulungi. Tukikola nga tetutya. Abaweereza bano abasasulwa bandisobodde okutuzikiriza mu kaseera katono singa baayagala, oba singa baali bagayaavu. Ebyo byonna tubikola, era tetubikubiraako nduulu. Emirundi mingi twesiga abantu nga tumaze naabo akaseera katono. Twetaaga kumanya bumanya engeri abantu gye bali n’empisa eza bulijjo ez’omu bantu. Tetuwulira nti tukola kintu kya kitalo. Naawe ekyo kyonna okikoze, omusomi omwagalwa, era okikola bulijjo. Tewandisobodde kubeera mulamu mu nsi eno okumala olunaku lumu singa tewandisobodde kwesiga bantu bannaabo. Era tekikujjira mu mutwe okugamba nti tosobola. Naye kyokka togaya kugamba, bulijjo, nti tosobola kwesiga Katonda wo! Nkusaba olowooze ng’okola mu nkolagana yo n’abantu nga bw’okola mu nkolagana yo ey’omwoyo. Lowooza nti enkya otandika ng’olina ekirowoozo kino mu mutwe: nti tosobola kwesiga muntu yenna, kubanga tolina kukkiriza. Ku kyenkya wandigambye nti, “Sisobola kulya kintu kyonna ku mmeeza eno. Sirina kukkiriza. Sisobola kukkiriza nti omufumbi tateeze butwa mu kaawa. Oba nti omusala w’ennyama tasindise nnyama erwadde.” Bw’otyo wandifudde enjala. Oluvannyuma wandigambye nti, “Sisobola kulinnya ggaali y’omukka. Sirina kukkiriza, n’olwekyo sisobola kwesiga muntu yenna.” Wandibadde olina okutambula n’ebigere buli wamu. Wandikooye nnyo. Era tewandisobodde kutuuka mu bifo bingi bye wandituuseemu ng’oyita mu ggaali y’omukka. Mikwano gyo oba omukozi wo ow’ebyobusuubuzi bwe bandikuleetedde ebiwandiiko, wandigambye nti, “Nsonyiwa, naye sisobola kubakkiriza. Sirina kukkiriza era sisobola kwesiga muntu yenna.” Bw’osoma olupapula lw’amawulire, wandibadde olina okululeka. Wandigambye nti, “Sisobola kukkiriza kigambo na kimu kye lwogera. Sirina kukkiriza. Sikkiriza nti waliwo Kwiini, kubanga sinnamulabako. Era sikkiriza nti Ayalandi weeri, kubanga sinnagendayo.” “Era sirina kukkiriza, kale mazima sisobola kukkiriza kintu kyonna kye sinneewuliramu na kukwatako nze kennyini. Kizibu kinene, naye sisobola kukiziyiza, kubanga sirina kukkiriza.” Lowooza ku lunaku ng’olwo. Lwandikuleetedde akabi kanene. Lwandirabise ng’obusirusiru eri buli eyandikulabye olunaku lwonna. Kimanye nti mikwano gyo bandiwulidde nga bavumiddwa. Abaweereza bo bandivudde ku mulimu. Olwo weebuuze kino: Obanga kibi nnyo bwe kityo obutesiga bantu bannaabo, kale kiri kitya okugamba Katonda nti tosobola kumwesiga? Ogamba nti kizibu kinene, naye tosobola kukiziyiza; tolina kukkiriza. Osobola okwesiga bantu bannaabo naye n’otosobola kwesiga Katonda wo? Nti osobola okukkiriza “obujulirwa bw’abantu”, naye n’otosobola kukkiriza “obujulirwa bwa Katonda”? Nti osobola okukkiriza ebyo abantu bye bategeeza, naye n’otokkiriza Katonda by’ategeeza? Weesiga bantu bannaabo abanafu era abalemererwa n’ebintu byo ebisinga omuwendo. Kyokka otya okukwasa emmeeme yo Omulokozi ow’omukisa. Yayiwa omusaayi gwe okukulokola. “ayinza okulokolera ddala” — akulokolera ddala ggwe. Mazima, omukkiriza omwagalwa, erinnya lyo lyennyini liraga nti osobola okukkiriza. N’olwekyo tolyetantala nate kwekwasa butaba na kukkiriza. Kubanga kino kitegeeza, mazima, nti tolina kukkiriza mu Katonda. Tosabibwa kubeera na kukkiriza mu ggwe kennyini. Singa wakubeera nakwo, gyandibadde mbeera mbi nnyo ey’omwoyo. Nkwegayiridde, bw’olowooza oba bw’oyogera ebintu bino, maliriza sentensi. Gamba nti, “Sirina kukkiriza mu Katonda, sisobola kukkiriza Katonda.” Nkakasa nti kino amangu kijja kukutiisa nnyo n’otoyinza kukyeyongerako. Naye ogamba nti, sisobola kukkiriza awatali Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Kale kirungi; onoosalawo nti obutaba na kukkiriza kwo kuva ku Mwoyo ow’omukisa okulemererwa okukola omulimu gwe? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, olwo ggwe toliiko musango. Tolina kwewulira ng’osaliddwa omusango. Okukukubiriza kwange kwonna okukkiriza tekugasa. Naye nedda! Tolaba nti, bw’oyimirira ku ndowooza eyo nti tolina kukkiriza era tosobola kukkiriza, oli ng’oyo “amufudde mulimba”? Era olaga obutesiga Mwoyo Omutukuvu n’akatono. Kubanga bulijjo mwetegefu okutubeera mu bunafu bwaffe. Tetwetaaga kumulindirira n’akatono; ye bulijjo y’atulindirira. Nnina okukkiriza okujjuvu mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Bulijjo mwetegefu okukola omulimu gwe. Kale mbagamba mmwe mwenna nti: musobola okukkiriza kaakano, mu kaseera kano. Bw’otokkiriza, si nsobi ya Mwoyo, wabula yiyo ggwe. Kale, okusalawo kwo kuteeke ku ludda lw’okukkiriza. Gamba nti, “Mukama, nja kukkiriza, era nzikiriza,” era weeyongere okukyogera. Nywerera ku kukkiriza, ne bwe kiba nga buli kirowoozo eky’okubuusabuusa kikukema. Mu butakkiriza bwo, weesuule ku kigambo kya Katonda n’ebisuubizo bye. Gumira okwesiga amaanyi ga Mukama Yesu agalokola. Obanga wali weesizza mukwano gwo ekintu eky’omuwendo, nkukubiriza kaakano weekwase ggwe kennyini. Kwasa Mukwano gwo ow’omu ggulu ebyo by’omwoyo gwo. Tobuusabuusanga nate, nedda, nedda, NEDDA! Era jjukira nti okwesiga n’okweraliikirira tebiyinza kutabagana, okusinga amafuta n’amazzi. Ekyo wandikiyise okwesiga? Bw’osaba mukwano gwo akukolere ekintu, ate n’omala emisana n’ekiro ng’weeraliikirira oba anaakikola bulungi. Ekyo oyinza okukiyita okwesiga? Emmeeme yo ogitadde mu mikono gya Mukama. Naye omala essaawa buli lunaku n’ekiro, ng’ojjudde okweraliikirira nga bw’obuusabuusa ekyo. Omukkiriza bw’aba ddala yeesiga ekintu, alekera awo okweraliikirira ku kintu ekyo ky’ateresezza. Era bw’aba yeeraliikirira, obwo bwe bukakafu obweyoleka nti teyeesiga. Bwe tugezesa n’etteeka lino, nga waliwo okwesiga okwa ddala okutono ennyo mu Kkanisa ya Kristo! Tekyewuunyisa nti Mukama waffe yabuuza ekibuuzo ekinakuwaza nti, “Omwana w’Omuntu, bw’alijja, alisanga okukkiriza ku nsi?” Alisanga emirimu mingi n’obunyiikivu. Walibaawo emitima mingi egyewaddeyo. Naye alisanga okukkiriza? Kye kintu ky’asinga okutwala nga kya muwendo. Kibuuzo kikulu nnyo, era nnandyagadde buli mutima gw’Omukristaayo gukifumiitirizeeko. Naye obulamu bwaffe obwayita ka bubeere nga bumala. Twagabana ku butakkiriza bw’ensi. Kale ffe abamanyi Mukama waffe ow’omukisa, ka tukakase amazima ge. Obwesigwa bwe businga ebigambo. Tulina, n’emitima gyaffe, okumwesiga mu bujjuvu. Nzijukira, nga nkyali mu ntandikwa y’obulamu bwange obw’Ekikristaayo, okukubiriza okumu kwe nnasanga mu kitabo ky’ebigambo by’okubuulira eby’edda. Kwasiikuula buli kiwuubaalo kyange eky’obwesigwa n’eky’okwagala. Kwakubiriza bonna abaagala Mukama Yesu okulaga abalala nga bw’asaanira, nga bayita mu kukkiriza kwabwe okunywevu mu ye. Nzijukira nga emmeeme yange yakaaba olw’okuyaayaana. Nnayaayaanira okutambulira mu makubo ago ag’ekizikiza. Obutesiga kwange okujjuvu kwandibadde nkizo ey’omukisa era ey’ekitiibwa. “lino ekkubo temuliyitangamu” — oboolyawo bw’oli bw’otyo. Naye leero nkizo yo ey’essanyu okulaga, nga bw’otolagangako, obwesige bwo obwesigwa mu Mukama. Tandika naye obulamu obw’okukkiriza, obubeerwamu n’okwesiga okujjuvu ng’okw’omwana omuto. Wamwesiga mu bintu bitono, era teyakulemererwa. Kaakano mwesige mu buli kintu. Laba oba tagenda kukukolera kusinga byonna by’oyinza okusaba oba okulowooza. Tekiriba lwa maanyi go, wabula lwa maanyi ge ag’ekitalo. Ago ge galikola mu ggwe byonna by’asiima mu kwagala kwe okw’omukisa. Weesiga Mukama okufuga obutonde bwonna n’ebitonde byonna. Ensonga yo eyinza okuba enzibu okusinga ebyo? Teweetaaga kweraliikirira ngeri gy’agifugamu. Okubuusabuusa okutasaana ng’okwo kuggweewo! Weesige Katonda wo. Laba ebizibu byonna bwe binaabulawo amangu ennyo mu maaso g’okusalawo okunywevu okw’okukkiriza. Weesige mu kizikiza, mu kitangaala, ekiro, n’enkya. Ojja kukizuula nti, newaakubadde okukkiriza kuyinza okutandika ng’okufuba okw’amaanyi, kujja kufuuka empisa ey’obutonde ey’omwoyo. Byonna bisoboka eri Katonda. Makko 9:23: “Obanga osobola! Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza.” “Okukkiriza, mu biseera eby’edda, kwe kwakola eby’abo ‘abaawangula bakabaka olw’okukkiriza, be baakola eby’obutuukirivu, be baafuna ebyasuubizibwa, era be baabuniza obumwa bw’empologoma, be baazikiza omuliro ogw’amaanyi, be baawona obwogi bw’ekitala. Be baaweebwa amaanyi okuva mu bunafu, era be baafuuka abazira ab’amaanyi mu ntalo, ne bagoba amaggye g’amawanga.’ Era okukkiriza kusobola okukikola nate.” Mukama waffe agamba nti, “Olw’okukkiriza kwammwe okutono. Kubanga ddala ddala mbagamba nti, bwe muba n’okukkiriza okufaanana ng’akaweke ka kaladaali, mwandiyinzizza okugamba olusozi luno nti, ‘Vvaawo wano,’ era ne luvaawo era tewandibaddewo kye mulemwa.” Matayo 17:20. Bw’oba oli mwana wa Katonda, oteekwa okuba n’okukkiriza waakiri okwenkana akaweke ka kaladaali. N’olwekyo toyinza kuddamu kugamba nti tosobola kwesiga kubanga tolina kukkiriza. Gamba nti, “Nsobola okwesiga Mukama wange, era nja kumwesiga. Amaanyi gonna ag’ensi oba ag’omu ggeyeena tegalimpaliriza kubuusabuusa Omununuzi wange ow’ekitiibwa era omwesigwa!” Ekintu ekisinga obukulu mu kyasa kino, okusumululwa kw’abaddu baffe, lye ssomo ddene ku kukkiriza. Abaddu baafuna eddembe lyabwe olw’okukkiriza, nga naffe bwe tuteekwa okufuna eryaffe. Baafuna amawulire amalungi nti gavumenti yali erangiridde eddembe lyabwe. Baafuuka ba ddembe mu kaseera Ekirango lwe kyafulumizibwa. Naye tebaakikkiriza ddala okutuusa lwe baawulira amawulire amalungi. Ekituufu kyalina okusooka. Naye baalina okukkiriza nga ekituufu tekinnabagasa. Enneewulira yandiddiridde ku nkomerero. Eno ye nkola ya Katonda bulijjo, era ye nkola ey’amagezi ag’obuntu. I. Ekituufu. II. Okukkiriza. III. Enneewulira. Naye omuntu akyusa enkola eno n’agamba nti: I. Enneewulira. II. Okukkiriza. III. Ekituufu. Oluusi twalowooza nti tuli ba ddembe, ate oluusi nti tetuli. Naye kaakano, nnyabo, bw’oba okakasa nti tuli ba ddembe, oyinza okuntegeeza byonna ku nsonga eno?” Bwe yalaba nti kyali kyetaago kya ddala, omukyala n’annyonnyola byonna omukyala oyo omwavu. Yamubuulira ku lutalo, ku ggye ery’e Bukiikakkono, ne ku Abraham Lincoln. Yamubuulira ku Kirango kye eky’Okusumulula Abaddu n’eddembe lye kyaleeta. Omuddu oyo omwavu yawuliriza ng’ayaayaana nnyo. Yawulira amawulire amalungi. Yagakkiriza. Era olugero bwe lwaggwa, n’afuluma mu kisenge ng’alina empisa ey’omuntu atafugibwa muntu yenna, ng’agenda ayogera nti, — “Ndi wa ddembe! Sikyasigala na mukama oyo ow’edda!” Yali afunye eddembe lye ku nkomerero, era yali alifunye olw’okukkiriza. Gavumenti yali emulangiridde nga wa ddembe dda nnyo. Naye ekyo tekyamugasa. Yali takkirizanga kirango ekyo. Amawulire amalungi tegaamugasa, kubanga oyo eyagawulira yali tagatabudde na kukkiriza — nga bali abaawulira ekigambo naye “baalema okukkiriza ekigambo kye baawulira, era tebaalina kye baagasibwa.” Naye kaakano yakkiriza, era olw’okukkiriza, n’agumira okwebala nga wa ddembe. Era kino tekyava ku nkyukakyuka yonna mu ye oba mu mbeera ze, wadde ku nneewulira yonna ey’omu mutima gwe. Wabula kyava ku kuba nti yeesiga omulala — oyo eyajja gy’ali n’amawulire ag’eddembe lye. Nneetaaga okulaga engeri kino gye kitukwatako? Mu bubaka bwa mirundi kikumi, Katonda alangiridde eddembe lyaffe. Atukubiriza okwerowooza nga ba ddembe. Kale okukkiriza kwo kukwate ekirango kye, era kakase nti kya mazima. Langirira gy’oli ggwe kennyini, eri mikwano gyo, ne mu kyama ky’omwoyo gwo eri Katonda, nti oli wa ddembe. Gaana okuwuliriza n’akaseera akamu ebigambo eby’obulimba ebya mukama wo ow’edda nti okyali muddu we. Waleme kubaawo kikumalamu maanyi, wadde enneewulira ez’omunda oba obubonero obw’ebweru. Nywerera ku by’okkiriza wadde nga buli kimu kikuziyiza. Nkusuubiza, ku buyinza bwa Mukama waffe, nti ojja kulaba nga kikolebwa ng’okukkiriza kwo bwe kuli. Mu kusinza kwonna kwe tuyinza okuleetera Katonda waffe, tewali kumuwoomera nga kuno — okwesiga kwaffe okujjuvu okwewaayo ddala. Tewali kumuleetera kitiibwa kingi bwe kityo. Mu buli ssaawa ey’ekizikiza, jjukira kino: “mujja kusanga ebizibu bya ngeri nnyingi okumala akaseera.” Kiri bwe kityo. “Kubanga okugezesebwa kw’okukkiriza kwammwe, kwa muwendo mungi nnyo okusinga zaabu egezebwa mu muliro n’ekakasibwa, kulyoke kusaanire ettendo n’ekitiibwa n’okugulumizibwa ku lunaku luli Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo lw’alirabikirako.”

fields.title: Ebizibu ku Kusalawo kw’Omuntu
fields.body_html:
Omwana wa Katonda bw’amala okwewaayo eri Kristo ng’amwesiga, ayinza okumanya essanyu ly’obulamu obukwekeddwa wamu ne Kristo mu Katonda. Naye wayinza okujjawo obuzibu obupya. Emirembe n’okuwummula by’asooka okufuna bwe bimala okuggwerera, n’awulira ng’ebyo by’ayitamu tebiriimu mazima n’akatono. Bwe kiba nti enneewulira ezo tezajja, yeewulira nga munnanfuusi olw’okulowooza nti bya mazima. Alowooza nti okukkiriza kwe kwa ku ngulu, kwa mu kamwa kwokka. N’olwekyo tekulina mugaso. Okwewaayo kwe tekuva ku mutima, n’olwekyo tekuyinza kusanyusa Katonda.

Atya okugamba nti wa Mukama, kubanga kiyinza obutaba kya mazima. Kyokka tayinza kukyegaana, kubanga akyegomba nnyo. Obuzibu buno bwa ddala era bumalamu amaanyi. Naye bujja kuwangulwa mangu. Omukristaayo ateekwa okutegeera obulamu obupya n’ayiga okubutambuliramu. Abantu balowooza nti “obulamu bwammwe bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda” kitegeeza okwesiga enneewulira.

N’olwekyo emmeeme ezimalirako amaaso. Bwe zibaamu okumatiza, emmeeme ewummula. Bwe zitaba bwe zityo, ebulwa emirembe. Naye amazima gali nti obulamu buno tebutambulirwa mu nneewulira. Butambulirwa mu kusalawo. N’olwekyo enneewulira ezikyukakyuka tezikosa bulamu buno — singa okusalawo kunywera mu kifo kyakwo ekituufu, kwe kwagala kwa Katonda.

Okukinnyonnyola obulungi, nteekwa okugaziyako katono. Fenelon agamba awamu nti “eddiini entukuvu ebeera mu kusalawo kwokka.” Ategeeza nti okusalawo ge maanyi agafuga mu butonde bw’omuntu. Okusalawo bwe kutereezebwa, obutonde bwe bwonna buteekwa okukwatagana nakwo. Bwe njogera ku kusalawo, sitegeeza kwegomba kw’omuntu wadde ekigendererwa kye. Ntegeeza okulonda, amaanyi agasalawo — kabaka buli kimu mu muntu ky’ateekwa okugondera. Mu bufunze, gwe muntu yennyini, “Nze,” ekyo kye tuwulira nti ye ffe ffennyini. Oluusi abantu balowooza nti enneewulira ze zifuga obutonde bwaffe. Naye mu bye tuyiseemu tumanyi nti waliwo ekintu munda mu ffe. Kiri emabega w’enneewulira zaffe n’okwegomba kwaffe. Ye nze eyeetongodde, esalawo era efuga buli kimu.

Enneewulira zaffe zaffe. Tuzibonaabonamu era tuzisanyukiramu. Naye si ze ffe ffennyini. Katonda bw’aba wa kututwala ffenna, ateekwa okuyingira mu kusalawo kwaffe okw’omunda, mu buntu bwaffe obwennyini. Bw’afugira eyo olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo we, obutonde bwaffe bwonna buteekwa okumugondera. Okusalawo nga bwe kuli, n’omuntu bw’ali bw’atyo. Amazima gano gakwatagana nnyo n’obuzibu bwe ndowoozaako. Emirundi mingi okusalawo kwaffe kukontana n’enneewulira zaffe. Bwe twesiga enneewulira zaffe, tuyinza okwewulira nga bannanfuusi.

Twandibadde tulangirira nti kya mazima ekyo okusalawo kwaffe kwokka kye kusazeewo. Naye bwe tulaba okusalawo nga ye kabaka, tetujja kufaayo ku kwemulugunya kwonna. Tujja kukkiriza bye kusazeewo nga bya mazima, enneewulira ne bwe zinajeema zitya.

Mmanyi nti ensonga eno nzibu. Naye nkulu nnyo mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza. N’olwekyo nkwegayirira, omusomi omwagalwa, ogumiikirize nayo okutuusa lw’onoogitegeerera ddala. Ekyokulabirako kiyinza okuyamba. Waaliwo omuvubuka eyali ayagala ennyo okutandika obulamu obupya, era yali mugezi nnyo.

Naye yali muddu w’omuze ogw’amaanyi ogw’okubuusabuusa. Kino kyamuggyangamu amaanyi. Mu nneewulira ze, tewaali kyalabika nga kya mazima oba kya ddala. Gye yakoma okufuba, byonna gye byakoma okulabika ng’ebitali bya ddala. N’abuulirwa ekyama ky’okusalawo. Kyali kino: bw’asalawo okukkiriza, okusalawo kwe akuteeke ku ludda lw’okukkiriza. Mu bufunze, ateekwa okugamba nti, “Nsazeewo okukkiriza!” Nzikiriza!” Teyalina kweraliikirira lwa nneewulira ze. Oluvannyuma zandizze ne zikwatagana.

“Ki!” bwe yagamba, “Otegeeza nti nsobola okusalawo okukkiriza ekyo, so nga tewali kirabika nga kya mazima gye ndi? “Okukkiriza okwo kunaaba kwa ddala?” “Yee. Omulimu gwo gwe guno: teeka okusalawo kwo ku ludda lwa Katonda mu nsonga eno ey’okukkiriza. Bw’onookola bw’otyo, Katonda ajja kukwata okusalawo okwo n’akufuga. Ajja kukola mu ggwe, akwagazise by’ayagala. Mangu ddala ojja kulaba nti obutonde bwo bwonna abuleese wansi we.” “Kale,” bwe yaddamu, “Kino nsobola okukikola?

Enneewulira zange sisobola kuzifuga. Naye okusalawo kwange nsobola okukufuga. Obulamu obupya bulabika nga busoboka, bwe kiba nti okusalawo kwange kwokka kwe kwetaaga okutereezebwa. “Nsobola okuwaayo okusalawo kwange eri Katonda, era nkuwaayo!” Okuva mu kaseera ako, n’atafaayo ku nneewulira ze.

Zaamulumirizanga nti munnanfuusi. Omuvubuka ono n’anywerera ku kye yasalawo. Buli kulumirizibwa yakuddangamu n’okukkiriza okunywevu. Yasalawo okukkiriza; yagenderera okukkiriza; era yakkiriza. Oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ntono, n’awangula. Buli nneewulira na buli kirowoozo kaakano byali bigondera amaanyi amangi ag’Omwoyo wa Katonda ow’ekitiibwa. Yali awadde Katonda okusalawo kwe.

Yanywerera ku kukkiriza kwe awatali kubuusabuusa. Kyokka yawuliranga nga talina kukkiriza kwa ddala kw’okunywererako. Emirundi egimu kyamumalangamu amaanyi gonna ag’okusalawo kwe okugamba nti akkiriza, kubanga kyali kikontana nnyo n’ebyo byonna by’awulira ne by’ategeera. Naye yamanya nti okusalawo kwe, ku nkomerero, ye yennyini. Bwe yakukuumanga ku ludda lwa Katonda, yabanga akola byonna by’asobola. Katonda yekka ye yali ayinza okukyusa enneewulira ze oba okufuga obulamu bwe. Ebyavaamu bwe bumu ku bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obusinga ekitiibwa bwe mmanyi. Bulamu bwa bwangu bwa kitalo, bwa butereevu, era bulina amaanyi ku kibi. Ekyama kiri wano wennyini. Okusalawo kwaffe, ensibuko y’ebikolwa byaffe byonna, mu mbeera yaakwo ey’obutonde kufugibwa okwerowoozaako. Era okwerowoozaako kubadde kukukozesa mu ffe okutuleetera okuzikirira n’ennaku. Kaakano Katonda agamba nti, “Mweweereyo ddala gyendi, ng’abantu abalamu abaava mu bafu. Nja kukolera mu mmwe, mbaagazise era mbasobozese okukola bye njagala, olw’okunsanyusa.”

Bwe twewaayo, mu kaseera ako kennyini atutwala. Akola mu ffe “ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo Noolwekyo abooluganda mbeegayirira olw’okusaasira kwa Katonda, muwengayo emibiri gyammwe nga ssaddaaka ennamu entukuvu esanyusa Katonda, kwe kuweereza kwammwe okw’omwoyo. “So temwefaananyirizanga ba mirembe gino, naye mukyusibwe olw’okudda obuggya mu birowoozo byammwe okukakasibwa okusiimibwa kwa Katonda, okusanyusa era okw’amazima. (Abaruumi 12:1-2.) Ka tutwale ekyokulabirako ekirala. Waaliwo omukyala, eyali akwekeddwa wamu ne Kristo, eyayolekagana n’okugezesebwa okw’amaanyi. Buli nneewulira munda mu ye yakujeemera. Singa yali atutte enneewulira ze nga ye kabaka we, yandiggweemu essuubi. Naye yali ayize ekyama kino eky’okusalawo. Bwe yamanya nti, mu buntu bwe obw’omunda, yali alonze Katonda by’amwagaliza, n’atafaayo ku nneewulira ze.

Buli kirowoozo eky’okweraliikirira ku kugezesebwa okwo yakiddangamu ebigambo, ng’abiddiŋŋana emirundi n’emirundi, “By’oyagala bikolebwe!” By’oyagala bikolebwe!” Yasalawo okugonza okusalawo kwe eri okwa Katonda. By’ayagala byandibadde, era byali, essanyu lye. Mu bbanga ttono nnyo, buli kirowoozo kyali kigonze. Yalaba n’enneewulira ze nga zisanyukira Katonda by’ayagala.

Era waaliwo omukyala omulala eyalina ekibi ekyamusibanga, kye yayagalanga ennyo mu nneewulira ze, naye nga mu kusalawo kwe akikyawa. Yali alowooza nti ateekwa okufuga enneewulira ze. N’olwekyo yalowooza nti tasobola kuziwangula okuggyako ng’enneewulira ze zisoose kukyuka. Naye n’ayiga ekyama eky’okusalawo. N’afukamira, n’agamba nti, “Mukama, olaba nti mu kitundu kimu eky’obutonde bwange, ekibi kino nkyagala. Naye mu nze yennyini ow’amazima, nkikyawa.” Era kaakano okusalawo kwange nkuteeka ku ludda lwo mu nsonga eno. Sijja kukikola nate. Ggwe kale ndokola.”

Amangwago Katonda n’atwala okusalawo kwe yali amuwaddeyo. N’atandika okukola mu ye. Awo by’ayagala ne bifuga enneewulira ze. N’alaba ng’alokoleddwa, si lwa kiragiro kya bweru, wabula lwa maanyi ga munda.

Omwoyo wa Katonda yali akola mu ye ekyo ekisiimibwa mu maaso ge. Era kaakano, Omukristaayo omwagalwa, ka nkulage engeri y’okukozesa amazima gano mu buzibu bwo. Lekera awo okulowooza ku nneewulira zo. Ziri baweereza buweereza. Okusalawo kwo ye kabaka wa ddala mu ggwe. N’olwekyo kwe kuba ossaako omwoyo. Kuweereddwayo eri Katonda? Kuteekeddwa mu mikono gye? Okusalawo kwo kusalawo okukkiriza? Okusalawo kwo kulonda okugondera? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, kale oli mu mikono gya Mukama, era osalawo okukkiriza, era olonda okugondera; kubanga okusalawo kwo ye ggwe kennyini. Era ekintu kiwedde. Endagaano ne Katonda ya mazima ddala ng’okusalawo kwo kwokka kwe kukola, nga bw’eba ya mazima nga buli nneewulira ekkiriziganya nakwo.

Gy’oli tekirabika nga kya mazima kyenkana awo; naye mu maaso ga Katonda kya mazima kyenkana awo. Bw’ozuula ekyama kino, tokyetaaga kufaayo ku nneewulira zo. Ssaayo omwoyo ku kusalawo kwo kwokka. Olwo ebiragiro byonna eby’Ebyawandiikibwa bifuuka ebisoboka gy’oli. Mu byo mwe muli: okwewaayo eri Katonda, okuba ssaddaaka ennamu, okubeera mu Kristo, okutambulira mu kitangaala, n’okufiira okwerowoozaako. Omanyi nti okusalawo kwo kusobola okukola era ne kutwala oludda lwa Katonda mu bino byonna. Naye singa enneewulira zo ze zaali zirina okubikola, wandiggweemu essuubi, kubanga omanyi nti tezifugika. N’olwekyo bw’owulira ng’eby’olimu si bya ddala oba ng’oli munnanfuusi, teweeraliikirira. Ezo nneewulira zo zokka, era tezisaanira wadde okulowoozebwako akaseera akatono. Kakasa bukakasa nti okusalawo kwo kuli mu mikono gya Katonda. Weewaayo eri omulimu gwe. Londa oludda lwe, olekere awo.

Enneewulira zo eziyiikayiika, ng’eryato eriyuuguumizibwa amayengo, ziteekwa okugondera okusika okunywevu. Ago ge maanyi ga Katonda, ge walonda okwesibako. Enneewulira zo ziteekwa okuwambibwa, ne zimwewa obwesigwa bwazo. Ojja kukakasa nti kya mazima ekigambo kino: “Buli ayagala okukola Katonda by’ayagala, ategeera obanga bye njigiriza byange ku bwange oba bya Katonda.”

Okusalawo kuli nga maama ow’amagezi mu kisenge ky’abaana; enneewulira ziri ng’ekibinja ky’abaana abaleekaana era abakaaba. Maama asalawo engeri gy’agenda okukolamu, gy’alowooza nti ye ntuufu era esinga obulungi. Abaana bagireekaanirako, ne bagamba nti tebajja kukkiriza. Naye maama, ng’amanyi nti y’afuga, asigala mukkakkamu.

Ng’okuleekaana kw’abaana tekumunyeenya, agezaako okubakkakkanya. Ku nkomerero, abaana bateekwa okugonda ne bakkiriza ky’asazeewo.

Bwe butyo obutebenkevu n’okukwatagana bwe bikuumibwa. Naye singa maama oyo yalowooza nti abaana be bafuzi, akavuyo kandifuze. Ebyokulabirako ng’ebyo bimanyiddwa mu maka! Era emmeeme mmeka, mu kaseera kano kennyini, ezitabuddwatabuddwa? Kiri bwe kityo kubanga enneewulira ze zifuga, so si kusalawo! Kale jjukira nti okusalawo kwo kwe kulamula ekya mazima.
