Mmaze emyaka gino esatu egy’entiisa nga nneegayirira Katonda ansonyiwe.” “Era tewakkiririzaako nti ddala yakusonyiwa?” omukyala bwe yabuuza. “Nedda,” omusajja oyo ow’ennaku bwe yaddamu, “nnyinza ntya, kubanga sawuliranga nti yansonyiwa?” “Naye singa yali agambye nti akusonyiye, ekyo tekyandibadde kirungi kyenkanyi n’okukiwulira?”

“Ayi, weewaawo,” omusajja bwe yaddamu, “Katonda singa akyogera, kya lwatu nnandikikkirizza.” “Kale bulungi, ddala akyogera,” omukyala bwe yaddamu, n’akyusa mu Bayibuli n’atuuka ku lunyiriri lwe tubadde tulaba waggulu. “bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okutusonyiwa n’okutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna.”(1 Yokaana 1:9) n’alusoma mu ddoboozi eriwulikika. “Kaakano,” bwe yeeyongerayo, “okumala emyaka esatu obadde oyatula ekibi kyo. Ekiseera kyonna ekyo ekigambo kya Katonda kibadde kirangirira nti ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okukusonyiwa n’okukunaazaako. Naye tokikkirizangako wadde omulundi gumu.”

Ekiseera kyonna kino obadde ‘ofuula Katonda mulimba’ ng’ogaana okukkiriza ekyo ky’ayogedde.”

Omusajja oyo ow’ennaku n’alaba ensonga yonna. N’asamaalirira era n’atya nnyo. Omukyala bwe yamusaba bafukamire, n’agondera ng’omuntu atamanyi gy’alaga. Yali ayagala atule ebibi bye eby’emabega, era awo wennyini yeetwalire okusonyiyibwa n’okunaazibwa. Naye ebyavaamu byali bya kitiibwa. Mu kaseera katono omusana ne gwakira mu ye, n’abaguka okutendereza olw’okununulibwa okwo okw’ekitalo. Mu ddakiika ssatu, emmeeme ye, mu kukkiriza, n’etambula olugendo oluwanvu era olukooya olw’emyaka esatu. Ne yeesanga ng’awummulidde mu Yesu, ng’ajaguza mu bulokozi bwe obujjuvu.

Ekyokulabirako ekirala kyali kya mukyala Omukristaayo. Yali amaze mu bulokozi buno nga wiiki bbiri, ng’alina obulamu obumasamasa obw’obuwanguzi. Amangu ago, ku nkomerero y’ekiseera ekyo, obusungu obw’amaanyi ne bumubuubuukamu ne bumuwangula. Okumala akaseera, amataba g’okuggwaamu amaanyi ne gayiika ku mmeeme ye. Omulabe n’agamba nti, “Laba kaakano, kino kiraga nti byonna byali nsobi. Kya lwatu obadde olimbibwa mu nsonga eno yonna, era tewayingirangako n’akatono mu bulamu obw’okwesiga okujjuvu.

Kirungi olekere awo bulekezi. Toyinza kwewaayo wadde okwesiga okusinga bwe wakola omulundi guno. N’olwekyo kyeyoleka bulungi nti obulamu buno obw’obutukuvu si bwa ggwe!” Ebirowoozo bino byayita mu mutwe gwe mu kaseera katono nnyo. Naye yali ayigirizibwa bulungi mu makubo ga Katonda. N’olwekyo n’agamba nti, “Weewaawo, nnyonoonye, era kya nnaku nnyo.” Naye Bayibuli egamba nti bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, Katonda ajja kutusonyiwa. Ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu. Era ajja kutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna. Nzikiriza nti ajja kukikola.” Teyalwa. Obusungu nga bukyamwesera munda, yadduka, so si kutambula, n’ayingira mu kisenge abeere yekka. Bwe yafukamira ku mabbali g’ekitanda, n’agamba nti, “Mukama, njatula ekibi kyange.” Nnyonoonye, era ne mu kaseera kano kennyini nkyayonoona.

Nkikyawa, naye sisobola kukyeggyako. Nkyatula eri Katonda n’ensonyi era n’obuswavu bungi. Era kaakano nzikiriza nti, ng’ekigambo kyo bwe kigamba, ddala onsonyiwa era ddala onnaazaako.” Yakyogerera waggulu, kubanga akavuyo ak’omunda kaali kangi nnyo, nga tekisoboka kukyogerera mu mutima. Ebigambo “Ddala onsonyiwa era ddala onnaazaako” bwe byava ku mimwa gye, okununulibwa ne kujja. Mukama n’agamba nti, “ N’azuukuka n’aboggolera omuyaga n’agamba ennyanja nti, “Tteeka, sirika.” Omuyaga ne gusirika n’ennyanja n’eteekera ddala.” (Makko 4:39) era ennyanja n’eteekera ddala. Amataba g’omusana n’essanyu ne gabaguka mu mmeeme ye, omulabe n’adduka, era n’awangula n’okukirawo ku bw’oyo eyamwagala. Ekibi n’eddagala lyakyo byatwala ddakiika ttaano zokka. Kaakano ebigere bye byatambula ku kkubo ettukuvu ery’omukisa nga binywevu okusinga bwe byali bibadde. Bwe kityo Ekiwonvu kya Akoli ne kifuuka oluggi olw’essuubi. N’ayimba oluyimba lwe olw’okununulibwa, nga lulina amakulu agasingawo obuziba: “Awo Musa n’abaana ba Isirayiri ne bayimbira Mukama oluyimba luno nga bagamba nti, “Nnaayimbiranga Mukama, kubanga awangudde n’ekitiibwa kingi. Asudde mu nnyanja embalaasi n’omwebagazi waayo.” (Okuva 15:1) Mu buzibu bwonna, eddagala lyokka kwe kwesiga Mukama. Obanga kino kye kyokka kye tuyinza okukola, si kirungi okukikola amangu ago? Emirundi mingi ekibuuzo kino kinnyimirizza bunnambiro: “Kale, kiki kye nnyinza okukola okuggyako okwesiga?” Amangu ago ne ntegeera obusirusiru bw’okunoonya okununulibwa mu ngeri endala yonna. Ne ndowooza nti, “Ku nkomerero nja kuba ndina okwesiga. “Kale, lwaki sikikola kaakano?” Twayingira mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza. Bwe tulemererwa, engeri yokka gye tuyinza okudda engulu eteekwa okuba okweyongera mu kukkiriza, so si kukendeera.

Buli kulemererwa, bwe kubaawo, kukuddusenga eri Mukama. Weewaayo gy’ali era omwesige ddala. Wadde okulemererwa kuno kwa nnaku, tekujja kukomya kuwummula kwo wadde okussa kimu kwo okulungi naye. Nkulaze engeri y’okuwona okulemererwa. Kaakano njagala okwogera ku bireeta okulemererwa mu bulamu buno obw’obulokozi obujjuvu.

Ebireeta okulemererwa tebiri mu maanyi g’okukemebwa, wadde mu bunafu bwaffe, era okusinga byonna tebiri mu kubulwa kwonna mu maanyi g’Omulokozi waffe wadde mu kwagala kwe okutulokola. Ekisuubizo eri Isirayiri kyali kikakafu: “ Tewali n’omu alisobola kubaziyiza ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwo; nga bwe nabeeranga ne Musa era bwe ntyo bwe nnaabeeranga naawe, sirikuleka wadde okukwabuulira. ” (Yoswa 1:5). Era n’ekisuubizo gye tuli kikakafu kyenkanyi: “ Tewali kukemebwa kubatuukako okutali kwa bantu; kyokka Katonda mwesigwa, kubanga taabalekenga kutuukibwako kukemebwa kwe mutayinza kugumira, naye anaabasobozesanga okubigumira, n’abalaga n’ekkubo ery’okubiwangula.” 1 Abakkolinso 10:13) Abayisirayiri ng’enkumi ssatu ne boolekera Ayi, kyokka abasajja be Ayi ne babafubutula emisinde Tegaali maanyi ga mulabe waabwe, so ne Katonda teyali abalekedde awo. Okuwangulwa kwabwe kwalina ensonga endala, Mukama gy’alangirira: “Isirayiri eyonoonye kubanga bavudde ku ndagaano gye nabakuutira,

ne batwala ku bintu ebiwonge, ne babitabika mu byabwe ate ne balimba.”

“Abayisirayiri tebayinza kwolekera balabe baabwe, babadduka buddusi.” Kyali kibi ekikwekeddwa ekyabawangula. Wansi mu ttaka, mu weema emu mu ggye eryo eddene, mwalimu ekintu Katonda kye yali awakanya.

Ekintu kino ekyakwekebwa kyafuula eggye lyonna obutaba na maanyi mu maaso g’abalabe baabwe. Isirayiri yagambibwa nti, “Waliwo ebikwekeddwa mu mmwe; okuggyako nga mubikwekula temuyinza kuwangula balabe bammwe.”

Okuyigiriza kuli kuti: Ekibi kyonna ekikwekeddwa mu mitima gyaffe, ne bwe kiba kitono kitya, kijja kutusuula mu maaso g’abalabe baffe. Obukaawu bwonna bwe tukuumira mu mutima, okusalira abalala emisango n’obukambwe, oba obugayaavu mu kugondera Mukama, bijja kulemaza obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo. Bwe bityo bwe bikola n’emize gyonna egibuusibwabuusibwa oba embeera gye tubeeramu. Tuyinza okuba nga twakweka ekibi mu mitima gyaffe.

Tuyinza okuba nga twakibikkako, ne tugaana okukiraba. Naye mu kyama tukimanyi.

Tuyinza okukibuusa amaaso ne tulangirira nti twesiga mu bujjuvu. Tuyinza okweyongera okunyiikira mu mirimu gyaffe egy’eddiini. Tuyinza okulaba amazima n’obulungi ebisingawo mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza. Tuyinza okulabika ng’abawangudde, mu maaso gaffe ffekka ne mu maaso g’abalala.

Kyokka tuyinza okuwangulwa mu ngeri ey’obulumi. Tuyinza okwewuunya, okubuuza, okuggwaamu essuubi, n’okusaba. Naye tewali kijja kutuyamba okutuusa ng’ekintu ekiwonge kisimiddwayo, ne kireetebwa mu kitangaala, ne kiteekebwa mu maaso ga Katonda. Omukkiriza abeera mu bulamu obw’omunda bw’awangulwa, alina okunoonya ensonga. Si maanyi ga mulabe. Kye kibuze ekikwekeddwa mu kwewaayo kwe, munda ddala mu ye.

Okulumwa omutwe si bulwadde, wabula kabonero ka bulwadde. Obulwadde obwo buba mu kitundu ekirala eky’omubiri. Bwe kityo ne mu Mukristaayo, ekibi kabonero kokka. Kyoleka obubi obuyinza okuba nga buli mu kitundu ekirala eky’obulamu bwe.

Oluusi omuntu ayinza okukweka obubi ne mu kintu ekirabika ng’ekirungi bw’okitunuulira amangu. Emabega w’okwegomba ennyo amazima wayinza okukwekebwa omuze ogw’okusalira abalala emisango oba okwekubiira ku ndowooza zaffe ffekka. Obwesigwa obw’Ekikristaayo obweyoleka obulungi buyinza okukweka obutaba na kwagala kwa Kikristaayo. Wansi w’okufaayo ku nsonga zaffe okulabika ng’okutuufu, tuyinza okukweka obutesiga Katonda obungi. Omukulembeze waffe ow’omukisa, Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe, aliwo. Ebintu bino abitulaga mu kyama, ng’ayita mu kutuluma okutonotono okw’omuntu ow’omunda. Bwe tutyo tetusigazaawo kya kwekwasa. Kyangu okubuusa amaaso eddoboozi lye eriteefu, ne twekakasa nti byonna biri bulungi. Kino kijja kukweka mu ffe obubi obutta, ne kituleetera okuwangulwa kwe tutasuubira.

Ekyokulabirako ekirungi ennyo eky’ekyo kyantuukako lumu mu kulabirira amaka gange. Nnasengukira mu nnyumba empya. Bwe nnali ngyekebejja okulaba obanga eyetegese, ne nsanga mu kisenge ekiri wansi w’ennyumba ekipipa ekiyonjo ennyo omwaterekebwanga omubisi gw’ebibala. Kyali kisibiddwa emitwe gyombi. Ne nneebuuza obanga nkiggye mu kisenge ekyo nkiggule. Kyalabika nga temuli kantu, era nga kirungi okulaba. N’olwekyo ne nsalawo okukireka, kubanga kyandibadde kizibu nnyo okukyambusa amadaala. Saawulira mirembe ddala, naye ne nsindika eri okubuusabuusa kwange ne nkireka. Buli mwaka, mu biseera ebibiri eby’okulongoosa ennyumba, nnajjukiranga ekipipa ekyo. Omuntu wange ow’omunda, ow’omukyala alabirira amaka, n’ambeeranga bubi. Saasobolanga kuwummula mu nnyumba nnongoofu ddala nga kikyali tekiggulwanga. Kubanga nnali mmanyi ntya nti tekyakweka bubi bwonna wansi w’endabika yaakyo ennungi?

Kyokka ne nkkakkanya okubuusabuusa kwange. Nnatya obuzibu bw’okukyekebejja. Okumala emyaka ebiri oba esatu, ekipipa ekyo ekyalabika ng’ekitaliiko kabi kyasigala mu kisenge kyange ekya wansi. Olwo, mu ngeri etannyonnyoleka n’akatono, ebiwojjolo ne bitandika okujjula ennyumba yange. Nnakozesa buli ngeri yonna okubyekuuma era ne nfuba nnyo okubimalawo, naye nga bwereere. Byeyongera mangu nnyo ne byagala okwonoona buli kye nnalina.

Ne ndowooza nti kapeti zange ze zibireeta, ne nziyonja nnyo. Ne ndowooza nti waliwo ekikyamu ku ntebe n’ebintu ebirala eby’omu nnyumba, ne mbizza buggya. Ne nteebereza ebintu ebya buli ngeri ebitasoboka.

Ku nkomerero, ekirowoozo ky’ekipipa ne kinjijira. Ne ndagira kiggyibwe mu kisenge ekya wansi, era omutwe gwakyo ne gumenyebwa.

Ndowooza siyinza kusobya bwe ŋŋamba nti ebiwojjolo enkumi n’enkumi byafubutukamu. Eyali abeera mu nnyumba eyo nga sinnagiyingiramu ateekwa okuba nga yalekamu ekintu ekyazaala ebiwojjolo. Kino kye kyali kireeta obuzibu bwange bwonna.

Kaakano nzikiriza nti omuze oba okwesanyusa okumu, ekintu ekimu ekitono ekirabika ng’ekitaliiko kabi, kituleetera okulumwa okutonotono okw’omuntu ow’omunda. Tekyekebejjeddwa bulungi wansi w’eriiso lya Katonda erinoonya. Ndowooza kye kiri ku kikolo ky’okulemererwa okusinga obungi mu bulamu buno obwa waggulu. Si byonna ebiweereddwayo. Waliwo ensonda ey’ekyama ekuumibwa nga nsibe, Mukama aleme kugiyingiramu. N’olwekyo tetuyinza kuyimirira mu maaso g’abalabe baffe, wabula twesanga nga tukubiddwa wansi mu maaso gaabwe.

Okwewala okulemererwa, oba okuzuula ekikireeta bwe tulemererwa, tulina okubeera n’essaala eno bulijjo mu maaso gaffe: “Nkebera, Ayi Katonda, otegeere omutima gwange. Ngezesa omanye ebirowoozo byange. Olabe obanga mu nze mulimu engeri yonna enkyamu; era onkulembere mu kkubo erintuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.”

Wayinza okubaawo obulimba bungi mu nnaku gye tulaba olw’okulemererwa kwaffe. Tuyinza okulowooza nti tufaayo ku kitiibwa kya Katonda. Kyokka emmeeme zaffe ziyinza okuba nga zeeraliikirira olw’okwefaako ffekka. Tetuli batukuvu nga bwe twalowooza, era okuzuula ekyo kulumya okwagala kwe twagala ffekka. Okwennyamira kwaffe kuyinza okuba ensobi esinga ekikolwa ekibi kyennyini. Engeri yokka etaliimu kabi ey’okukwatamu okulemererwa kwaffe kwe kwewala okwefuula abatuukirivu oba okwesalira omusango.

Mu kifo ky’ekyo, tusaanidde okukuteeka mu kasirise mu maaso ga Mukama, ne tukutunuulira mu mirembe ne mu kwagala.

Abawandiisi ab’edda ab’eby’omwoyo eby’ekyama bagamba nti okukyukira Katonda mu bwangu ne mu mirembe kutuyamba okusinga okwejjusa olw’okuwaba okuva gy’ali. “Beera mwesigwa bwesigwa,” bwe bagamba. “Kyukira gy’ali yekka amangu ddala ng’olabye ekibi kyo. Okubeerawo kwe kujja kukununula mu mitego egikukwase.” Okwetunuulira wekka kukusuula wansi ennyo mu bitosi, kubanga ebitosi bino mu butuufu si kirala wabula ggwe wennyini; so ng’okutunuulira Katonda obutunuulizi kusobola okukkakkanya n’okubudaabuda omutima gwo.

Ku nkomerero, ka tuleme kwerabira, ne bwe tulemererwa tutya, nti Mukama Yesu ayinza, nga bwe kyalangirirwa, okutulokola okuva mu balabe baffe. Olwo tuyinza “okulokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe awatali kutya, tulyoke tuweereze mu maaso ge, mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.”(Lukka 1:74-75). Ka tusabe, buli omu ku ffe, emisana n’ekiro nti: “ Era omuddu wo omuwonye okukola ebibi ebigenderere, bireme kunfuga. ”(Zabbuli 19:13). “ Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi.”(Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8). Tulina okubeera abagonvu ennyo mu mikono gye, era ne tumwesiga. Olwo ajja “ abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.” (Abaebbulaniya 13:21)
fields.body_text: Omutwe gw’essuula eno gwokka guyinza okwewuunyisa abamu. “Okulemererwa,” bwe bagamba; “twalowooza nti mu bulamu buno obw’okukkiriza temuli kulemererwa!” Kino nnyinza okukiddamu nti tekisaanidde kubaawo, era tekyetaagisa kubaawo; naye mu mazima, oluusi kubaawo. Era tulina okukola ku bituufu ebiriwo, so si ku ndowooza obulowooza. Tewali muyigiriza wa bulamu buno obw’omunda agamba nti tetuyinza kwonoona; bakkaatiriza bukkaatiriza nti tekituwaliriza kwonoona. Kaakano kisoboka okuwangula bulijjo. Era batono abeegaana nti oluusi bawanguddwa okukemebwa. Kya lwatu, bwe njogera ku kibi wano, ntegeeza ekibi omuntu ky’amanyi era ky’akola ng’alaba. Sikwata ku bibi eby’obutamanya. Era sikubaganya birowoozo ku kiyitibwa ekibi eky’obutonde bwaffe ekitayinza kwewalika. Byombi bibikkiddwa okutangirira, era tebitaataaganya kussa kimu kwaffe ne Katonda. Sirina kwagala wadde obusobozi okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku njigiriza ez’ekibi; ekyo nkirekera abayivu b’eby’eddiini. Nja kwogera ku ebyo byokka omukkiriza by’ayitamu. Njagala kitegeerekeke bulungi nti nja kwogera ku ebyo byokka bye tumanyi nga bituli munda. Kale okutegeera obubi ensonga eno ey’ekibi ekimanyiddwa kya kabi eri obulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obwa waggulu. Omukkiriza eyeesiga nti ali ku kkubo ettukuvu ayinza okugwa mu kibi nga tamanyiridde. Olwo akemebwa okulekera awo ddala, oba okukweka ekibi kye. Okusobola okukuuma enjigiriza ye, ayinza okukiyita “obunafu,” n’agaana okwogera amazima. Ekkubo lyonna ku ago abiri litta ddala okukula n’okweyongera mu maaso kwonna okw’amazima mu bulamu obw’obutukuvu. Tulina okutunuulira amazima gano ag’ennaku. Tulina okugatuuma erinnya, ne tunoonya, bwe kiba kisoboka, ekigaleeta n’eddagala lyago. Obulamu buno obw’okwegatta ne Katonda bwetaaga obwesimbu obusingirayo ddala gy’ali era ne gye tuli ffekka. Ekibi kyandisobodde kutaataaganya kussa kimu okwo akaseera katono kwokka; naye obutaba beesimbu ku kyo kwandikuzikirizza ddala. Okulemererwa okw’amangu si nsonga ya kuggwaamu maanyi n’okulekera ddala byonna nga tulowooza nti byonna bifudde. So n’obutuufu bw’enjigiriza yaffe tebukwatibwako. Tetubuulira mbeera gye tutuukamu ne tusigala, wabula okutambula. Ekkubo ettukuvu si kifo, wabula kkubo. Okutukuzibwa si kintu kye tufuna nga tutuuse ku ddaala erimu mu bye tuyitamu ne tukibeera nakyo emirembe gyonna; bwe bulamu bwe tulina okubeeramu buli lunaku na buli ssaawa. Tuyinza okuwaba okuva ku kkubo akaseera katono, naye okuwaba kwaffe tekulisangulawo; tuyinza okudda amangu. Mu bulamu buno obw’okukkiriza, oluusi tuyinza okulemererwa. Okulemererwa okwo kwa nnaku era kusaana okukungubagirwa. Naye bwe tukukwata mu ngeri entuufu, tekwetaaga kutaataaganya kwesiga kwaffe okujjuvu mu Katonda, era tekusaanidde kusalako kussa kimu kwaffe okw’essanyu naye okumala ebbanga eddene. Ensonga enkulu kwe kudda eri Katonda amangu ddala. Ekibi kyaffe si nsonga ya kulekera awo kwesiga, wabula ensonga etayinza kuwakanyizibwa lwaki tulina okwesiga mu bujjuvu okusinga bwe twali twesiga. Ka kibe nti okulemererwa kwaffe kuvudde ku ki, okuggwaamu amaanyi tekujja kutuyamba. Omwana ayiga okutambula ayinza okuggwaamu essuubi ng’amaze okugwa, n’agaana okugezaako nate. Omukkiriza ayiga okubeera mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza talina kulekera awo olw’okuba ng’ayonoonye. Mu mbeera zombi, ekkubo lyokka kwe kugolokoka amangu ddala n’ogezaako nate. Oluvannyuma lw’okuwangulwa okw’entiisa. “Yoswa n’abakulembeze b’Abayisirayiri ne bayuza ebyambalo byabwe ne beesiiga enfuufu mu mitwe gyabwe era ne beeyala ku ttaka mu maaso g’Essanduuko ya Mukama okuzibya obudde. Yoswa n’agamba nti, “Mukama Katonda nga kitalo kino! Wasomosezaaki Abayisirayiri omugga Yoludaani ate n’obaleka bazikirizibwe Abamoli? Bwe twali tukyali emitala wa Yoludaani tetwaliko kabi n’akatono! Ayi Mukama, sonyiwa omuddu wo. Isirayiri alumbiddwa abalabe baabwe, nze nnaayogera ki kaakano! Abakanani n’abali mu kitundu ekyo kyonna bwe banaakiwulira bajja kutwebungulula batusaanyeewo. Olwo erinnya lyo ekkulu bwe lityo liriba terikyavuga.”(Yoswa 7:6-9) Ng’okwo kwali kukaaba kwa kuggwaamu ssuubi! Era nga kuddibwamu nnyo abaana ba Katonda bangi leero! Emitima gyabwe gisaanuuka ng’amazzi olw’okuwangulwa. Bakaaba nti, “Yoswa n’agamba nti, ‘Mukama Katonda nga kitalo kino! Wasomosezaaki Abayisirayiri omugga Yoludaani ate n’obaleka bazikirizibwe Abamoli? Bwe twali tukyali emitala wa Yoludaani tetwaliko kabi n’akatono!” Balagula okulemererwa okulala, era n’okuwangulwa abalabe baabwe. Tewali kubuusabuusa nti Yoswa yalowooza nga ffe bwe tulowooza kaakano. Oluvannyuma lw’okulemererwa okw’engeri eyo, okuggwaamu amaanyi n’okuggwaamu essuubi byalabika ng’ekyokuddamu kyokka ekirimu obukuumi. Naye Katonda yalowooza mu ngeri endala. “ Mukama n’agamba Yoswa nti, “Golokoka. Kiki ekikuvuunamizza ku ttaka? “ Tebasaanidde kwewaayo eri okuggwaamu essuubi, ne bwe kuba nga kulabika nga kwa buwombeefu. Balina okutunuulira obubi n’okubuggyawo. Kibagwanidde “beetukuze” amangu ddala.” “Golokoka otukuze abantu,” kye kiragiro kya Katonda bulijjo. “Galamira wansi oggweemu amaanyi,” kwe kukemebwa kw’omulabe bulijjo. Tuwulira nga kya kwekulumbaza, era kya bujoozi, okugenda amangu ddala eri Mukama nga tumaze okumwonoona. Tulowooza nti tusaanidde okusooka okubonaabona olw’ebiva mu bibi byaffe okumala akaseera, n’okugumiikiriza omuntu waffe ow’omunda atusalira omusango. Tetusobola kukkiriza mangu nti Mukama ayagala okutwaniriza nate mu kussa kimu naye okw’okwagala. Omuwala omuto lumu yandaga endowooza eno, mu bwesimbu obw’omwana obutaliimu kukyusakyusa. Yambuuza obanga Mukama Yesu bulijjo atusonyiwa ebibi byaffe bwe tumusaba. Ne mmuddamu nti, “Weewaawo, kya lwatu, atusonyiwa.” “Amangu ago ddala” bwe yaddamu ng’abuusabuusa. “Weewaawo,” ne mmuddamu, “mu ddakiika yennyini gye tumusabiramu, atusonyiwa.” “Kale,” bwe yagamba ng’alowoozezza, “ekyo sisobola kukikkiriza. Ndowooza yandisoose okutuleka ne tunakuwala okumala ennaku bbiri oba ssatu. Ate oluvannyuma ndowooza yanditusabizza emirundi mingi nnyo, era mu ngeri ennungi ennyo, so si mu bigambo bya bulijjo byokka. Nzikiriza nti bw’atyo bw’akola. Teweetaaga kugezaako kunkkirizisa nti ansonyiwa amangu ago, ne bwe kiba nti Bayibuli egamba ki.” Yayogera bwogezi Abakristaayo abasinga obungi kye balowooza. Ekisinga obubi, abasinga bakikolerako. Okwejjusa kwabwe kaakano kubaawula ku Katonda okusinga ekibi kyabwe bwe kyandibaawudde. Kikontana nnyo n’engeri gye twagala abaana baffe okweyisaamu, ne kinneewuunyisa engeri gye twasobola okulowooza bwe tutyo ku Katonda. Maama anakuwala nnyo omwana we omujeemu bw’agenda yekka mu nsonda ng’aggwaamu essuubi, ng’abuusabuusa obanga maama we ayagala okumusonyiwa. Naye omutima gwe gwaniriza n’essanyu omwana omwagalwa adduka gy’ali n’amwegayirira amusonyiwe! Mazima Katonda waffe yali amanyi okwagala kuno bwe yagamba nti, “ Mukomeewo mmwe abantu abatali beesigwa, nnaabawonya ne mbafuula abeesigwa. Weewaawo tujja kudda gy’oli, kubanga ggwe Mukama Katonda waffe.”(Yeremiya 3:22) Akaseera kennyini akabikkula ekibi kasaanidde okubikkula n’okusonyiyibwa. Kino kikulu nnyo eri okutambula okunywevu ku kkubo ettukuvu. Wano tetuyinza kugumiikiriza kwawukana na Katonda wadde akaseera akamu. Ekkubo lino tuyinza okulitambulirako nga tutunuulira Yesu buli kaseera. Bwe tuggya amaaso gaffe ku ye ne tutunuulira ekibi kyaffe n’obunafu bwaffe, tujja kuva ku kkubo amangu ago. Omukkiriza eyeesiga nti ali ku kkubo lino, ekibi bwe kimuwangula, alina okuddukira eri Mukama. Alina okukolera ku (1 Yokaana 1:9) “bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okutusonyiwa n’okutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna.” Talina kukweka kibi kye n’akinoonyeza obusonga okukisiigako, wadde okukigoba mu birowoozo bye ng’aleka ebbanga liyiteewo. Wabula alina okukola ng’abaana ba Isirayiri bwe baakola. Alina okugolokoka “ku makya ennyo,” era “adduke” agende ekifo ekintu ekibi gye kikwekeddwa. Olwo alina okukiggya gye kikwekeddwa n’akiteeka “mu maaso ga Mukama.” Alina okwatula ekibi kye. Oluvannyuma alina okukikuba amayinja, okukyokya, n’okukiggyawo. Ate alina okukituumako entuumu ennene ey’amayinja okukikweka emirembe gyonna. Alina, awo wennyini, okukkiriza nti Katonda waali. Alina okukkiriza, ng’ekigambo kye bwe kigamba, nti Katonda mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okumusonyiwa ekibi kye, era nti ddala akimusonyiwa. Alina n’okukkiriza nti Katonda amunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna. Alina, mu kukkiriza, okwetwalira okusonyiyibwa n’okunaazibwa amangu ddala. Olwo alina okwesiga okusinga bwe yali yeesiga. Ekibi kya Isirayiri bwe kyamala okubikkulwa n’okuggibwawo, ekigambo kya Katonda ne kijja. Bwali bubaka obuzzaamu ennyo amaanyi: “ Mukama n’agamba Yoswa nti, “Totya era tokeŋŋentererwa, ddira abasajja bonna abalwanyi mulumbe ekibuga Ayi kubanga mbawadde obuwanguzi ku kyo. Kabaka, n’abantu be, ne byonna ebiri mu kibuga Ayi mbibawadde. ”(Yoswa 8:1) Obuvumu bwaffe bulina okulinnya waggulu okusinga bwe bwali. Tulina okwesiga Mukama okusingawo. Olwo amaanyi ge amangi gasobola okukola mu ffe okutuukiriza by’ayagala. Ate era, tulina okwerabira ekibi kyaffe amangu ddala nga kimaze okwatulwa n’okusonyiyibwa bwe kityo. Tetulina kukibeera ku mutima, n’okukyekenneenya, n’okwesanyusa mu bulumi n’okwejjusa. Tetulina kukifuula kifaananyi kye tusinza, ne tukyetooloola nga tukyerolera. Ekyo kyandikifudde olusozi olutukweka Katonda waffe. Tulina okugoberera ekyokulabirako kya Pawulo, eyagamba nti kye yakola “kwe kwerabira ebyo ebiri emabega ne nduubirira ebyo ebiri mu maaso.” Olwo naffe tulina okukola nga ye bwe yagamba nti, “Nduubirira okutuuka awawakanirwa awali empeera ey’okuyita kwa Katonda okwa waggulu mu Kristo Yesu.” Njagala okuleeta ebyokulabirako bibiri ebikontana ku nsonga zino. Ekisooka kyali kya Mukristaayo omunyiikivu ennyo, eyali akola nnyo emirimu gy’ekkanisa. Okumala emyezi egiwerako, yali anyumirwa obulokozi obujjuvu. Amangu ago okukemebwa okuyisa muganda we obubi ne kumuwangula. Yali alowooza nti tekisoboka kwonoona nate, n’olwekyo n’aggwaamu nnyo amaanyi. N’asalawo nti yali mukyamu; nti teyali yeesizza ddala. Okuggwaamu amaanyi kwe ne kufuuka okuggwaamu essuubi. N’asalawo nti teyazaalibwa buggya n’akatono, ne yeetwala ng’abuze. Yamala emyaka esatu mu nnaku. Yeeyongera okuwaba okuva ku Katonda, n’agwa mu kibi kimu ne kiddirirwa ekirala. Obulamu bwe ne bufuuka kikolimo gy’ali ne eri abo abaali bamwetoolodde. Obulamu bwe ne bunafuwa nnyo wansi w’omugugu ogwo ogw’entiisa, era ne batandika okutya nti ayinza okugwa eddalu. Emyaka esatu bwe gyaggwaako, n’asisinkana omukyala Omukristaayo eyali ategeera amazima ku kibi ge mbadde ngezaako okunnyonnyola. Oluvannyuma lw’okunyumya naye akaseera katono, n’ategeera ekimuluma. N’amugamba nti, “Tewali kubuusabuusa nti wayonoona mu kikolwa ekyo. Togezaako kukyekwasa nsonga.” Naye tewakyatulirako Mukama n’omusaba akusonyiwe?” “Okukyatula!” bwe yaleekaana, “Sirina kirala kye nkoze wabula okukyatula. Mmaze emyaka gino esatu egy’entiisa nga nneegayirira Katonda ansonyiwe.” “Era tewakkiririzaako nti ddala yakusonyiwa?” omukyala bwe yabuuza. “Nedda,” omusajja oyo ow’ennaku bwe yaddamu, “nnyinza ntya, kubanga sawuliranga nti yansonyiwa?” “Naye singa yali agambye nti akusonyiye, ekyo tekyandibadde kirungi kyenkanyi n’okukiwulira?” “Ayi, weewaawo,” omusajja bwe yaddamu, “Katonda singa akyogera, kya lwatu nnandikikkirizza.” “Kale bulungi, ddala akyogera,” omukyala bwe yaddamu, n’akyusa mu Bayibuli n’atuuka ku lunyiriri lwe tubadde tulaba waggulu. “bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okutusonyiwa n’okutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna.”(1 Yokaana 1:9) n’alusoma mu ddoboozi eriwulikika. “Kaakano,” bwe yeeyongerayo, “okumala emyaka esatu obadde oyatula ekibi kyo. Ekiseera kyonna ekyo ekigambo kya Katonda kibadde kirangirira nti ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu okukusonyiwa n’okukunaazaako. Naye tokikkirizangako wadde omulundi gumu.” Ekiseera kyonna kino obadde ‘ofuula Katonda mulimba’ ng’ogaana okukkiriza ekyo ky’ayogedde.” Omusajja oyo ow’ennaku n’alaba ensonga yonna. N’asamaalirira era n’atya nnyo. Omukyala bwe yamusaba bafukamire, n’agondera ng’omuntu atamanyi gy’alaga. Yali ayagala atule ebibi bye eby’emabega, era awo wennyini yeetwalire okusonyiyibwa n’okunaazibwa. Naye ebyavaamu byali bya kitiibwa. Mu kaseera katono omusana ne gwakira mu ye, n’abaguka okutendereza olw’okununulibwa okwo okw’ekitalo. Mu ddakiika ssatu, emmeeme ye, mu kukkiriza, n’etambula olugendo oluwanvu era olukooya olw’emyaka esatu. Ne yeesanga ng’awummulidde mu Yesu, ng’ajaguza mu bulokozi bwe obujjuvu. Ekyokulabirako ekirala kyali kya mukyala Omukristaayo. Yali amaze mu bulokozi buno nga wiiki bbiri, ng’alina obulamu obumasamasa obw’obuwanguzi. Amangu ago, ku nkomerero y’ekiseera ekyo, obusungu obw’amaanyi ne bumubuubuukamu ne bumuwangula. Okumala akaseera, amataba g’okuggwaamu amaanyi ne gayiika ku mmeeme ye. Omulabe n’agamba nti, “Laba kaakano, kino kiraga nti byonna byali nsobi. Kya lwatu obadde olimbibwa mu nsonga eno yonna, era tewayingirangako n’akatono mu bulamu obw’okwesiga okujjuvu. Kirungi olekere awo bulekezi. Toyinza kwewaayo wadde okwesiga okusinga bwe wakola omulundi guno. N’olwekyo kyeyoleka bulungi nti obulamu buno obw’obutukuvu si bwa ggwe!” Ebirowoozo bino byayita mu mutwe gwe mu kaseera katono nnyo. Naye yali ayigirizibwa bulungi mu makubo ga Katonda. N’olwekyo n’agamba nti, “Weewaawo, nnyonoonye, era kya nnaku nnyo.” Naye Bayibuli egamba nti bwe twatula ebibi byaffe, Katonda ajja kutusonyiwa. Ye mwesigwa era mutuukirivu. Era ajja kutunaazaako obutali butuukirivu bwonna. Nzikiriza nti ajja kukikola.” Teyalwa. Obusungu nga bukyamwesera munda, yadduka, so si kutambula, n’ayingira mu kisenge abeere yekka. Bwe yafukamira ku mabbali g’ekitanda, n’agamba nti, “Mukama, njatula ekibi kyange.” Nnyonoonye, era ne mu kaseera kano kennyini nkyayonoona. Nkikyawa, naye sisobola kukyeggyako. Nkyatula eri Katonda n’ensonyi era n’obuswavu bungi. Era kaakano nzikiriza nti, ng’ekigambo kyo bwe kigamba, ddala onsonyiwa era ddala onnaazaako.” Yakyogerera waggulu, kubanga akavuyo ak’omunda kaali kangi nnyo, nga tekisoboka kukyogerera mu mutima. Ebigambo “Ddala onsonyiwa era ddala onnaazaako” bwe byava ku mimwa gye, okununulibwa ne kujja. Mukama n’agamba nti, “ N’azuukuka n’aboggolera omuyaga n’agamba ennyanja nti, “Tteeka, sirika.” Omuyaga ne gusirika n’ennyanja n’eteekera ddala.” (Makko 4:39) era ennyanja n’eteekera ddala. Amataba g’omusana n’essanyu ne gabaguka mu mmeeme ye, omulabe n’adduka, era n’awangula n’okukirawo ku bw’oyo eyamwagala. Ekibi n’eddagala lyakyo byatwala ddakiika ttaano zokka. Kaakano ebigere bye byatambula ku kkubo ettukuvu ery’omukisa nga binywevu okusinga bwe byali bibadde. Bwe kityo Ekiwonvu kya Akoli ne kifuuka oluggi olw’essuubi. N’ayimba oluyimba lwe olw’okununulibwa, nga lulina amakulu agasingawo obuziba: “Awo Musa n’abaana ba Isirayiri ne bayimbira Mukama oluyimba luno nga bagamba nti, “Nnaayimbiranga Mukama, kubanga awangudde n’ekitiibwa kingi. Asudde mu nnyanja embalaasi n’omwebagazi waayo.” (Okuva 15:1) Mu buzibu bwonna, eddagala lyokka kwe kwesiga Mukama. Obanga kino kye kyokka kye tuyinza okukola, si kirungi okukikola amangu ago? Emirundi mingi ekibuuzo kino kinnyimirizza bunnambiro: “Kale, kiki kye nnyinza okukola okuggyako okwesiga?” Amangu ago ne ntegeera obusirusiru bw’okunoonya okununulibwa mu ngeri endala yonna. Ne ndowooza nti, “Ku nkomerero nja kuba ndina okwesiga. “Kale, lwaki sikikola kaakano?” Twayingira mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza. Bwe tulemererwa, engeri yokka gye tuyinza okudda engulu eteekwa okuba okweyongera mu kukkiriza, so si kukendeera. Buli kulemererwa, bwe kubaawo, kukuddusenga eri Mukama. Weewaayo gy’ali era omwesige ddala. Wadde okulemererwa kuno kwa nnaku, tekujja kukomya kuwummula kwo wadde okussa kimu kwo okulungi naye. Nkulaze engeri y’okuwona okulemererwa. Kaakano njagala okwogera ku bireeta okulemererwa mu bulamu buno obw’obulokozi obujjuvu. Ebireeta okulemererwa tebiri mu maanyi g’okukemebwa, wadde mu bunafu bwaffe, era okusinga byonna tebiri mu kubulwa kwonna mu maanyi g’Omulokozi waffe wadde mu kwagala kwe okutulokola. Ekisuubizo eri Isirayiri kyali kikakafu: “ Tewali n’omu alisobola kubaziyiza ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwo; nga bwe nabeeranga ne Musa era bwe ntyo bwe nnaabeeranga naawe, sirikuleka wadde okukwabuulira. ” (Yoswa 1:5). Era n’ekisuubizo gye tuli kikakafu kyenkanyi: “ Tewali kukemebwa kubatuukako okutali kwa bantu; kyokka Katonda mwesigwa, kubanga taabalekenga kutuukibwako kukemebwa kwe mutayinza kugumira, naye anaabasobozesanga okubigumira, n’abalaga n’ekkubo ery’okubiwangula.” 1 Abakkolinso 10:13) Abayisirayiri ng’enkumi ssatu ne boolekera Ayi, kyokka abasajja be Ayi ne babafubutula emisinde Tegaali maanyi ga mulabe waabwe, so ne Katonda teyali abalekedde awo. Okuwangulwa kwabwe kwalina ensonga endala, Mukama gy’alangirira: “Isirayiri eyonoonye kubanga bavudde ku ndagaano gye nabakuutira, ne batwala ku bintu ebiwonge, ne babitabika mu byabwe ate ne balimba.” “Abayisirayiri tebayinza kwolekera balabe baabwe, babadduka buddusi.” Kyali kibi ekikwekeddwa ekyabawangula. Wansi mu ttaka, mu weema emu mu ggye eryo eddene, mwalimu ekintu Katonda kye yali awakanya. Ekintu kino ekyakwekebwa kyafuula eggye lyonna obutaba na maanyi mu maaso g’abalabe baabwe. Isirayiri yagambibwa nti, “Waliwo ebikwekeddwa mu mmwe; okuggyako nga mubikwekula temuyinza kuwangula balabe bammwe.” Okuyigiriza kuli kuti: Ekibi kyonna ekikwekeddwa mu mitima gyaffe, ne bwe kiba kitono kitya, kijja kutusuula mu maaso g’abalabe baffe. Obukaawu bwonna bwe tukuumira mu mutima, okusalira abalala emisango n’obukambwe, oba obugayaavu mu kugondera Mukama, bijja kulemaza obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo. Bwe bityo bwe bikola n’emize gyonna egibuusibwabuusibwa oba embeera gye tubeeramu. Tuyinza okuba nga twakweka ekibi mu mitima gyaffe. Tuyinza okuba nga twakibikkako, ne tugaana okukiraba. Naye mu kyama tukimanyi. Tuyinza okukibuusa amaaso ne tulangirira nti twesiga mu bujjuvu. Tuyinza okweyongera okunyiikira mu mirimu gyaffe egy’eddiini. Tuyinza okulaba amazima n’obulungi ebisingawo mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza. Tuyinza okulabika ng’abawangudde, mu maaso gaffe ffekka ne mu maaso g’abalala. Kyokka tuyinza okuwangulwa mu ngeri ey’obulumi. Tuyinza okwewuunya, okubuuza, okuggwaamu essuubi, n’okusaba. Naye tewali kijja kutuyamba okutuusa ng’ekintu ekiwonge kisimiddwayo, ne kireetebwa mu kitangaala, ne kiteekebwa mu maaso ga Katonda. Omukkiriza abeera mu bulamu obw’omunda bw’awangulwa, alina okunoonya ensonga. Si maanyi ga mulabe. Kye kibuze ekikwekeddwa mu kwewaayo kwe, munda ddala mu ye. Okulumwa omutwe si bulwadde, wabula kabonero ka bulwadde. Obulwadde obwo buba mu kitundu ekirala eky’omubiri. Bwe kityo ne mu Mukristaayo, ekibi kabonero kokka. Kyoleka obubi obuyinza okuba nga buli mu kitundu ekirala eky’obulamu bwe. Oluusi omuntu ayinza okukweka obubi ne mu kintu ekirabika ng’ekirungi bw’okitunuulira amangu. Emabega w’okwegomba ennyo amazima wayinza okukwekebwa omuze ogw’okusalira abalala emisango oba okwekubiira ku ndowooza zaffe ffekka. Obwesigwa obw’Ekikristaayo obweyoleka obulungi buyinza okukweka obutaba na kwagala kwa Kikristaayo. Wansi w’okufaayo ku nsonga zaffe okulabika ng’okutuufu, tuyinza okukweka obutesiga Katonda obungi. Omukulembeze waffe ow’omukisa, Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe, aliwo. Ebintu bino abitulaga mu kyama, ng’ayita mu kutuluma okutonotono okw’omuntu ow’omunda. Bwe tutyo tetusigazaawo kya kwekwasa. Kyangu okubuusa amaaso eddoboozi lye eriteefu, ne twekakasa nti byonna biri bulungi. Kino kijja kukweka mu ffe obubi obutta, ne kituleetera okuwangulwa kwe tutasuubira. Ekyokulabirako ekirungi ennyo eky’ekyo kyantuukako lumu mu kulabirira amaka gange. Nnasengukira mu nnyumba empya. Bwe nnali ngyekebejja okulaba obanga eyetegese, ne nsanga mu kisenge ekiri wansi w’ennyumba ekipipa ekiyonjo ennyo omwaterekebwanga omubisi gw’ebibala. Kyali kisibiddwa emitwe gyombi. Ne nneebuuza obanga nkiggye mu kisenge ekyo nkiggule. Kyalabika nga temuli kantu, era nga kirungi okulaba. N’olwekyo ne nsalawo okukireka, kubanga kyandibadde kizibu nnyo okukyambusa amadaala. Saawulira mirembe ddala, naye ne nsindika eri okubuusabuusa kwange ne nkireka. Buli mwaka, mu biseera ebibiri eby’okulongoosa ennyumba, nnajjukiranga ekipipa ekyo. Omuntu wange ow’omunda, ow’omukyala alabirira amaka, n’ambeeranga bubi. Saasobolanga kuwummula mu nnyumba nnongoofu ddala nga kikyali tekiggulwanga. Kubanga nnali mmanyi ntya nti tekyakweka bubi bwonna wansi w’endabika yaakyo ennungi? Kyokka ne nkkakkanya okubuusabuusa kwange. Nnatya obuzibu bw’okukyekebejja. Okumala emyaka ebiri oba esatu, ekipipa ekyo ekyalabika ng’ekitaliiko kabi kyasigala mu kisenge kyange ekya wansi. Olwo, mu ngeri etannyonnyoleka n’akatono, ebiwojjolo ne bitandika okujjula ennyumba yange. Nnakozesa buli ngeri yonna okubyekuuma era ne nfuba nnyo okubimalawo, naye nga bwereere. Byeyongera mangu nnyo ne byagala okwonoona buli kye nnalina. Ne ndowooza nti kapeti zange ze zibireeta, ne nziyonja nnyo. Ne ndowooza nti waliwo ekikyamu ku ntebe n’ebintu ebirala eby’omu nnyumba, ne mbizza buggya. Ne nteebereza ebintu ebya buli ngeri ebitasoboka. Ku nkomerero, ekirowoozo ky’ekipipa ne kinjijira. Ne ndagira kiggyibwe mu kisenge ekya wansi, era omutwe gwakyo ne gumenyebwa. Ndowooza siyinza kusobya bwe ŋŋamba nti ebiwojjolo enkumi n’enkumi byafubutukamu. Eyali abeera mu nnyumba eyo nga sinnagiyingiramu ateekwa okuba nga yalekamu ekintu ekyazaala ebiwojjolo. Kino kye kyali kireeta obuzibu bwange bwonna. Kaakano nzikiriza nti omuze oba okwesanyusa okumu, ekintu ekimu ekitono ekirabika ng’ekitaliiko kabi, kituleetera okulumwa okutonotono okw’omuntu ow’omunda. Tekyekebejjeddwa bulungi wansi w’eriiso lya Katonda erinoonya. Ndowooza kye kiri ku kikolo ky’okulemererwa okusinga obungi mu bulamu buno obwa waggulu. Si byonna ebiweereddwayo. Waliwo ensonda ey’ekyama ekuumibwa nga nsibe, Mukama aleme kugiyingiramu. N’olwekyo tetuyinza kuyimirira mu maaso g’abalabe baffe, wabula twesanga nga tukubiddwa wansi mu maaso gaabwe. Okwewala okulemererwa, oba okuzuula ekikireeta bwe tulemererwa, tulina okubeera n’essaala eno bulijjo mu maaso gaffe: “Nkebera, Ayi Katonda, otegeere omutima gwange. Ngezesa omanye ebirowoozo byange. Olabe obanga mu nze mulimu engeri yonna enkyamu; era onkulembere mu kkubo erintuusa mu bulamu obutaggwaawo.” Wayinza okubaawo obulimba bungi mu nnaku gye tulaba olw’okulemererwa kwaffe. Tuyinza okulowooza nti tufaayo ku kitiibwa kya Katonda. Kyokka emmeeme zaffe ziyinza okuba nga zeeraliikirira olw’okwefaako ffekka. Tetuli batukuvu nga bwe twalowooza, era okuzuula ekyo kulumya okwagala kwe twagala ffekka. Okwennyamira kwaffe kuyinza okuba ensobi esinga ekikolwa ekibi kyennyini. Engeri yokka etaliimu kabi ey’okukwatamu okulemererwa kwaffe kwe kwewala okwefuula abatuukirivu oba okwesalira omusango. Mu kifo ky’ekyo, tusaanidde okukuteeka mu kasirise mu maaso ga Mukama, ne tukutunuulira mu mirembe ne mu kwagala. Abawandiisi ab’edda ab’eby’omwoyo eby’ekyama bagamba nti okukyukira Katonda mu bwangu ne mu mirembe kutuyamba okusinga okwejjusa olw’okuwaba okuva gy’ali. “Beera mwesigwa bwesigwa,” bwe bagamba. “Kyukira gy’ali yekka amangu ddala ng’olabye ekibi kyo. Okubeerawo kwe kujja kukununula mu mitego egikukwase.” Okwetunuulira wekka kukusuula wansi ennyo mu bitosi, kubanga ebitosi bino mu butuufu si kirala wabula ggwe wennyini; so ng’okutunuulira Katonda obutunuulizi kusobola okukkakkanya n’okubudaabuda omutima gwo. Ku nkomerero, ka tuleme kwerabira, ne bwe tulemererwa tutya, nti Mukama Yesu ayinza, nga bwe kyalangirirwa, okutulokola okuva mu balabe baffe. Olwo tuyinza “okulokolebwa okuva mu mukono gw’abalabe baffe awatali kutya, tulyoke tuweereze mu maaso ge, mu butukuvu ne mu butuukirivu ennaku zonna ez’obulamu bwaffe.”(Lukka 1:74-75). Ka tusabe, buli omu ku ffe, emisana n’ekiro nti: “ Era omuddu wo omuwonye okukola ebibi ebigenderere, bireme kunfuga. ”(Zabbuli 19:13). “ Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw’alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z’ensi.”(Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:8). Tulina okubeera abagonvu ennyo mu mikono gye, era ne tumwesiga. Olwo ajja “ abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.” (Abaebbulaniya 13:21)

fields.title: Okubuusabuusa
fields.body_html:
Abakristaayo bangi nnyo baddu b’omuze ogw’okubuusabuusa. Tewali mutamiivu yali asibiddwa ddala n’enjegere z’omuze gwe ogumutta okusinga bo bwe basibiddwa enjegere ezo. Obulamu bwabwe bwonna obw’Ekikristaayo lutalo olutakoma. Eggye ery’okubuusabuusa libalindirira okubalumba buli lwe lifuna akakisa. Obulamu bwabwe bwa nnaku. Okubuusabuusa kwabwe kulemesa omugaso gwabwe era kumenya okussa kimu kwabwe ne Katonda.

Emmeeme bw’eyingira mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza, ekitabo kino kye kyogerako, emirundi mingi okubuusabuusa kugobebwa. Naye oluusi kukomawo, ne kuleeta okwesittala n’okuggwaamu essuubi. Kyokka tekuyinza kuzzaayo ddala mukkiriza mu ddungu eryo ery’ennaku.

Tewali kubuusabuusa nti fenna tujjukira ebyatusikiriza n’entiisa bye twawulira nga tukyali baana mu lugero luli. Lwali lukwata ku Mukristaayo (Christian) bwe yasibibwa mu Kigo ky’Okubuusabuusa omunene omubi ayitibwa Okuggwaamu Essuubi. Twasanyuka nnyo bwe yawona n’ava mu miryango egyo eminene ne ku mufuzi oyo omukambwe. Mu kiseera ekyo tetwateebereza nti naffe twandisibiddwa omunene oyo yennyini, mu kigo ekyo kyennyini. Naye ntya nti buli mmemba w’Ekkanisa ya Kristo afunye ku mbeera ng’eyo waakiri omulundi gumu. Bwe kiba nga tekikyali kipya mu birowoozo byammwe, mbasaba musome nate olugero olwo. Muyinza okusangamu ebyo bye mwayitamu mmwe bennyini, ebyali ebizibu ennyo okugumira era eby’ennaku okujjukira.

Kyewuunyisa nti abantu abayitibwa Abakkiriza balina okwatula okubuusabuusa okw’engeri eyo. Erinnya lyabwe liraga nti ekibamanyisa kyokka kwe kukkiriza. Naye guno muze gwa buli wamu nnyo, nti singa Ekkanisa yali eweebwa erinnya eppya, erinnya lyokka eryandigisaanidde lyandibadde “Ababuusabuusa”. Abakristaayo abasinga obungi bakkirizza okubuusabuusa kwabwe, ne bakutwala ng’obulwadde obulumya obutayinza kwewalika.

Balowooza nti balina okukugumiikiriza ng’ekitundu ku kukangavvulwa kw’obulamu. Beemulugunya ku kubuusabuusa kwabwe ng’omuntu bw’ayinza okwemulugunya ku bulumi bwe n’obulwadde bwe. Baagala okulabibwa nga “ensonga ey’enjawulo” ey’okugezesebwa okutali kwa bulijjo, eyeetaaga okusaasirwa ennyo n’okulabirirwa ennyo.

Kino kitera okuba bwe kityo ku bakkiriza. Beegomba okubeera mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza era batutte amadaala mangi okubutuukako. Bayinza okuba nga baawona okubuusabuusa kwabwe okw’edda, okwabatulugunyanga ennyo. Beebuuzanga obanga ebibi byabwe byasonyiyibwa, n’obanga balituuka mu Ggulu. Naye bakyabuusabuusa. Omuze bagukyusizza bukyusa ne baguteeka ku ddaala erya waggulu. Bayinza okuba nga bagamba nti, “Weewaawo, nzikiriza nti ebibi byange bisonyiyibwa, era ndi mwana wa Katonda olw’okukkiriza mu Yesu Kristo. Sikyayinza kubuusabuusa kino.

Naye ate, era “naye ate” kuno kuzingiramu okubuusabuusa ku buli kisuubizo Kitaffe kye yasuubiza abaana be.

Balwanagana nabyo, ne bagaana okukkiriza okutuusa nga bafunye obukakafu nti bya mazima obusinga ekigambo kya Katonda.

Beewuunya lwaki basobola okutambulira mu kizikiza ekyenkanidde awo. Beetwala ng’abajulizi. Basinda wansi w’entalo ez’omwoyo ez’enjawulo ze balina okugumiikiriza. Entalo ez’omwoyo! Singa tuziyita obujeemu obw’omwoyo, erinnya eryo lyandizisaanidde nnyo okusingawo! Olutalo lwaffe lulina okuba olutalo olw’okukkiriza, era akaseera ke tubuusabuusa, olutalo lwaffe lukoma n’obujeemu bwaffe ne butandika.

Njagala, bwe kiba kisoboka, okuwakanya ensonga eno yonna n’amaanyi gange gonna. Kye kimu n’okwegatta ku kwemulugunya kw’omutamiivu, oba okusaba naye ekisa okugumiikiriza omuze gwe ogumutta. Kya busirusiru kye kimu okubudaabuda emmeeme ezifuuliddwa abaddu nga tuzikkiriza okwemulugunya kwazo okutaliimu maanyi. Siyinza kukola kirala wabula okuzirangirira okununulibwa okutuukiridde Mukama Yesu Kristo kw’azitegekedde. Nzegayirira, nzikubiriza, era nziragira n’obulamu bwange bwonna, okukukkiriza zibe ez’eddembe. Sandiwulirizza wadde akaseera akamu okwekwasa kwazo okw’okuggwaamu essuubi. Osaanidde okuba ow’eddembe, osobola okuba ow’eddembe, era oteekwa okuba ow’eddembe!

Oyinza okwetantala okuŋŋamba nti kya buwaze era tekiyinza kwewalika Katonda okubuusibwabuusibwa abaana be?

Kya buwaze nti abaana bo bateekwa okukubuusabuusa? Wandigumiikirizza okubuusabuusa kwabwe wadde essaawa emu? Wandisaasidde mutabani wo singa akugamba nti, “Taata, sisobola kukkiriza kigambo kyo, sisobola kwesiga kwagala kwo”? Wandimutwala ng’ensonga ey’enjawulo? Nzijukira lumu nga ndaba obusungu bwa maama gwe nnali mmanyi, nga bumukutte okutuuka munda ddala olw’okubuusabuusa okutono okw’omu ku baana be. Yali aleese abawala babiri abato ewange abandekere ng’agenda okukola emirimu egimu. Omu ku bo, n’obwesige obw’essanyu obw’omwana, yeewaayo ddala eri ebyo ebyali mu kisenge ky’abaana. Yasangayo byonna ebisanyusa, n’ayimba era n’azannya okutuusa maama we lwe yakomawo.

Omulala, n’obwegendereza obw’abakulu obutali bulungi, n’atuula yekka mu nsonda. Yeebuuza obanga maama we anajjukira okukomawo okumutwala. Yatya nti ajja kwerabirwa. Yalowooza nti maama we yandisanyuse okumwesonyiwa, kubanga yali muwala mujeemu. Ku nkomerero, ne yeeyongera okwennyamira okutuusa lwe yaggwaamu ddala essuubi. Sijja kwerabira mangu ndabika ya maama oyo ku maaso ge. Kyali ng’omuwala we omuto akaaba amaze okudda gy’ali n’amubuulira ekyali kimuluma. Ennaku, okwagala okulumiddwa, obusungu n’okusaasira byonna byawakana okufuga. Naye obusungu ne buwangula, era mbuusabuusa obanga omuwala oyo omuto yali akangavvuddwa n’amaanyi bwe gatyo emabegako. Ekifaananyi ekyo kizze mu birowoozo byange emirundi kikumi okuva olwo. Kinjigirizza nnyo. Kimpalirizza okugaana okubuusabuusa okwagala kwa Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu. Okubuusabuusa okwo kubadde kukonkona n’amaanyi ku luggi lw’omutima gwange nga kwagala kuyingire.

Nkakasa nti eri bangi, okubuusabuusa kya kwejalabya. Okukyeggyako kwandibadde okwefiiriza okusingayo obuzibu kwe bamanyi. Kya kwejalabya ekireeta ebivaamu eby’ennaku, nga n’ebirala byonna eby’okwejalabya bwe bikola. Oboolyawo, bw’olaba ennaku gye kireese mu bulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo, oyinza okukemebwa okugamba nti, Nnaku! Kino si kya kwejalabya gye ndi, wabula kugezesebwa kwa ntiisa kwokka.” Naye yimirira akaseera. Gezaako okukireka, era amangu ojja kuzuula obanga kya kwejalabya oba nedda. Okubuusabuusa kwo tekujja gy’oli ng’ekibinja ky’emikwano? Kukusaasira mu buzibu bwo era kwagala okukubudaabuda.

Si kwejalabya okutuula nakwo, okukusembeza, n’okuwuliriza empaka zaakwo? N’okwegatta nakwo mu kusaasira kwakwo? Tekyandibadde kwefiiriza okukukyukira ddala okukuvaako, n’ogaana okuwulira ekigambo kyonna kye kulina okwogera?

Bw’oba tomanyi, gezaako olabe. Tewanyumirwangako kwejalabya mu birowoozo ebikakali ku abo abaakukola obubi? Tewamanyangako ssanyu ery’okufumiitiriza ku butaba na kisa bwabwe? Ery’okwekenneenya ettima lyabwe? Ery’okubalowoozaako ebintu ebikyamu eby’engeri zonna ebitasanyusa? Kya lwatu, kino kikunakuwazizza. Naye bwe bunaku obusikiriza, bw’otoyinza kulekera mangu. Era okwejalabya mu kubuusabuusa kuli bwe kutyo. Ebintu bikukyamukidde mu by’oyitamu.

Engeri Katonda gy’akukwatamu tetegeerekeka. Okukemebwa kwo kwa ngeri ya njawulo. Embeera yo erabika nga si ya bulijjo. Kiki ekyandibadde eky’obutonde okusinga okusalawo nti, olw’ensonga emu, Katonda akwabulidde? Nti takwagala era tafaayo ku bulungi bwo? Era endowooza nti oli mubi nnyo n’atakufaako, oba nti oli muzibu nnyo n’atasobola kukukwata, ebeera ya maanyi nnyo!

Tomunenya era tomulumiriza butali bwenkanya. Owulira nti osaanidde obutafibwako n’okugaanibwa kwe olw’obutasaana bwo. Olukwe luno lukusobozesa okwebuusabuusa ng’weefuula omuwombeefu.

Naye ddala weesanyusa mu birowoozo ebikakali era ebikyamu ku Mukama wo, nga bwe wakola ku mulabe omuntu.

Agamba nti teyajja kulokola batuukirivu, wabula aboonoonyi. Obwonoonyi bwo n’obutasaana bwo bye bikusaanyiza okusinga byonna okwagala kwe n’okukulabirira kwe.

Akaliga akato ak’ennaku akawabye ne kabula mu ddungu kandiyinza okugamba nti, “Omusumba tanjagala, tanfaako, era tanjijukira, kubanga mbuze.” Ayagala era afaayo ku baliga bokka abatawaba.” Era n’omulwadde yandiyinza okugamba nti, “Omusawo tajja kujja kundaba, wadde okumpa eddagala, kubanga ndi mulwadde. Afaayo era alambula abalamu bokka.” Yesu agamba nti, “ Abalamu tebeetaaga musawo wabula abalwadde.”(Matayo 9:12) Era ate agamba nti, “Singa omu ku mmwe abadde alina endiga kikumi, naye emu n’emubulako, taleka ziri ekyenda mu omwenda ku ttale n’agenda anoonya eri ebuze okutuusa Lw’agiraba? Bw’agiraba, agisitula ku bibegabega bye n’agitwala eka ng’ajaguza. Bw’atuuka eka ayita mikwano gye ne baliraanwa be bajje ng’agamba nti, ‘Munsanyukireko kubanga endiga yange eyabadde ebuze, erabise.’”(Lukka 15:4-6) Ebirowoozo byonna ku ye ebyawukana ku bigambo bye ye kennyini birowoozo bikakali. Okwesanyusa mu byo kubi nnyo okusinga okwesanyusa mu birowoozo ebikakali ku mukwano gwo yenna ow’oku nsi oba omulabe wo. Okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo, bulijjo kibi okwesanyusa mu kubuusabuusa. Okubuusabuusa kwonna kuva eri Setaani, era bulijjo si kwa mazima. Era engeri yokka ey’okukwolekera kwe kukwegaana butereevu era n’amaanyi. Kino kintuusa ku kitundu eky’enkola eky’ensonga eno yonna: engeri y’okununulibwa okuva mu muze guno ogutta. Eky’okuddamu kyange kyandibadde nti okununulibwa mu guno tekuyinza kujja mu ngeri ndala okuggyako ng’okununulibwa mu kibi ekirala kyonna. Kusangibwa mu Mukama era mu ye yekka. Olina okumukwasa okubuusabuusa kwo, nga bwe wayiga okumukwasa okukemebwa kwo okulala. Olina okukola kye kimu kye okola n’obusungu bwo oba n’amalala go.

Olina okukuwaayo eri Mukama.

Nzikiriza nti eddagala lyokka kwe kweyama obutaddamu kubuusabuusa. Nga bwe wandikubirizza omutamiivu okweyama obutaddamu kunywa mwenge. Weesige Mukama yekka akukuume ng’oli munywevu.

Nga bwe kiri ku kibi ekirala kyonna, ekigo kyakwo kiri mu kusalawo kw’omuntu. Olina okuwaayo okusalawo kwo ku nsonga y’okubuusabuusa, nga bwe wandikoze ku kukemebwa okulala kwonna. Katonda bulijjo atwala okusalawo okuweereddwayo gy’ali. Bwe tugamba nti tetujja kubuusabuusa ne tumuwaayo omunda mwaffe ddala, Omwoyo we ajja kukola mu ffe, era tujja kukuumibwa obutabuusabuusa olw’amaanyi ge amangi. Obuzibu buli nti, emirundi mingi emmeeme teyewaayo ddala. Yeekuumira eddembe ettono ery’okubuusabuusa, ng’erowooza nti oluusi kyetaagisa. Tujja kugamba nti, “Sikyayagala kubuusabuusa,” oba, “Nsuubira nti sijja kubuusabuusa.” Naye kizibu okugamba nti, “Sijja kuddamu kubuusabuusa.”

Naye tewali kwewaayo kukola okutuusa nga kutuuse ku kugamba nti, “Sijja”. Eddembe ery’okubuusabuusa liteekwa okuweebwayo emirembe gyonna. Era emmeeme eteekwa okukkiriza okubeera mu bulamu obw’okwesiga obutakoma era obutaliiko kirala kya kulondako. Ndowooza, emirundi mingi kyetaagisa okukomya okubuusabuusa kuno; tulina okutuuka ku kusalawo ku nsonga eno. Nzikiriza nti kyetaagisa nnyo ku abuusabuusa nga bwe kiri ku mutamiivu. Tekijja kukola okukulekayo mpolampola. Enkola ey’okukulekera ddala yonna yokka y’ekola wano. Bw’emala okwewaayo, emmeeme eteekwa okwesigama ku Mukama yekka okuginunula mu buli kukemebwa. Eteekwa okusitula engabo ey’okukkiriza amangu ddala ng’okulumba kutuuse. Eteekwa okukwasa Mukama ekirowoozo ekisooka eky’okubuusabuusa, era eteekwa okugamba omulabe agende akiteese ne Mukama.

Eteekwa okugaana okuwuliriza okubuusabuusa wadde akaseera akamu. Ne bwe kulabika ng’okw’amagezi oba okw’obuwombeefu kutya, emmeeme eteekwa okugamba nti, “Sisobola kwetantala kubuusabuusa; nteekwa okwesiga.” Mukama mulungi, era DDALA ANJAGALA. Yesu andokola; andokola kaakano.” Ebigambo ebyo ebitono, nga biddibwamu enfunda n’enfunda, — “Yesu andokola, Yesu andokola,” — bijja kuwangula eggye erisinga obunene ery’okubuusabuusa eryali lirumbye emmeeme. Nkigezezzaako emirundi egitabalika, era sikirabangako nga kirema. Toyimirira kukubaganya nakwo birowoozo, era togezaako kulaga nti kukyamu. Tokufaako n’akatono; kunyoomere ddala. Kuggalire oluggi mu maaso, era weegaane n’amaanyi buli kigambo kye kukugamba. Leeta ekigambo ekimu ekigamba nti “Kyawandiikibwa,” okukasuke ng’okugoba. Tunuulira Yesu butereevu, omugambe nti omwesiga, era nti omaliridde okumwesiga. Okubuusabuusa ka kuleekaane nga bwe kwagala, tekuyinza kukulumya bw’otokuyingiza.

Kiyinza okulabika ng’oggalira oluggi ku mikwano gyo egisinga. Omutima gwo gujja kwegomba okubuusabuusa kwo okusinga Abayisirayiri bwe beegomba sefuliya z’ennyama ez’e Misiri. Naye weefiirize; weetikke omusaalaba gwo mu nsonga eno. Gaana okuwuliriza ekigambo kyonna awatali kusaasira. Eggye eddamba ery’okubuusabuusa lyali linnindiridde nga nzuukuka, ne likonkona ku luggi lwange nga lyagala okuyingira. Tewaali kyalabika nga kituufu oba kya mazima. Okusinga byonna, tekyalabika nga kisoboka nti nze — omunaku era ow’obuyinike — nnyinza okuba nga Mukama anjagala, ananfaako, oba anandabako. Singa nnali nsobola okukuyingiza okubuusabuusa kuno. Singa nnali nsobola okukuyita kutuule era kweyagalire nga bwe kuli ewaka, ng’okwo kwandibadde kwejalabya! Naye emyaka mingi emabega, neeyama obutabuusabuusa. Okumenya obweyamo buno kyandibadde kibi gye ndi nga bwe kyandibadde okumenya obweyamo bwange obw’obutanywa mwenge.

Saayinza kwetantala kuyingiza kubuusabuusa kusooka. Nnasitula engabo yange ey’okukkiriza amangu ddala nga ndabye ebirowoozo bino. Nnakwasa Mukama wange eggye eryo lyonna alyoke aliwangule. Olwo ne nsigala nga ŋŋamba nti, “Mukama ddala anjagala.” Ye Mulokozi wange ow’ekiseera kino era atuukiridde; Yesu andokola, Yesu andokola kaakano!”

Obuwanguzi bwali bujjuvu. Omulabe yajja ng’amataba, naye Mukama n’ayimusa bendera okumuziyiza.

Yawangulwa n’adduka. Emmeeme yange eyimba oluyimba lwa Musa n’abaana ba Isirayiri. Egamba nti, “ Awo Musa n’abaana ba Isirayiri ne bayimbira Mukama oluyimba luno nga bagamba nti, “Nnaayimbiranga Mukama, kubanga awangudde n’ekitiibwa kingi. Asudde mu nnyanja embalaasi n’omwebagazi waayo.” (Okuva 15:1) “Mukama ge maanyi gange era lwe luyimba lwange, era afuuse obulokozi bwange. Ye Katonda wange, nange nnaamutenderezanga, ye Katonda wa kitange, nange nnaamugulumizanga. Mukama mulwanyi; Mukama, ly’erinnya lye. ”(Okuva 15:2-3). Kijja kukuyamba okulwanyisa okulumba kw’okukemebwa kuno okw’okubuusabuusa, bw’onoolaba obulungi nti okubuusabuusa kibi. Kujeemera butereevu Mukama waffe, atulagira nti, “Mbalekera emirembe, era mbawa emirembe gyange. Emirembe gye mbawa tegiringa egy’ensi. Noolwekyo temutyanga era temweraliikiriranga.” (Yokaana 14:27) Bayibuli buli wamu etulagira okwesiga, awatali kwawula. Ebiseera n’ebbanga byandimpeddeko okwogera ku kitundu kimu ku kikumi eky’ebyo. Naye tewali ayinza kusoma Zabbuli n’atakakasibwa. Omuntu eyeesiga awatali kubuusabuusa y’oyo yekka asanyusa Katonda era gw’akkiriza. “Okusunguwaza” kwa Isirayiri kwali nti tebaayesiga; “Naye bo ne beeyongera bweyongezi okwonoona, ne bajeemera Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo nga bali mu ddungu. Ne bagezesa Katonda mu bugenderevu, nga bamusaba emmere gye baalulunkanira. Era ne boogera ku Katonda; nga bagamba nti, “Katonda asobola okutuliisiza mu ddungu? Weewaawo yakuba olwazi, amazzi ne gakulukuta ng’emigga; naye anaatuwa emmere? Anaawa abantu be ennyama?” Awo Mukama bwe yawulira ebyo n’asunguwala nnyo; omuliro gwe ne gwaka ku Yakobo, n’obusungu bwe ne bubuubuukira ku Isirayiri. Kubanga tebakkiriza Katonda, era tebeesiga maanyi ge agalokola.” (Zabbuli 78:17-22.)

Okwawukana ku ekyo, Isaaya ayogera ku abo abeesiga nti, “Mukama alikuuma mirembe oyo amaliridde okumwesiga mu mutima gwe. “(Isaaya 26:3) Tewali kitulumya nga mukwano gwaffe okutubuusabuusa. Nkakasa nti tewali kinakuwaza Katonda okusinga okubuusabuusa kwaffe.

Omu ku baana bange, kaakano ali ne Mukama, yaŋŋamba akawungeezi akamu bwe nnali mmubikka mu kitanda, nti, “Kale, maama, nfunye okubuusabuusa kwange okusooka.” “Ayi, Ray,” ne ŋŋamba, “Kwali kutya?” “Ate,” bwe yaddamu, “Setaani yajja gye ndi n’aŋŋamba nneme kukkiriza Bayibuli, kubanga tewali kigambo na kimu mu yo kya mazima.” “Era ggwe wamugamba ki?”

Ne mbuuza. “Ayi,” bwe yaddamu ng’awangudde, “Nnamugamba bugambi nti, Setaani, nja kugikkiriza. Kale awo!” Nnasanyuka nnyo olw’amagezi ag’omwoyo omwana ono ge yalina. Yali amanyi engeri y’okwolekera okubuusabuusa. Ne mmuzzaamu amaanyi, nga mmunnyonnyola nti okubuusabuusa kwonna n’okuggwaamu amaanyi kwonna biva eri omulabe. Mulimba, n’olwekyo tomuwulirizanga n’akatono.

Ekiro ekyaddako, nnali nkyerabidde ddala. N’olwekyo ne nneewuunya bwe yaŋŋamba, nga mmubikka, nti, “Kale, maama, Setaani azzeemu nate.” “Ayi, Ray omwagalwa!” bwe nnaleekaana nga nneeraliikiridde, “kaakano akugambye ki?” “Kale,” bwe yaddamu, “aŋŋambye bugambi nti ndi muwala mujeemu nnyo, Yesu n’atasobola kunjagala. Nti kya busirusiru okulowooza nti anjagala.” “Era ggwe kaakano omugambye ki?” ne mbuuza. “Ayi!” bwe yaddamu, “Mmutunuulidde n’obusungu ne mmugamba nti, Setaani, ziba akamwa ko!” Awo n’ayongerako ng’amwenya, “Tayinza kunnakuwaza n’akatono.” Tewali mmeeme yali erwanye lutalo lusinga kitiibwa okusinga olwo omwana ono omuto lwe yalwana, era tewali buwanguzi businga obwo bwali buwanguddwa!

Emmeeme eyagalwa ebuusabuusa, genda okole bw’otyo; era obuwanguzi obufaanana ng’obwo bunaaba bubwo. Bw’onooteeka wansi ekitabo kino, kwata ekkalaamu yo owandiike okumalirira kwo obutaddamu kubuusabuusa. Kifuule endagaano ey’amazima wakati w’emmeeme yo ne Mukama. Waayo eddembe lyo ery’okubuusabuusa emirembe gyonna. Teeka okusalawo kwo mu nsonga eno ku ludda lwa Mukama, era omwesige akukuume oleme okugwa. Mubuulire obunafu bwo n’okubuusabuusa kwo.

Omulabe wo akufudde atalina ky’oyinza kukola. Mukwase olutalo lwonna. Mugambe nti tojja kuddamu kubuusabuusa.

Olwo, amaaso go gabeerenga ku Yesu.

Kyuka oleke ggwe kennyini n’okubuusabuusa kwo. Nywerera ku kukkiriza kwo, kubanga eyasuubiza mwesigwa.

Bw’onoonywerera mu bwesige bwo okutuusa ku nkomerero, ojja, ku bw’oyo akwagala, okuwangula n’okukirawo mu nsonga eno.
fields.body_text: Abakristaayo bangi nnyo baddu b’omuze ogw’okubuusabuusa. Tewali mutamiivu yali asibiddwa ddala n’enjegere z’omuze gwe ogumutta okusinga bo bwe basibiddwa enjegere ezo. Obulamu bwabwe bwonna obw’Ekikristaayo lutalo olutakoma. Eggye ery’okubuusabuusa libalindirira okubalumba buli lwe lifuna akakisa. Obulamu bwabwe bwa nnaku. Okubuusabuusa kwabwe kulemesa omugaso gwabwe era kumenya okussa kimu kwabwe ne Katonda. Emmeeme bw’eyingira mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza, ekitabo kino kye kyogerako, emirundi mingi okubuusabuusa kugobebwa. Naye oluusi kukomawo, ne kuleeta okwesittala n’okuggwaamu essuubi. Kyokka tekuyinza kuzzaayo ddala mukkiriza mu ddungu eryo ery’ennaku. Tewali kubuusabuusa nti fenna tujjukira ebyatusikiriza n’entiisa bye twawulira nga tukyali baana mu lugero luli. Lwali lukwata ku Mukristaayo (Christian) bwe yasibibwa mu Kigo ky’Okubuusabuusa omunene omubi ayitibwa Okuggwaamu Essuubi. Twasanyuka nnyo bwe yawona n’ava mu miryango egyo eminene ne ku mufuzi oyo omukambwe. Mu kiseera ekyo tetwateebereza nti naffe twandisibiddwa omunene oyo yennyini, mu kigo ekyo kyennyini. Naye ntya nti buli mmemba w’Ekkanisa ya Kristo afunye ku mbeera ng’eyo waakiri omulundi gumu. Bwe kiba nga tekikyali kipya mu birowoozo byammwe, mbasaba musome nate olugero olwo. Muyinza okusangamu ebyo bye mwayitamu mmwe bennyini, ebyali ebizibu ennyo okugumira era eby’ennaku okujjukira. Kyewuunyisa nti abantu abayitibwa Abakkiriza balina okwatula okubuusabuusa okw’engeri eyo. Erinnya lyabwe liraga nti ekibamanyisa kyokka kwe kukkiriza. Naye guno muze gwa buli wamu nnyo, nti singa Ekkanisa yali eweebwa erinnya eppya, erinnya lyokka eryandigisaanidde lyandibadde “Ababuusabuusa”. Abakristaayo abasinga obungi bakkirizza okubuusabuusa kwabwe, ne bakutwala ng’obulwadde obulumya obutayinza kwewalika. Balowooza nti balina okukugumiikiriza ng’ekitundu ku kukangavvulwa kw’obulamu. Beemulugunya ku kubuusabuusa kwabwe ng’omuntu bw’ayinza okwemulugunya ku bulumi bwe n’obulwadde bwe. Baagala okulabibwa nga “ensonga ey’enjawulo” ey’okugezesebwa okutali kwa bulijjo, eyeetaaga okusaasirwa ennyo n’okulabirirwa ennyo. Kino kitera okuba bwe kityo ku bakkiriza. Beegomba okubeera mu bulamu obw’okukkiriza era batutte amadaala mangi okubutuukako. Bayinza okuba nga baawona okubuusabuusa kwabwe okw’edda, okwabatulugunyanga ennyo. Beebuuzanga obanga ebibi byabwe byasonyiyibwa, n’obanga balituuka mu Ggulu. Naye bakyabuusabuusa. Omuze bagukyusizza bukyusa ne baguteeka ku ddaala erya waggulu. Bayinza okuba nga bagamba nti, “Weewaawo, nzikiriza nti ebibi byange bisonyiyibwa, era ndi mwana wa Katonda olw’okukkiriza mu Yesu Kristo. Sikyayinza kubuusabuusa kino. Naye ate, era “naye ate” kuno kuzingiramu okubuusabuusa ku buli kisuubizo Kitaffe kye yasuubiza abaana be. Balwanagana nabyo, ne bagaana okukkiriza okutuusa nga bafunye obukakafu nti bya mazima obusinga ekigambo kya Katonda. Beewuunya lwaki basobola okutambulira mu kizikiza ekyenkanidde awo. Beetwala ng’abajulizi. Basinda wansi w’entalo ez’omwoyo ez’enjawulo ze balina okugumiikiriza. Entalo ez’omwoyo! Singa tuziyita obujeemu obw’omwoyo, erinnya eryo lyandizisaanidde nnyo okusingawo! Olutalo lwaffe lulina okuba olutalo olw’okukkiriza, era akaseera ke tubuusabuusa, olutalo lwaffe lukoma n’obujeemu bwaffe ne butandika. Njagala, bwe kiba kisoboka, okuwakanya ensonga eno yonna n’amaanyi gange gonna. Kye kimu n’okwegatta ku kwemulugunya kw’omutamiivu, oba okusaba naye ekisa okugumiikiriza omuze gwe ogumutta. Kya busirusiru kye kimu okubudaabuda emmeeme ezifuuliddwa abaddu nga tuzikkiriza okwemulugunya kwazo okutaliimu maanyi. Siyinza kukola kirala wabula okuzirangirira okununulibwa okutuukiridde Mukama Yesu Kristo kw’azitegekedde. Nzegayirira, nzikubiriza, era nziragira n’obulamu bwange bwonna, okukukkiriza zibe ez’eddembe. Sandiwulirizza wadde akaseera akamu okwekwasa kwazo okw’okuggwaamu essuubi. Osaanidde okuba ow’eddembe, osobola okuba ow’eddembe, era oteekwa okuba ow’eddembe! Oyinza okwetantala okuŋŋamba nti kya buwaze era tekiyinza kwewalika Katonda okubuusibwabuusibwa abaana be? Kya buwaze nti abaana bo bateekwa okukubuusabuusa? Wandigumiikirizza okubuusabuusa kwabwe wadde essaawa emu? Wandisaasidde mutabani wo singa akugamba nti, “Taata, sisobola kukkiriza kigambo kyo, sisobola kwesiga kwagala kwo”? Wandimutwala ng’ensonga ey’enjawulo? Nzijukira lumu nga ndaba obusungu bwa maama gwe nnali mmanyi, nga bumukutte okutuuka munda ddala olw’okubuusabuusa okutono okw’omu ku baana be. Yali aleese abawala babiri abato ewange abandekere ng’agenda okukola emirimu egimu. Omu ku bo, n’obwesige obw’essanyu obw’omwana, yeewaayo ddala eri ebyo ebyali mu kisenge ky’abaana. Yasangayo byonna ebisanyusa, n’ayimba era n’azannya okutuusa maama we lwe yakomawo. Omulala, n’obwegendereza obw’abakulu obutali bulungi, n’atuula yekka mu nsonda. Yeebuuza obanga maama we anajjukira okukomawo okumutwala. Yatya nti ajja kwerabirwa. Yalowooza nti maama we yandisanyuse okumwesonyiwa, kubanga yali muwala mujeemu. Ku nkomerero, ne yeeyongera okwennyamira okutuusa lwe yaggwaamu ddala essuubi. Sijja kwerabira mangu ndabika ya maama oyo ku maaso ge. Kyali ng’omuwala we omuto akaaba amaze okudda gy’ali n’amubuulira ekyali kimuluma. Ennaku, okwagala okulumiddwa, obusungu n’okusaasira byonna byawakana okufuga. Naye obusungu ne buwangula, era mbuusabuusa obanga omuwala oyo omuto yali akangavvuddwa n’amaanyi bwe gatyo emabegako. Ekifaananyi ekyo kizze mu birowoozo byange emirundi kikumi okuva olwo. Kinjigirizza nnyo. Kimpalirizza okugaana okubuusabuusa okwagala kwa Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu. Okubuusabuusa okwo kubadde kukonkona n’amaanyi ku luggi lw’omutima gwange nga kwagala kuyingire. Nkakasa nti eri bangi, okubuusabuusa kya kwejalabya. Okukyeggyako kwandibadde okwefiiriza okusingayo obuzibu kwe bamanyi. Kya kwejalabya ekireeta ebivaamu eby’ennaku, nga n’ebirala byonna eby’okwejalabya bwe bikola. Oboolyawo, bw’olaba ennaku gye kireese mu bulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo, oyinza okukemebwa okugamba nti, Nnaku! Kino si kya kwejalabya gye ndi, wabula kugezesebwa kwa ntiisa kwokka.” Naye yimirira akaseera. Gezaako okukireka, era amangu ojja kuzuula obanga kya kwejalabya oba nedda. Okubuusabuusa kwo tekujja gy’oli ng’ekibinja ky’emikwano? Kukusaasira mu buzibu bwo era kwagala okukubudaabuda. Si kwejalabya okutuula nakwo, okukusembeza, n’okuwuliriza empaka zaakwo? N’okwegatta nakwo mu kusaasira kwakwo? Tekyandibadde kwefiiriza okukukyukira ddala okukuvaako, n’ogaana okuwulira ekigambo kyonna kye kulina okwogera? Bw’oba tomanyi, gezaako olabe. Tewanyumirwangako kwejalabya mu birowoozo ebikakali ku abo abaakukola obubi? Tewamanyangako ssanyu ery’okufumiitiriza ku butaba na kisa bwabwe? Ery’okwekenneenya ettima lyabwe? Ery’okubalowoozaako ebintu ebikyamu eby’engeri zonna ebitasanyusa? Kya lwatu, kino kikunakuwazizza. Naye bwe bunaku obusikiriza, bw’otoyinza kulekera mangu. Era okwejalabya mu kubuusabuusa kuli bwe kutyo. Ebintu bikukyamukidde mu by’oyitamu. Engeri Katonda gy’akukwatamu tetegeerekeka. Okukemebwa kwo kwa ngeri ya njawulo. Embeera yo erabika nga si ya bulijjo. Kiki ekyandibadde eky’obutonde okusinga okusalawo nti, olw’ensonga emu, Katonda akwabulidde? Nti takwagala era tafaayo ku bulungi bwo? Era endowooza nti oli mubi nnyo n’atakufaako, oba nti oli muzibu nnyo n’atasobola kukukwata, ebeera ya maanyi nnyo! Tomunenya era tomulumiriza butali bwenkanya. Owulira nti osaanidde obutafibwako n’okugaanibwa kwe olw’obutasaana bwo. Olukwe luno lukusobozesa okwebuusabuusa ng’weefuula omuwombeefu. Naye ddala weesanyusa mu birowoozo ebikakali era ebikyamu ku Mukama wo, nga bwe wakola ku mulabe omuntu. Agamba nti teyajja kulokola batuukirivu, wabula aboonoonyi. Obwonoonyi bwo n’obutasaana bwo bye bikusaanyiza okusinga byonna okwagala kwe n’okukulabirira kwe. Akaliga akato ak’ennaku akawabye ne kabula mu ddungu kandiyinza okugamba nti, “Omusumba tanjagala, tanfaako, era tanjijukira, kubanga mbuze.” Ayagala era afaayo ku baliga bokka abatawaba.” Era n’omulwadde yandiyinza okugamba nti, “Omusawo tajja kujja kundaba, wadde okumpa eddagala, kubanga ndi mulwadde. Afaayo era alambula abalamu bokka.” Yesu agamba nti, “ Abalamu tebeetaaga musawo wabula abalwadde.”(Matayo 9:12) Era ate agamba nti, “Singa omu ku mmwe abadde alina endiga kikumi, naye emu n’emubulako, taleka ziri ekyenda mu omwenda ku ttale n’agenda anoonya eri ebuze okutuusa Lw’agiraba? Bw’agiraba, agisitula ku bibegabega bye n’agitwala eka ng’ajaguza. Bw’atuuka eka ayita mikwano gye ne baliraanwa be bajje ng’agamba nti, ‘Munsanyukireko kubanga endiga yange eyabadde ebuze, erabise.’”(Lukka 15:4-6) Ebirowoozo byonna ku ye ebyawukana ku bigambo bye ye kennyini birowoozo bikakali. Okwesanyusa mu byo kubi nnyo okusinga okwesanyusa mu birowoozo ebikakali ku mukwano gwo yenna ow’oku nsi oba omulabe wo. Okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero y’obulamu bwo obw’Ekikristaayo, bulijjo kibi okwesanyusa mu kubuusabuusa. Okubuusabuusa kwonna kuva eri Setaani, era bulijjo si kwa mazima. Era engeri yokka ey’okukwolekera kwe kukwegaana butereevu era n’amaanyi. Kino kintuusa ku kitundu eky’enkola eky’ensonga eno yonna: engeri y’okununulibwa okuva mu muze guno ogutta. Eky’okuddamu kyange kyandibadde nti okununulibwa mu guno tekuyinza kujja mu ngeri ndala okuggyako ng’okununulibwa mu kibi ekirala kyonna. Kusangibwa mu Mukama era mu ye yekka. Olina okumukwasa okubuusabuusa kwo, nga bwe wayiga okumukwasa okukemebwa kwo okulala. Olina okukola kye kimu kye okola n’obusungu bwo oba n’amalala go. Olina okukuwaayo eri Mukama. Nzikiriza nti eddagala lyokka kwe kweyama obutaddamu kubuusabuusa. Nga bwe wandikubirizza omutamiivu okweyama obutaddamu kunywa mwenge. Weesige Mukama yekka akukuume ng’oli munywevu. Nga bwe kiri ku kibi ekirala kyonna, ekigo kyakwo kiri mu kusalawo kw’omuntu. Olina okuwaayo okusalawo kwo ku nsonga y’okubuusabuusa, nga bwe wandikoze ku kukemebwa okulala kwonna. Katonda bulijjo atwala okusalawo okuweereddwayo gy’ali. Bwe tugamba nti tetujja kubuusabuusa ne tumuwaayo omunda mwaffe ddala, Omwoyo we ajja kukola mu ffe, era tujja kukuumibwa obutabuusabuusa olw’amaanyi ge amangi. Obuzibu buli nti, emirundi mingi emmeeme teyewaayo ddala. Yeekuumira eddembe ettono ery’okubuusabuusa, ng’erowooza nti oluusi kyetaagisa. Tujja kugamba nti, “Sikyayagala kubuusabuusa,” oba, “Nsuubira nti sijja kubuusabuusa.” Naye kizibu okugamba nti, “Sijja kuddamu kubuusabuusa.” Naye tewali kwewaayo kukola okutuusa nga kutuuse ku kugamba nti, “Sijja”. Eddembe ery’okubuusabuusa liteekwa okuweebwayo emirembe gyonna. Era emmeeme eteekwa okukkiriza okubeera mu bulamu obw’okwesiga obutakoma era obutaliiko kirala kya kulondako. Ndowooza, emirundi mingi kyetaagisa okukomya okubuusabuusa kuno; tulina okutuuka ku kusalawo ku nsonga eno. Nzikiriza nti kyetaagisa nnyo ku abuusabuusa nga bwe kiri ku mutamiivu. Tekijja kukola okukulekayo mpolampola. Enkola ey’okukulekera ddala yonna yokka y’ekola wano. Bw’emala okwewaayo, emmeeme eteekwa okwesigama ku Mukama yekka okuginunula mu buli kukemebwa. Eteekwa okusitula engabo ey’okukkiriza amangu ddala ng’okulumba kutuuse. Eteekwa okukwasa Mukama ekirowoozo ekisooka eky’okubuusabuusa, era eteekwa okugamba omulabe agende akiteese ne Mukama. Eteekwa okugaana okuwuliriza okubuusabuusa wadde akaseera akamu. Ne bwe kulabika ng’okw’amagezi oba okw’obuwombeefu kutya, emmeeme eteekwa okugamba nti, “Sisobola kwetantala kubuusabuusa; nteekwa okwesiga.” Mukama mulungi, era DDALA ANJAGALA. Yesu andokola; andokola kaakano.” Ebigambo ebyo ebitono, nga biddibwamu enfunda n’enfunda, — “Yesu andokola, Yesu andokola,” — bijja kuwangula eggye erisinga obunene ery’okubuusabuusa eryali lirumbye emmeeme. Nkigezezzaako emirundi egitabalika, era sikirabangako nga kirema. Toyimirira kukubaganya nakwo birowoozo, era togezaako kulaga nti kukyamu. Tokufaako n’akatono; kunyoomere ddala. Kuggalire oluggi mu maaso, era weegaane n’amaanyi buli kigambo kye kukugamba. Leeta ekigambo ekimu ekigamba nti “Kyawandiikibwa,” okukasuke ng’okugoba. Tunuulira Yesu butereevu, omugambe nti omwesiga, era nti omaliridde okumwesiga. Okubuusabuusa ka kuleekaane nga bwe kwagala, tekuyinza kukulumya bw’otokuyingiza. Kiyinza okulabika ng’oggalira oluggi ku mikwano gyo egisinga. Omutima gwo gujja kwegomba okubuusabuusa kwo okusinga Abayisirayiri bwe beegomba sefuliya z’ennyama ez’e Misiri. Naye weefiirize; weetikke omusaalaba gwo mu nsonga eno. Gaana okuwuliriza ekigambo kyonna awatali kusaasira. Eggye eddamba ery’okubuusabuusa lyali linnindiridde nga nzuukuka, ne likonkona ku luggi lwange nga lyagala okuyingira. Tewaali kyalabika nga kituufu oba kya mazima. Okusinga byonna, tekyalabika nga kisoboka nti nze — omunaku era ow’obuyinike — nnyinza okuba nga Mukama anjagala, ananfaako, oba anandabako. Singa nnali nsobola okukuyingiza okubuusabuusa kuno. Singa nnali nsobola okukuyita kutuule era kweyagalire nga bwe kuli ewaka, ng’okwo kwandibadde kwejalabya! Naye emyaka mingi emabega, neeyama obutabuusabuusa. Okumenya obweyamo buno kyandibadde kibi gye ndi nga bwe kyandibadde okumenya obweyamo bwange obw’obutanywa mwenge. Saayinza kwetantala kuyingiza kubuusabuusa kusooka. Nnasitula engabo yange ey’okukkiriza amangu ddala nga ndabye ebirowoozo bino. Nnakwasa Mukama wange eggye eryo lyonna alyoke aliwangule. Olwo ne nsigala nga ŋŋamba nti, “Mukama ddala anjagala.” Ye Mulokozi wange ow’ekiseera kino era atuukiridde; Yesu andokola, Yesu andokola kaakano!” Obuwanguzi bwali bujjuvu. Omulabe yajja ng’amataba, naye Mukama n’ayimusa bendera okumuziyiza. Yawangulwa n’adduka. Emmeeme yange eyimba oluyimba lwa Musa n’abaana ba Isirayiri. Egamba nti, “ Awo Musa n’abaana ba Isirayiri ne bayimbira Mukama oluyimba luno nga bagamba nti, “Nnaayimbiranga Mukama, kubanga awangudde n’ekitiibwa kingi. Asudde mu nnyanja embalaasi n’omwebagazi waayo.” (Okuva 15:1) “Mukama ge maanyi gange era lwe luyimba lwange, era afuuse obulokozi bwange. Ye Katonda wange, nange nnaamutenderezanga, ye Katonda wa kitange, nange nnaamugulumizanga. Mukama mulwanyi; Mukama, ly’erinnya lye. ”(Okuva 15:2-3). Kijja kukuyamba okulwanyisa okulumba kw’okukemebwa kuno okw’okubuusabuusa, bw’onoolaba obulungi nti okubuusabuusa kibi. Kujeemera butereevu Mukama waffe, atulagira nti, “Mbalekera emirembe, era mbawa emirembe gyange. Emirembe gye mbawa tegiringa egy’ensi. Noolwekyo temutyanga era temweraliikiriranga.” (Yokaana 14:27) Bayibuli buli wamu etulagira okwesiga, awatali kwawula. Ebiseera n’ebbanga byandimpeddeko okwogera ku kitundu kimu ku kikumi eky’ebyo. Naye tewali ayinza kusoma Zabbuli n’atakakasibwa. Omuntu eyeesiga awatali kubuusabuusa y’oyo yekka asanyusa Katonda era gw’akkiriza. “Okusunguwaza” kwa Isirayiri kwali nti tebaayesiga; “Naye bo ne beeyongera bweyongezi okwonoona, ne bajeemera Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo nga bali mu ddungu. Ne bagezesa Katonda mu bugenderevu, nga bamusaba emmere gye baalulunkanira. Era ne boogera ku Katonda; nga bagamba nti, “Katonda asobola okutuliisiza mu ddungu? Weewaawo yakuba olwazi, amazzi ne gakulukuta ng’emigga; naye anaatuwa emmere? Anaawa abantu be ennyama?” Awo Mukama bwe yawulira ebyo n’asunguwala nnyo; omuliro gwe ne gwaka ku Yakobo, n’obusungu bwe ne bubuubuukira ku Isirayiri. Kubanga tebakkiriza Katonda, era tebeesiga maanyi ge agalokola.” (Zabbuli 78:17-22.) Okwawukana ku ekyo, Isaaya ayogera ku abo abeesiga nti, “Mukama alikuuma mirembe oyo amaliridde okumwesiga mu mutima gwe. “(Isaaya 26:3) Tewali kitulumya nga mukwano gwaffe okutubuusabuusa. Nkakasa nti tewali kinakuwaza Katonda okusinga okubuusabuusa kwaffe. Omu ku baana bange, kaakano ali ne Mukama, yaŋŋamba akawungeezi akamu bwe nnali mmubikka mu kitanda, nti, “Kale, maama, nfunye okubuusabuusa kwange okusooka.” “Ayi, Ray,” ne ŋŋamba, “Kwali kutya?” “Ate,” bwe yaddamu, “Setaani yajja gye ndi n’aŋŋamba nneme kukkiriza Bayibuli, kubanga tewali kigambo na kimu mu yo kya mazima.” “Era ggwe wamugamba ki?” Ne mbuuza. “Ayi,” bwe yaddamu ng’awangudde, “Nnamugamba bugambi nti, Setaani, nja kugikkiriza. Kale awo!” Nnasanyuka nnyo olw’amagezi ag’omwoyo omwana ono ge yalina. Yali amanyi engeri y’okwolekera okubuusabuusa. Ne mmuzzaamu amaanyi, nga mmunnyonnyola nti okubuusabuusa kwonna n’okuggwaamu amaanyi kwonna biva eri omulabe. Mulimba, n’olwekyo tomuwulirizanga n’akatono. Ekiro ekyaddako, nnali nkyerabidde ddala. N’olwekyo ne nneewuunya bwe yaŋŋamba, nga mmubikka, nti, “Kale, maama, Setaani azzeemu nate.” “Ayi, Ray omwagalwa!” bwe nnaleekaana nga nneeraliikiridde, “kaakano akugambye ki?” “Kale,” bwe yaddamu, “aŋŋambye bugambi nti ndi muwala mujeemu nnyo, Yesu n’atasobola kunjagala. Nti kya busirusiru okulowooza nti anjagala.” “Era ggwe kaakano omugambye ki?” ne mbuuza. “Ayi!” bwe yaddamu, “Mmutunuulidde n’obusungu ne mmugamba nti, Setaani, ziba akamwa ko!” Awo n’ayongerako ng’amwenya, “Tayinza kunnakuwaza n’akatono.” Tewali mmeeme yali erwanye lutalo lusinga kitiibwa okusinga olwo omwana ono omuto lwe yalwana, era tewali buwanguzi businga obwo bwali buwanguddwa! Emmeeme eyagalwa ebuusabuusa, genda okole bw’otyo; era obuwanguzi obufaanana ng’obwo bunaaba bubwo. Bw’onooteeka wansi ekitabo kino, kwata ekkalaamu yo owandiike okumalirira kwo obutaddamu kubuusabuusa. Kifuule endagaano ey’amazima wakati w’emmeeme yo ne Mukama. Waayo eddembe lyo ery’okubuusabuusa emirembe gyonna. Teeka okusalawo kwo mu nsonga eno ku ludda lwa Mukama, era omwesige akukuume oleme okugwa. Mubuulire obunafu bwo n’okubuusabuusa kwo. Omulabe wo akufudde atalina ky’oyinza kukola. Mukwase olutalo lwonna. Mugambe nti tojja kuddamu kubuusabuusa. Olwo, amaaso go gabeerenga ku Yesu. Kyuka oleke ggwe kennyini n’okubuusabuusa kwo. Nywerera ku kukkiriza kwo, kubanga eyasuubiza mwesigwa. Bw’onoonywerera mu bwesige bwo okutuusa ku nkomerero, ojja, ku bw’oyo akwagala, okuwangula n’okukirawo mu nsonga eno.

fields.title: Ebivaamu mu Bulamu obwa Bulijjo
fields.body_html:
Obanga byonna ebyogeddwa ku bulamu bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda bya mazima, kale bisaanidde okweyolekera mu bulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo.

Abo ababunyumirwa basaanidde okuba “eggwanga ery’envuma, erinyiikirira ebikolwa ebirungi.” Mutabani wange bwe yali ku ttendekero ekkulu yawandiikira mukwano gwe nti Abakristaayo kibagwanidde okuba abajulirwa ba Katonda. Ensi tegenda kusoma Bayibuli, naye ejja kusoma obulamu bwaffe. Okukkiriza kwe balina mu ddiini yaffe kwesigamye ku bujulirwa obulamu bwaffe bwe buwa. Nga ffenna bwe tumanyi, guno mulembe gwa bikolwa ebirabika. Abantu bava ku kubuuza ku ndowooza ne babuuza ku bintu ebiriwo ddala.

Obanga eddiini yaffe eneeyongera mu maaso, kiteekwa okukakasibwa nti si ndowooza buwoozi. Tuteekwa okulaga ebirowoozo by’omulembe gwaffe ebyekenneenya ennyo ebintu ebikulu eby’obulamu obukyusiddwa amaanyi ga Katonda ag’ekitalo agakolera mu ffe okukola by’ayagala. “Mutulage ‘engeri z’obulamu,’ bwe boogera bannassaayansi, era tujja kukkiriza. Ekkanisa bw’erireeta mu maaso gaabwe, mu bammemba baayo bonna, obulamu obutukuvu, ekigo kyabwe ekisembayo kiriwambibwa.” Nandyagadde, nga sinnaggalawo kitabo kyange, okwogera mu ngeri ey’obukulu ennyo ku bibala by’obulamu obw’okukkiriza, obw’engeri gye mbadde nnyonnyola.

Nzikiriza nti byetaagisa. Nkubiriza abasomi bange okuwulira obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe obw’okutambula mu ngeri esaanira okuyitibwa kwabwe okw’ekitiibwa.

Njagala okwogera ne bamu ku mmwe nga mikwano gyange. Nkakasa nti, okuyita mu kitabo kino, okwegomba kwe tugabana kukuze mu mitima gyammwe, nga bwe kukuze ne mu gwange. Tusaanidde okutenda ebirungi bya Katonda eyatuggya mu kizikiza n’atuyingiza mu butangaavu bwe obutenkanika. Nga mukwano gwammwe, nnyinza okwogera mu bwerufu eri mikwano gyange. Munsonyiwe bwe nnaayogera ku nsonga ezimu enkulu ez’obulamu n’empisa. Zikulu nnyo eri okukula okw’amazima mu Bukristaayo.

Omutindo gw’obulamu obutukuvu mu Bakristaayo guli wansi. Okwewaayo kwonna okw’amazima mu bulamu n’empisa kwewuunyisa bangi mu Kkanisa, era emirundi mingi tebakusiima. Abasinga obungi ku abo abeeyita abagoberezi ba Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo tebamufaanana. Omuntu ow’ebweru yandirabye okukwatagana kutono nnyo wakati wabwe naye.

Naye ffe, abawulidde Katonda ng’atuyita okwewaayo kwonna n’okwesiga kwonna, tuteekwa okukola mu ngeri endala. Tuteekwa okuva mu nsi ne twawukana nayo, era tetulina kugyefaananyiriza mu mpisa zaffe newaakubadde mu bigendererwa byaffe.

Tetukyalina kugabana ku mwoyo gwayo newaakubadde ku makubo gaayo.

Tuteekwa okujjukira nti obutaka bwaffe buli mu ggulu. Tuteekwa okunoonya ebintu ebiri waggulu, Kristo gy’atudde ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda. Tuteekwa okutambula mu nsi nga Kristo bwe yatambula. Tuteekwa okubaamu endowooza eyali mu ye.

Nga bwe tuli bayise ku nsi kuno, tuteekwa okwewala okwegomba kw’omubiri, kubanga kulwanagana n’omwoyo. Ng’abaserikale abalungi aba Kristo Yesu, tuteekwa okwewala emitawaana gy’ensi nga bwe kisoboka. Kino kye kisanyusa oyo eyatuwandiika okuba abaserikale be.

Tuteekwa okwewalanga buli ngeri ya kibi. Tuteekwa okubeeranga ab’ekisa, nga tusonyiwagana, nga Katonda bwe yatusonyiwa ku lwa Kristo. Tetulina kusiba kiruyi olw’ebitulumya oba olw’obutatuyisa bulungi. Wabula tusaanidde okusasula ekirungi olw’ekibi, n’okukyusiza ettama eryokubiri abo abatulumya. Tuteekwa bulijjo okutwala ekifo ekisembayo wansi mu bantu bannaffe; ne tutanoonya kitiibwa kyaffe, wabula ekitiibwa ky’abalala. Tuteekwa okuba abakkakkamu, abawombeefu era abagonvu; nga tetulwanirira ddembe lyaffe, wabula eddembe ly’abalala. Byonna bye tukola biteekwa okukolebwa okugulumiza Katonda. Mu bufunze, nga oyo eyatuyita bw’ali omutukuvu, naffe tuteekwa okuba abatukuvu mu byonna bye tukola. Kyawandiikibwa nti, “Mubenga batukuvu, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu.”

Kale, mikwano gyange, bino byonna bya nkola ddala. Mazima ddala kitegeeza obulamu obwawukana ennyo ku bulamu bw’abasinga obungi ku abo abeeyita Abakristaayo. Kitegeeza nti tuvaako ddala era mu bujjuvu ku kwerowoozaako, ne ku nsonga n’ebigendererwa eby’okwerowoozaako. Tuli bantu ab’enjawulo, eri Katonda n’eri ensi. Obulamu bwaffe n’ebigambo byaffe ebifaanana Kristo biriraga nti tugoberera Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Tetuli ba nsi, nga naye bwe yali nga si wa nsi. Tetukyawulira nti ensimbi zaffe zaffe, wabula za Mukama, zikozesebwe mu buweereza bwe. Tetuyinza kukozesa maanyi gaffe kunoonya bya nsi byokka. Bwe tunaasooka okunoonya obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, tunaafuna bye twetaaga.

Tujja kugaanibwa okunoonya ebifo ebya waggulu oba amagoba ag’ensi. Tetuliganyizibwa kwefaananyiriza nsi mu ngeri gye tulowoozaamu oba gye tuwangaalamu. Tetujja kuba na kwegomba kwonna kwetaba mu by’amasanyu eby’obusirusiru eby’ensi. Tusaanidde okwagala eby’omu ggulu, so si eby’oku nsi. Tetujja kweweereza ffekka, wabula Mukama waffe. Tujja kutuukiriza emirimu gyaffe obulungi okusinga bwe kyali kibadde. Tujja kukola nga tugoberera ekigambo kino: “Ekyo temukikola lwa kulabibwa, abantu balyoke babasiime, wabula mukolenga ng’abaddu ba Kristo nga mukola n’omutima gwammwe gwonna, nga Katonda bw’ayagala.”

Omutindo gw’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo bwe gutaba mutangaavu, tuyinza obutategeera ddoboozi lye olw’obutamanya. Kyenva njagala okwogera mu bigambo ebitangaavu era ebitegeerekeka. Nkizudde nti, omwoyo ogwewaddeyo bwe gugoberera Mukama n’obwesigwa, ebintu ebimu bigobererawo, gye bujja oba amangu. Mpolampola, obukkakkamu n’obuteefu bw’omwoyo bifuuka obulamu obwa buli lunaku. Wabaawo okukkiriza okw’obuwulize ebyo Katonda by’ayagala, nga bwe bijja mu bibaawo buli lunaku.

Era wabaawo obugonvu mu mikono gya Katonda, okukola oba okubonaabona nga bw’ayagala. Ate era wasaanidde okubaawo obuwoomi ng’omuntu asunguwazibwa, okukkakkana wakati mu kavuyo, n’okukkiriza ebyo abalala bye baagala. Wabaawo obutafaayo ku kunyoomebwa, era n’obuteeraliikirira. Okutya n’okweraliikirira biggwaawo. Ebyo byonna, n’ebirabo by’ekisa ebirala bingi ebiri ng’ebyo, bye bibala ebya bulijjo eby’obulamu obw’omunda obwo bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda.

Ate ku mize gyabwe: Bulijjo tulaba Abakristaayo ng’abo, gye bujja oba amangu, nga beewaayo eri omulimu ogumu ogwa Katonda n’ogw’abantu bannaabwe. Beetegefu okwewaayo bo bennyini ne byonna bye balina mu buweereza bwa Mukama waabwe. Tebakyafaayo nnyo ku bintu by’omu nnyumba zaabwe n’engeri gye bawangaalamu. Okwewunda kwonna bakussa wansi w’ebintu bya Katonda.

Eddoboozi liweebwayo eri Katonda, okwogera n’okuyimba ku lulwe. Ensawo y’ensimbi eteekebwa mu buyinza bwe. Ekkalaamu eweebwayo okuwandiika ku lulwe, emimwa okwogera ku lulwe, emikono n’ebigere okukola by’alagira. Buli mwaka, Abakristaayo ng’abo beeyongera okwawukana ku by’ensi n’okulowooza eby’omu ggulu. Beeyongera okufaanana Kristo.
