Mu maaso gaabwe mulabika obulamu obulungi obw’obwakatonda obubeera mu bo. Bonna ababatunuulira bamanya nti babeera ne Katonda era babeera mu ye.

Nkakasa nti buli omu ku mmwe awulidde obubonero obumu obuva eri Katonda. Bulaga obulamu bwe nnyonnyola kaakano. Totandise kuwulira, wansi ddala mu mwoyo gwo, eddoboozi lya Katonda nga likwogerako ku nsonga zino? Tekikuluma era tekikunakuwaza mu kiseera kino okuzuula ebintu ebikyamu ebingi bwe bityo mu bulamu bwo? Omwoyo gwo tegweraliikiridde olw’okubuusabuusa ku mize egimu gye wanyumirwanga edda? Totandise kuwulira nga toteredde olw’emize egimu? Oyagala nnyo okugikyusa? Amakubo ag’okwewaayo n’ag’obuweereza tegatandise kweggulawo mu maaso go, n’ekirowoozo eky’okwegomba nti, “Owange, singa nnyinza okugatambuliramu”?

Okwegomba kwo kwonna, okubuusabuusa kwo n’okunakuwala kwo, lye ddoboozi ly’Omusumba Omulungi. Likunoonya okukuyita okuva ku byonna ebiwakanya by’ayagala. Owange! Nkwegayirira oleme kukyuka kuva ku kwegayirira kwe okw’obukkakkamu. Tomanyi n’akatono amakubo ag’ekyama g’ayagala okukutwalamu ng’ayita mu mitendera gino gyennyini. Tomanyi mikisa minene egiri ku nkomerero yaago. Singa obadde ogimanyi, wandigondedde n’essanyu byonna by’akwetaagisa. Osobola okutuuka ku ntikko z’okutuukirira kw’Omukristaayo. Okukikola, oteekwa okugoberera Omukulembeze alikutwalayo. Akubikkulira ekkubo lyo omutendera gumu gumu, ng’ayita mu bulamu bwo obwa buli lunaku. Akwetaagako kimu kyokka: okwewaayo eri okuluŋŋamya kwe.

Bw’oba ng’olumirizibwa ekibi kyonna, eryo lye ddoboozi lya Mukama wo. Kiwaayo gy’ali amangu ago nga bw’akulagira.

Sanyuka kubanga atandise okukukulembera n’okukuluŋŋamya.

Beera mugonvu ddala mu mikono gye egy’amagezi. Genda gy’akusikiriza. Kyuka okuva ku byonna ebikuleetera okwekwata. Mugondere mu bujjuvu. Ajja kukutwala mangu era mu ngeri ennyangu mu bulamu obw’ekitalo obukufaananya ye yennyini. Bujja kuba bujulirwa eri bonna abakwetoolodde, okusinga bw’oliyinza okumanya.

Nnamanya omukazi eyeewaayo okugoberera Mukama yonna gye yamukulembera. Mu myezi esatu, yava mu kuggwamu essuubi okw’amaanyi n’atuuka ku kwegatta okw’omukisa ne Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo.

Mu kizikiza kye, yeewaayo eri Mukama. Yamukwasa okusalawo kwe. Yayagala Mukama akolere mu ye, akole ebyo by’asiima. Mukama n’atandika okwogera naye ng’ayita mu Mwoyo we mu mutima gwe. Yamuleeteranga ebirowoozo by’obuweereza obutono ku lulwe. Yamuyita okuva mu makubo gonna agatafaanana Kristo.

Yategeera eddoboozi lye. Kye yatyanga kyokka kwe kumujeemera. Bw’atyo n’amugoberera, ng’agonda ku buli ky’amusaba, yonna gye yamutwala. Yamukulembera, lunaku ku lunaku. N’amufaananya by’ayagala. Obulamu bwe ne bufuuka obujulirwa eri abo abaali bamwetoolodde. Ne bamu ku abo abaali bawakanya era nga tebakkiriza baawalirizibwa okukkiriza nti kyali kiva eri Katonda. Ne basikirizibwa okwewaayo mu ngeri y’emu.

Oluvannyuma lw’emyezi esatu gyokka egy’okugoberera kuno okw’obwesigwa, ne kituukirira. Yali atambudde mangu nnyo, Mukama we n’asobola okubikkulira omwoyo gwe ogwali gwewuunya ebimu ku byama bye ebisingayo obuziba eby’okwagala? Yatuukiriza ekisuubizo kya (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:5) “Yokaana yabatiza na mazzi, naye mmwe mujja kubatizibwa na Mwoyo Mutukuvu mu nnaku si nnyingi.” n’amubatiza n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Olowooza yali yejjusizza okumugoberera mu bujjuvu? Oba nti waliwo ekirala kyonna ekijjuza omutima gwe okuggyako essanyu? Yeebaza olw’ekkubo eryamuleeta mu kifo kino eky’ekitalo. Egimu ku mitendera egyo gyali gizibu mu kiseera ekyo, naye tagyejjusa. Bw’oba oyagala omukisa, weewe ddala eri Mukama ow’omu ggulu, nga ye bwe yakola. Toganya kwewaayo kwonna kw’akusaba.

Ekkubo erituukiridde lizibu eri omubiri. Teriri zibu eri okwagala. Singa wali mulwadde ng’oyagala nnyo Katonda, wandidduse mangu wa? Mazima ddala osobola okumwesiga! Ebiragiro ebimu biyinza okusaba ebintu by’otwala ng’ebitalina mugaso. Biyinza okulabika nga tebisaanidde kufiibwako Mukama. Jjukira nti Mukama tatunuulira ebyo abantu bye batunuulira; ekitono mu maaso go kiyinza okuba, mu maaso ge, ekisumuluzo ky’ekintu ekisingayo obuziba. Okukubumba okutuuka ku by’ayagala, ateekwa okukufuna ng’oli mugonvu. Obugonvu buno bufunibwa mangu ng’ogonda mu bintu ebitono okusinga mu binene. Okwegomba kwo okukulu kwe kumugoberera mu bujjuvu; kale toyinza kumugamba bulijjo nti “Weewaawo, Mukama!” ku biragiro bye byonna ebiwoomu, ebitono oba ebinene, n’omwesiga okukukulembera mu kkubo erisingayo obumpi okutuuka ku mukisa gwo ogusingayo obujjuvu?

Mukwano gwange omwagalwa, kino, era tewali kitono ku kino, kye kyali kitegeeza okwewaayo kwo, ka obe nga wali okimanyi oba nedda. Kyali kitegeeza obuwulize obutaliiko kya kwewala. Kyali kitegeeza nti Katonda wo by’ayagala bye birina okuba by’oyagala okuva olwo, mu mbeera zonna era mu biseera byonna. Kyali kitegeeza nti, okuva olwo, walekulira eddembe lyo. Weewaayo ddala wansi w’obufuzi bwa Mukama wo. Kyali kitegeeza ekiseera eky’okumugoberera yonna gy’akukulembera. Tewali kirooto kya kudda mabega. Kaakano nkusaba okutuukiriza ekigambo kyo. Leka byonna ebirala. Beera, mu bulamu bwo obwa buli lunaku, mu bulamu obw’Obwakatonda obuli mu ggwe. Weegasse ne Mukama wo mu nkolagana ey’ekitalo. Kale tambula nga ye bwe yatambula. Laga ensi amaanyi ge ag’okulokola ng’omuleka akulokole ddala. Tolina kutya kukkiriza kino, kubanga ye Mulokozi wo, era amaanyi ge gasobola okukikola kyonna. Takusaba ggwe, mu bunafu bwo, okukikola. Akusaba kimu kyokka: okwewaayo gy’ali. Olwo ajja kukozesa amaanyi ge okukuleetera okwagala okukikola n’okukikola. Omulimu gwo kwe kwewaayo. Ogugwe kwe kukola. Tajja kukuwa kiragiro na kimu nga takuwadde maanyi kukigondera.

Teweeraliikiriranga bya nkya. Weesige Mukama wo akwagala. Yasuubiza okukulembera endiga ze mu kkubo ery’emirembe era eryangu. Tambula buli mutendera ng’akugutegeeza bulungi. Leeta obulamu bwo bwonna, mu buli kantu kaabwo, gy’ali abufuge era abuluŋŋamye. Goberera n’essanyu era mangu ebirowoozo ebiwoomu eby’Omwoyo we mu mwoyo gwo. Era, lunaku ku lunaku, ojja kumuzuula. Ajja kweyongera okukufaananya by’ayagala mu byonna. Ajja, nga bw’onoosobola okugumira, okukubumba. Olwo ojja kuba ekibya eky’ekitiibwa kye, ekitukuziddwa, ekisaanira buli mulimu omulungi. Ojja kufuna essanyu ery’okuba bbaluwa ya Kristo, emanyiddwa era esomebwa abantu bonna.

Omusana gwo gujja kwaka nnyo ne kiba nti abantu, bwe banaalaba ebikolwa byo ebirungi, baligulumiza Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, so si ggwe.

Twalondebwa “okufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi” ky’Omwana wa Katonda. Kino, kya lwatu, tekitegeeza kufaanana mu ndabika ya mubiri, wabula kufaanana mu mpisa ne mu butonde. Kitegeeza okufaanana mu birowoozo, mu nneewulira, mu kwegomba, mu bye twagala ne bye tukyawa. Kitegeeza nti tusaanidde okulowooza n’okukola nga Kristo bwe yandikoze singa yali mu mbeera zaffe.

Omuwala omuto yabuuzibwa olumu kye kitegeeza okuba Omukristaayo. N’addamu nti, “Kitegeeza okuba nga Kristo bwe yandibadde, singa yali muwala muto ng’abeera mu nnyumba yaffe.” Ekyama ky’obulamu bwa Kristo kyali kwagala kwe okutaliimu kwefaako eri abalala. Bwe tuba nga tumufaanana, kino kijja kuba kyama kyaffe naffe. Yalokola abalala, naye ye yennyini teyasobola kwerokola. Ye “teyeesanyusa yekka.” Bwe tutyo naffe, “so si okwesanyusa ffekka.” Wabula tusaanidde okusanyusa muliraanwa waffe, bwe kiba nga kya bulungi bwe.

Omuhindu omu omulowoozi, eyakyalidde Bungereza ne Amerika gye buvuddeko okwekenneenya Obukristaayo, yagamba nti, “Abakristaayo kye beetaaga, Obukristaayo bwa Kristo bweyongereko katono, n’obw’abantu bukendeereko katono.” Obukristaayo bw’abantu buyigiriza okwefiiriza okwerokola ffe bennyini. Obukristaayo bwa Kristo buyigiriza okwefiiriza okulokola abalala. Obukristaayo bw’abantu buzaala okwefaako okutaliiko bibala okungi ennyo mu ddiini yaffe. Obukristaayo bwa Kristo buzaala obutefaako obw’omukisa. Buva mu bulamu obufukibwa ku lw’abalala, nga obubwe bwe bwali. Mu bufunze, ekitabo kyaffe kiyigiriza kintu kimu: tulina okuba Abakristaayo abafaanana Kristo. Era byonna bye tuyitamu tebiriiko kye bigasa bwe bitaleeta kino. “Si bonna abampita nti, ‘Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe,’ be baliyingira obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, wabula abo bokka abakola ebyo Kitange ali mu ggulu by’ayagala.” (Matayo 7:21)
fields.body_text: Obanga byonna ebyogeddwa ku bulamu bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda bya mazima, kale bisaanidde okweyolekera mu bulamu bwaffe obwa bulijjo. Abo ababunyumirwa basaanidde okuba “eggwanga ery’envuma, erinyiikirira ebikolwa ebirungi.” Mutabani wange bwe yali ku ttendekero ekkulu yawandiikira mukwano gwe nti Abakristaayo kibagwanidde okuba abajulirwa ba Katonda. Ensi tegenda kusoma Bayibuli, naye ejja kusoma obulamu bwaffe. Okukkiriza kwe balina mu ddiini yaffe kwesigamye ku bujulirwa obulamu bwaffe bwe buwa. Nga ffenna bwe tumanyi, guno mulembe gwa bikolwa ebirabika. Abantu bava ku kubuuza ku ndowooza ne babuuza ku bintu ebiriwo ddala. Obanga eddiini yaffe eneeyongera mu maaso, kiteekwa okukakasibwa nti si ndowooza buwoozi. Tuteekwa okulaga ebirowoozo by’omulembe gwaffe ebyekenneenya ennyo ebintu ebikulu eby’obulamu obukyusiddwa amaanyi ga Katonda ag’ekitalo agakolera mu ffe okukola by’ayagala. “Mutulage ‘engeri z’obulamu,’ bwe boogera bannassaayansi, era tujja kukkiriza. Ekkanisa bw’erireeta mu maaso gaabwe, mu bammemba baayo bonna, obulamu obutukuvu, ekigo kyabwe ekisembayo kiriwambibwa.” Nandyagadde, nga sinnaggalawo kitabo kyange, okwogera mu ngeri ey’obukulu ennyo ku bibala by’obulamu obw’okukkiriza, obw’engeri gye mbadde nnyonnyola. Nzikiriza nti byetaagisa. Nkubiriza abasomi bange okuwulira obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwe obw’okutambula mu ngeri esaanira okuyitibwa kwabwe okw’ekitiibwa. Njagala okwogera ne bamu ku mmwe nga mikwano gyange. Nkakasa nti, okuyita mu kitabo kino, okwegomba kwe tugabana kukuze mu mitima gyammwe, nga bwe kukuze ne mu gwange. Tusaanidde okutenda ebirungi bya Katonda eyatuggya mu kizikiza n’atuyingiza mu butangaavu bwe obutenkanika. Nga mukwano gwammwe, nnyinza okwogera mu bwerufu eri mikwano gyange. Munsonyiwe bwe nnaayogera ku nsonga ezimu enkulu ez’obulamu n’empisa. Zikulu nnyo eri okukula okw’amazima mu Bukristaayo. Omutindo gw’obulamu obutukuvu mu Bakristaayo guli wansi. Okwewaayo kwonna okw’amazima mu bulamu n’empisa kwewuunyisa bangi mu Kkanisa, era emirundi mingi tebakusiima. Abasinga obungi ku abo abeeyita abagoberezi ba Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo tebamufaanana. Omuntu ow’ebweru yandirabye okukwatagana kutono nnyo wakati wabwe naye. Naye ffe, abawulidde Katonda ng’atuyita okwewaayo kwonna n’okwesiga kwonna, tuteekwa okukola mu ngeri endala. Tuteekwa okuva mu nsi ne twawukana nayo, era tetulina kugyefaananyiriza mu mpisa zaffe newaakubadde mu bigendererwa byaffe. Tetukyalina kugabana ku mwoyo gwayo newaakubadde ku makubo gaayo. Tuteekwa okujjukira nti obutaka bwaffe buli mu ggulu. Tuteekwa okunoonya ebintu ebiri waggulu, Kristo gy’atudde ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda. Tuteekwa okutambula mu nsi nga Kristo bwe yatambula. Tuteekwa okubaamu endowooza eyali mu ye. Nga bwe tuli bayise ku nsi kuno, tuteekwa okwewala okwegomba kw’omubiri, kubanga kulwanagana n’omwoyo. Ng’abaserikale abalungi aba Kristo Yesu, tuteekwa okwewala emitawaana gy’ensi nga bwe kisoboka. Kino kye kisanyusa oyo eyatuwandiika okuba abaserikale be. Tuteekwa okwewalanga buli ngeri ya kibi. Tuteekwa okubeeranga ab’ekisa, nga tusonyiwagana, nga Katonda bwe yatusonyiwa ku lwa Kristo. Tetulina kusiba kiruyi olw’ebitulumya oba olw’obutatuyisa bulungi. Wabula tusaanidde okusasula ekirungi olw’ekibi, n’okukyusiza ettama eryokubiri abo abatulumya. Tuteekwa bulijjo okutwala ekifo ekisembayo wansi mu bantu bannaffe; ne tutanoonya kitiibwa kyaffe, wabula ekitiibwa ky’abalala. Tuteekwa okuba abakkakkamu, abawombeefu era abagonvu; nga tetulwanirira ddembe lyaffe, wabula eddembe ly’abalala. Byonna bye tukola biteekwa okukolebwa okugulumiza Katonda. Mu bufunze, nga oyo eyatuyita bw’ali omutukuvu, naffe tuteekwa okuba abatukuvu mu byonna bye tukola. Kyawandiikibwa nti, “Mubenga batukuvu, kubanga nze ndi mutukuvu.” Kale, mikwano gyange, bino byonna bya nkola ddala. Mazima ddala kitegeeza obulamu obwawukana ennyo ku bulamu bw’abasinga obungi ku abo abeeyita Abakristaayo. Kitegeeza nti tuvaako ddala era mu bujjuvu ku kwerowoozaako, ne ku nsonga n’ebigendererwa eby’okwerowoozaako. Tuli bantu ab’enjawulo, eri Katonda n’eri ensi. Obulamu bwaffe n’ebigambo byaffe ebifaanana Kristo biriraga nti tugoberera Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo. Tetuli ba nsi, nga naye bwe yali nga si wa nsi. Tetukyawulira nti ensimbi zaffe zaffe, wabula za Mukama, zikozesebwe mu buweereza bwe. Tetuyinza kukozesa maanyi gaffe kunoonya bya nsi byokka. Bwe tunaasooka okunoonya obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, tunaafuna bye twetaaga. Tujja kugaanibwa okunoonya ebifo ebya waggulu oba amagoba ag’ensi. Tetuliganyizibwa kwefaananyiriza nsi mu ngeri gye tulowoozaamu oba gye tuwangaalamu. Tetujja kuba na kwegomba kwonna kwetaba mu by’amasanyu eby’obusirusiru eby’ensi. Tusaanidde okwagala eby’omu ggulu, so si eby’oku nsi. Tetujja kweweereza ffekka, wabula Mukama waffe. Tujja kutuukiriza emirimu gyaffe obulungi okusinga bwe kyali kibadde. Tujja kukola nga tugoberera ekigambo kino: “Ekyo temukikola lwa kulabibwa, abantu balyoke babasiime, wabula mukolenga ng’abaddu ba Kristo nga mukola n’omutima gwammwe gwonna, nga Katonda bw’ayagala.” Omutindo gw’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo bwe gutaba mutangaavu, tuyinza obutategeera ddoboozi lye olw’obutamanya. Kyenva njagala okwogera mu bigambo ebitangaavu era ebitegeerekeka. Nkizudde nti, omwoyo ogwewaddeyo bwe gugoberera Mukama n’obwesigwa, ebintu ebimu bigobererawo, gye bujja oba amangu. Era wabaawo obugonvu mu mikono gya Katonda, okukola oba okubonaabona nga bw’ayagala. Ate era wasaanidde okubaawo obuwoomi ng’omuntu asunguwazibwa, okukkakkana wakati mu kavuyo, n’okukkiriza ebyo abalala bye baagala. Wabaawo obutafaayo ku kunyoomebwa, era n’obuteeraliikirira. Okutya n’okweraliikirira biggwaawo. Ebyo byonna, n’ebirabo by’ekisa ebirala bingi ebiri ng’ebyo, bye bibala ebya bulijjo eby’obulamu obw’omunda obwo bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda. Ekkalaamu eweebwayo okuwandiika ku lulwe, emimwa okwogera ku lulwe, emikono n’ebigere okukola by’alagira. Buli mwaka, Abakristaayo ng’abo beeyongera okwawukana ku by’ensi n’okulowooza eby’omu ggulu. Ekkubo erituukiridde lizibu eri omubiri. Teriri zibu eri okwagala. Singa wali mulwadde ng’oyagala nnyo Katonda, wandidduse mangu wa? Mazima ddala osobola okumwesiga! Ebiragiro ebimu biyinza okusaba ebintu by’otwala ng’ebitalina mugaso. Biyinza okulabika nga tebisaanidde kufiibwako Mukama. Jjukira nti Mukama tatunuulira ebyo abantu bye batunuulira; ekitono mu maaso go kiyinza okuba, mu maaso ge, ekisumuluzo ky’ekintu ekisingayo obuziba. Okukubumba okutuuka ku by’ayagala, ateekwa okukufuna ng’oli mugonvu. Obugonvu buno bufunibwa mangu ng’ogonda mu bintu ebitono okusinga mu binene. Okwegomba kwo okukulu kwe kumugoberera mu bujjuvu; kale toyinza kumugamba bulijjo nti “Weewaawo, Mukama!” ku biragiro bye byonna ebiwoomu, ebitono oba ebinene, n’omwesiga okukukulembera mu kkubo erisingayo obumpi okutuuka ku mukisa gwo ogusingayo obujjuvu? Mukwano gwange omwagalwa, kino, era tewali kitono ku kino, kye kyali kitegeeza okwewaayo kwo, ka obe nga wali okimanyi oba nedda. Kyali kitegeeza obuwulize obutaliiko kya kwewala. Kyali kitegeeza nti Katonda wo by’ayagala bye birina okuba by’oyagala okuva olwo, mu mbeera zonna era mu biseera byonna. Kyali kitegeeza nti, okuva olwo, walekulira eddembe lyo. Weewaayo ddala wansi w’obufuzi bwa Mukama wo. Kyali kitegeeza ekiseera eky’okumugoberera yonna gy’akukulembera. Tewali kirooto kya kudda mabega. Kaakano nkusaba okutuukiriza ekigambo kyo. Leka byonna ebirala. Beera, mu bulamu bwo obwa buli lunaku, mu bulamu obw’Obwakatonda obuli mu ggwe. Weegasse ne Mukama wo mu nkolagana ey’ekitalo. Kale tambula nga ye bwe yatambula. Laga ensi amaanyi ge ag’okulokola ng’omuleka akulokole ddala. Tolina kutya kukkiriza kino, kubanga ye Mulokozi wo, era amaanyi ge gasobola okukikola kyonna. Takusaba ggwe, mu bunafu bwo, okukikola. Akusaba kimu kyokka: okwewaayo gy’ali. Olwo ajja kukozesa amaanyi ge okukuleetera okwagala okukikola n’okukikola. Omulimu gwo kwe kwewaayo. Ogugwe kwe kukola. Tajja kukuwa kiragiro na kimu nga takuwadde maanyi kukigondera. Teweeraliikiriranga bya nkya. Weesige Mukama wo akwagala. Yasuubiza okukulembera endiga ze mu kkubo ery’emirembe era eryangu. Tambula buli mutendera ng’akugutegeeza bulungi. Leeta obulamu bwo bwonna, mu buli kantu kaabwo, gy’ali abufuge era abuluŋŋamye. Goberera n’essanyu era mangu ebirowoozo ebiwoomu eby’Omwoyo we mu mwoyo gwo. Era, lunaku ku lunaku, ojja kumuzuula. Ajja kweyongera okukufaananya by’ayagala mu byonna. Ajja, nga bw’onoosobola okugumira, okukubumba. Olwo ojja kuba ekibya eky’ekitiibwa kye, ekitukuziddwa, ekisaanira buli mulimu omulungi. Ojja kufuna essanyu ery’okuba bbaluwa ya Kristo, emanyiddwa era esomebwa abantu bonna. Omusana gwo gujja kwaka nnyo ne kiba nti abantu, bwe banaalaba ebikolwa byo ebirungi, baligulumiza Kitaffe ali mu ggulu, so si ggwe. Twalondebwa “okufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi” ky’Omwana wa Katonda. Kino, kya lwatu, tekitegeeza kufaanana mu ndabika ya mubiri, wabula kufaanana mu mpisa ne mu butonde. Kitegeeza okufaanana mu birowoozo, mu nneewulira, mu kwegomba, mu bye twagala ne bye tukyawa. Kitegeeza nti tusaanidde okulowooza n’okukola nga Kristo bwe yandikoze singa yali mu mbeera zaffe. Omuwala omuto yabuuzibwa olumu kye kitegeeza okuba Omukristaayo. N’addamu nti, “Kitegeeza okuba nga Kristo bwe yandibadde, singa yali muwala muto ng’abeera mu nnyumba yaffe.” Ekyama ky’obulamu bwa Kristo kyali kwagala kwe okutaliimu kwefaako eri abalala. Bwe tuba nga tumufaanana, kino kijja kuba kyama kyaffe naffe. Yalokola abalala, naye ye yennyini teyasobola kwerokola. Ye “teyeesanyusa yekka.” Bwe tutyo naffe, “so si okwesanyusa ffekka.” Wabula tusaanidde okusanyusa muliraanwa waffe, bwe kiba nga kya bulungi bwe. Omuhindu omu omulowoozi, eyakyalidde Bungereza ne Amerika gye buvuddeko okwekenneenya Obukristaayo, yagamba nti, “Abakristaayo kye beetaaga, Obukristaayo bwa Kristo bweyongereko katono, n’obw’abantu bukendeereko katono.” Obukristaayo bw’abantu buyigiriza okwefiiriza okwerokola ffe bennyini. Obukristaayo bwa Kristo buyigiriza okwefiiriza okulokola abalala. Obukristaayo bw’abantu buzaala okwefaako okutaliiko bibala okungi ennyo mu ddiini yaffe. Obukristaayo bwa Kristo buzaala obutefaako obw’omukisa. Buva mu bulamu obufukibwa ku lw’abalala, nga obubwe bwe bwali. Mu bufunze, ekitabo kyaffe kiyigiriza kintu kimu: tulina okuba Abakristaayo abafaanana Kristo. Era byonna bye tuyitamu tebiriiko kye bigasa bwe bitaleeta kino. “Si bonna abampita nti, ‘Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe,’ be baliyingira obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, wabula abo bokka abakola ebyo Kitange ali mu ggulu by’ayagala.” (Matayo 7:21)

fields.title: Essanyu ly’Obuwulize
fields.body_html:
Nnasoma olumu nti: “Obuwulize obutuukiridde bwandireese essanyu erituukiridde, singa twali n’okwesiga okutuukiridde mu buyinza bwe tugondera.” Kyankwatako nnyo. Kyandaga ekkubo ery’okufuna essanyu erisoboka, wadde nga nnali sirirootangako. Oluvannyuma, wadde nga nnali mujeemu, ekigambo ekyo kyagenda kinkomako buli kiseera. Kyasuubiza ekiwummulo n’ekkubo ery’okukula. Kyakkakkanya era ne kimatiza okwegomba kwange.

Nteekwa okugamba nti ekiwummulo kino nkizudde, si ng’ekirooto, wabula ng’ekintu ekiriwo ddala. Nkirabye mu Mukama Yesu, Mukama waffe. Tusobola okwewaayo gy’ali ne tusitula ekikoligo kye okufuna ekiwummulo ekituukiridde. Ggwe, omwoyo omwagalwa ogulonzalonza, tomanyi ssanyu ly’ofiirwa. Mukama yeeraze gy’oli. Akuyita okwewaayo kwonna. Weekwata era olonzalonza. Okwewaayo okw’ekigero oli mwetegefu okukukola, era olowooza nti mazima kisaanidde era kituufu okukukola. Naye olabika ng’olowooza nti okwewaayo okujjuvu, awatali kusigaza kintu, kungi nnyo okusabibwa. Kukutiisa. Kizingiramu bingi nnyo, bw’olowooza, era mulimu munene nnyo. Kye wandyagadde kwe kugonda mu kigero; ekirowoozo eky’okugonda mu bujjuvu kikutiisa nnyo.

Olaba n’abalala. Batambulira mu kkubo eddene okusinga eryo eryakulambikibwa ggwe, ng’emitima gyabwe tegibalumiriza. Weebuuza nti, lwaki kino? Kirabika ng’ekyewuunyisa, era oboolyawo nga kizibu, nti oteekwa okukola ebyo bo bye batalina kukola. Era nti oteekwa okulekayo ebyo bo bye balina eddembe okukola. Owange! Omukristaayo omwagalwa, enjawulo eno yennyini wakati wammwe kye kirabo kyo eky’enjawulo, newaakubadde nga tonnakimanya. Mukama wo agamba nti, “Buli anjagala anaagonderanga ebiragiro byange; era kubanga anjagala, ne Kitange anaamwagalanga. Era nange nnaamwagalanga, era nnaamulabikiranga.”(Yokaana 14:21) Ggwe olina ebiragiro bye; abo b’okwatirwa obuggya tebabirina. Omanyi Mukama wo ky’alowooza ku bintu bingi, bo mwe bakyatambulira mu kizikiza. Kino si kirabo kya njawulo? Kya kunakuwalira nti omwoyo gwo guli kumpi nnyo ne Mukama wo? Ayinza okukubuulira ebintu abo abali ewala bye batamanyi. Tolaba nti kino kitegeeza omukwano ogw’okumpi ennyo era ogw’ekisa?

Enkolagana nnyingi mu bulamu zeetaaga okwewaayo okw’ekigero kyokka okuva ku njuyi zombi. Tuyinza okuba n’emikwano eminene.

Kyokka obulamu bwaffe obusinga tubumala mu mirimu egy’enjawulo egyawukana. Bwe tuba awamu, tuyinza okunyumirwa okubeera awamu. Tuyinza okuzuula ebintu bingi bye twagala ffembi. Naye okwawukana tekutunakuwaza. Emikwano emirala egy’okumpi tegitaataaganya. Tetulina kwagala kumala kutuwa ddembe oba kwegomba kugabana ku nsonga zaffe ezisingayo okuba ez’ekyama. Twewulira nti okwekuumako n’okubeera ebbanga kye kisaanidde. Naye waliwo enkolagana endala mu bulamu nga bino byonna bikyuka. Omukwano gufuuka okwagala. Emitima ebiri gyewaayo eri ginnaagyo, ne gitaba ebiri nate wabula kimu.

Wabaawo okwegatta kw’emyoyo, okufuula byonna eby’omu okuba eby’omunne. Ebyo bye baagala eby’enjawulo n’amakubo ag’enjawulo mu bulamu tebikyasoboka. Ebintu ebyali bikkirizibwa edda kaakano tebikkirizibwa. Kiri bwe kityo olw’obunywevu bw’omukago ogubasiba. Okwekuumako n’ebbanga ebisaanira omukwano obwabwo bifuuka bya kabi mu kwagala. Okwagala kuwaayo byonna, era kuteekwa okufuna byonna mu kuddamu. Omu by’ayagala bisiba omunne.

Buli mutima gwegomba okumanya ebyo omunne by’ayagala mu kyama. Gwagala okubuukira ku mpewo okubituukiriza.

Abantu ng’abo bawulira nga bakooye olw’omugugu okwagala gwe kubatikka? Bakwatirwa obuggya emikwano egy’ebbugumu ettono egy’obukkakkamu gye balaba? Bejjusa okubeera okumpi n’omwagalwa waabwe olw’obuvunaanyizibwa bwe kuleeta?

Tebeenyumiriza mu buvunaanyizibwa buno bwennyini? Era, n’essanyu ery’obukkakkamu n’ery’okujaguza, tebasaasira abo abaavu abali ewala abatya okusemberera okumpi bwe batyo? Buli kubikkulirwa okupya okw’ebirowoozo by’omunne si ssanyu? Era waliwo ekkubo lyonna erizibu okwagala kwabwe lye kubawaliriza okutambuliramu? Owange! Emyoyo emyagalwa, bwe muba nga kino mwali mukimanyi, ne bwe kiba kya ssaawa ntono; bwe muba nga mwali mwagalako omuntu okutuuka n’okufuna essanyu mu kwefiiriza ku lulwe; bwe muba nga mwali mwegombyeko okukwasa omulala okusalawo kwammwe ng’ekirabo ekiwoomu, kale, ku lw’okwagala kwonna okwa Mukama wammwe ow’omu ggulu, mbakubiriza okukola bwe mutyo eri Katonda!

Akwagala n’okwagala okusinga okw’omukwano. Nga omugole omusajja bwasanyukira oyo gw’awasizza, bw’atyo naye bw’akusanyukira ggwe. Okwewaayo okujjuvu kwokka kwe kuyinza okumumatiza. Akuwadde byonna, era akusaba byonna mu kuddamu. Okwekuumako kwonna, ne bwe kuba kutono nnyo, kujja kumunakuwaza okutuuka ku mutima. Ye teyeesaasira yennyini, kale ggwe oyinza otya okwesaasira? Ku lulwo, yawaayo byonna bye yalina. Ku lulwe, naawe oteekwa okukola kye kimu. Owange, beera mugabi mu kwewaayo kwo! Okwewaayo kwe gy’oli okutaliiko kigero kusisinkane n’okwewaayo gy’ali okutaliiko kigero. Sanyuka era yanguwa okwesuula mu mikono gye egy’omukwano, n’okumukwasa enkoba z’obufuzi. Kyonna ky’oli, mukkirize abe nakyo kyonna. Lekulira emirembe gyonna buli kintu ekyawukana ku ye. Ndekulira eddembe lyange ery’okwerondera. Nsanyukira okwegatta kwaffe. Kufuula okwewaayo kwange si kya kusoboka kyokka, wabula kya bwetaavu.

Tewegombangako kwagala muntu ali ewala? Tewali kumpi kimala okusemberera mu ngeri ey’okumpi ennyo. Towulirangako kwegomba okw’amaanyi okwewaayo gy’ali? Naye nga tolina muntu gw’oyinza kuwa kwagala okwo. Emikono gyo tegibaddemu eccupa ez’omuwendo omungi ez’amafuta ag’akaloosa? Tobangako kumpi kimala n’omutima gwonna okugafuka. Bw’owulira eddoboozi eriwoomu erya Mukama wo, akuyita mu kifo eky’okumpi ennyo naye. Kyetaagisa okwawukana n’ebirala byonna. Kijja kufuula okwewaayo kwo si kya kusoboka kyokka, wabula kya bwetaavu. Onooddirira oba onoolonzalonza?

Onoolaba nga kizibu nti akubikkulira by’alowooza okusinga abalala? Tajja kukuganya kusanyukira kintu kyonna ekikwawula ku ye. Oyagala okugenda gy’atasobola kugenda naawe, oba okubeera n’emirimu gy’atasobola kugabanako?

Nedda! Nedda, emirundi lukumi, nedda! Ojja kubuuka okusisinkana by’ayagala n’essanyu eringi. Ne by’ayagala ebisingayo obutono bijja kufuuka gy’oli etteeka erikusiba, lye kyandikumenya omutima okujeemera. Ojja kusanyukira obufunda bw’ekkubo ly’akuteerawo. Ojja kusaasira, n’ennaku etaliiko kkomo, abo abaavu abali ewala abaafiirwa essanyu lino. Obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okwagala bujja kuba bye birabo byakwo ebisingayo obuwoomi. Eddembe lyo ery’okuwa Mukama wo byonna by’olina lijja kuwulira ng’akuyimusa mu nsi ey’ekitiibwa ekitayogerekeka. Essanyu erituukiridde lijja kuva mu buwulize obutuukiridde. Olwo ojja kumanyako katono Yesu kye yategeeza bwe yagamba nti, “Nsanyukira okukola ky’oyagala, Ayi Katonda wange, kubanga amateeka go gali mu mutima gwange.”(Zabbuli 40:8) Era olowooza nti essanyu lino lijja kuba ku ludda lwo lwokka? Mukama talina ssanyu mu abo abeewaddeyo gy’ali bwe batyo, era abaagala okumugondera? Owange, mikwano gyange, tetusaanira kwogera ku kino. Naye Ebyawandiikibwa bitulaga ku bitundutundu by’essanyu, okumatira n’okusanyuka Mukama waffe by’alina mu ffe. Bisikiriza omwoyo n’obubonero bwabyo obw’ekitalo obw’omukisa. Nti ffe tumwetaaga, kyangu okutegeera; nti ye atwetaaga, kirabika nga tekitegeerekeka. Kya butonde okumwegomba. Naye nti ye atwegomba, kizibu okukikkiriza. Kyokka, emirundi n’emirundi, akyogera, era kiki kye tuyinza okukola okuggyako okumukkiriza?

Yatonda emitima gyaffe nga gisobola okuwulira okwagala kuno okunene. Yeewaddeyo okuba kye kwolekera. Kwa muwendo nnyo gy’ali okutayogerekeka. Agamba nti, “Buli anjagala anaagonderanga ebiragiro byange; era kubanga anjagala, ne Kitange anaamwagalanga.

Era nange nnaamwagalanga, era nnaamulabikiranga”(Yokaana 14:21). Akonkona ku buli mutima, ng’anoonya okuba okwagala kwagwo okusingayo. “Onkkiriza okuba owuwo?” bw’agamba omukkiriza, “Okuba omwagalwa wo, onoongoberera mu kubonaabona ne mu kubeera wekka? Onoogumiikiriza obuzibu ku lwange? Tosaba mpeera yonna okuggyako okumwenya kwange n’okutenderezebwa kwange.

Onooyesuula n’okwewaayo okujjuvu mu bye njagala? Onompa obufuzi obujjuvu ku ggwe ne ku byonna by’oli? Onoomatira okunsanyusa nze nzekka? Nkole nga bwe njagala munda mu ggwe mu byonna? Onooyingira mu kwegatta nange okw’okumpi ennyo okutuuka okwetaagisa okwawukana n’ensi? Onoonzikiriza nga Mukama wo omu yekka, n’olekayo abalala bonna, okunywerera ku nze nzekka?” Mu ngeri lukumi, awa buli mukkiriza ekisuubizo kino eky’okuba omu naye. Naye si bonna abamugamba “Weewaawo,” mu kuddamu. Okwagala okulala n’ebirala bye baagala bibalabikira nga bya muwendo nnyo okubisuula.

Tebafiirwa ggulu lwa kino. Naye bafiirwa essanyu eritayogerekeka.

Ggwe, naye, toli omu ku bo. Okuva ku lubereberye omwoyo gwo gukaabidde n’obwagazi n’essanyu eri byonna by’akuwa nti, “Weewaawo, Mukama; weewaawo!” Oli mwetegefu nnyo okumufukako eby’obugagga byo byonna ebisingayo obulungi eby’okwagala n’okwewaayo. Obunyiikivu bwo mu kwewaayo buyinza okutaataaganya Abakristaayo abamu ab’ekigero.

Okwagala kwo kwetaagisa okwawukana n’ensi, okwagala okwa wansi kwe kutayinza na kulowooza.

Ssaddaaka n’obuweereza bisoboka era biwoomera ggwe. Tebiyinza kuva mu mutima ogwewaddeyo ekitono.

Obulamu bw’oyingiddemu bukuwa eddembe ery’okufuka byonna by’olina n’omutima omugabi ku mwagalwa wo. Obuweereza emyoyo egiri ewala bwe gitamanyiiko kintu, kaakano bufuuka kirabo kyo ekisingayo obuwoomi.

Mukama wo akwetaagako, olw’okwegatta kwo naye, ebingi nnyo okusinga by’abetaagako bo.

Ekikkirizibwa gye bali, okwagala kukufuulidde ekitakkirizibwa. Ggwe asobola okukumanyisa ebyama bye, era ggwe gw’asuubira okuddamu amangu ago buli okwagala kwe kye kwetaaga. Owange, kya kitalo! Ekirabo eky’ekitiibwa ekitayogerekeka ky’oyingiddemu! Tekirina nnyo kye kigasa abantu bwe banaakukyawa. Bayinza okukwewala, okukuvuma, n’okusiiga erinnya lyo enziro ku lulwe! “Musanyukanga ku lunaku olwo ne mujaguza, kubanga empeera yammwe nnene mu ggulu, bwe tubonaabonera awamu naye, tulyoke tuweerwe wamu naye ekitiibwa.” Mu ggwe alaba ku ebyo ebiva mu kubonaabona kwe, omutima gwe ne gutereera. Okwagala kwo n’okwewaayo kwo y’empeera ye ey’omuwendo olw’ebyo byonna by’akukoledde.

Kiwoomera nnyo gy’ali okutayogerekeka. Kale totya kwesuula mu kwewaayo eri Mukama wo n’omutima gwonna, okutagumiikiriza kwekuumako kwonna. Abalala bayinza obutakisiima, naye ye ajja kukisiima, era ekyo kimala. Tobalirira buwulize bwo wadde obuweereza bwo. Omutima gwo n’omukono gwo bibeere ebyeyagalire okumuweereza, ng’omutima gwe n’omukono gwe bwe byali ebyeyagalire okukuweereza ggwe. Mukkirize abe na byonna by’oli, omubiri, emmeeme n’omwoyo, ebiseera, ebitone, eddoboozi, buli kintu. Bikkula obulamu bwo bwonna mu maaso ge alyoke abufuge. Mugambenga buli lunaku nti, “Mukama, nnaategeka ntya olunaku luno ndyoke nkusanyuse? Nnaagenda wa? Nnaakola ki? Nnaakyalira ani? Nnaayogera ki?” Kwasa amagezi go mu buyinza bwe ogambe nti, “Mukama, ndaga engeri y’okulowoozaamu ndyoke nkusanyuse?” Muwe by’osoma, by’onoonya, n’emikwano gyo. Olwo ogambe nti, “Mukama, mpa okutegeera okusalira ebintu bino omusango n’amagezi go.” Waleme okubaawo olunaku wadde essaawa mw’otakolera by’ayagala n’okutegeera, ng’omugoberera mu bujjuvu.

Okumuweereza kujja kuwa obulamu bwo ekitiibwa ekikwetoolodde. Kujja kumasamasa ne ku bulamu obusingayo okuba obwa bulijjo n’ekitangaala eky’omu ggulu.

Wali onakuwadde nti obulungi obw’ekirooto obw’obuvubuka buggwaawo mangu mu bintu ebikakali eby’ensi? Leeta Katonda mu bulamu bwo ne mu buli kantu kaabwo. Essanyu erisingako lijja kukankanya omwoyo gwo okusinga ennaku z’obuvubuka ezisingayo okumasamasa bwe zaali ziyinza okumanya. Tewali kintu kijja kuddamu kulabika nga kizibu oba kikakali. Obulamu obusingayo obutaba na kitiibwa bujja kugulumizibwa olw’ekyo. Bwe nnali ntunuulira omukazi omwavu ng’ayoza engoye mu bbaafu, nnalowooza ku bintu by’obulamu bwe ebimalamu amaanyi. Neebuuza lwaki obulamu ng’obwo buteekwa okubaawo. Olwo, n’essanyu eryankankanya, ne nzijukira nti nabwo busobola okugulumizibwa. Ne neegamba nti, n’obulamu buno, nga bubeerwamu mu Kristo era wamu naye, nga bumugoberera yonna gy’akulembera, bwandibadde bwa kitiibwa.

Buli ssaawa yaabwo yandijjudde obunyiikivu.

Kinsanyusa okumanya nti emikisa gya Katonda egisingayo obunene giri n’obulamu obusingayo obwavu n’obuwombeefu. “Kubanga,” bw’agamba Mukama waffe yennyini, “buli muntu,” ka abe mugagga oba mwavu, mukadde oba muto, muddu oba wa ddembe.

Kubanga buli muntu akola Katonda by’asiima ye muganda wange, ye mwannyinaze era ye mmange.

Lowooza akaseera katono ku bigambo bino ebyangu naye eby’ekitalo. Muganda we, mwannyina, ne nnyina! Kiki kye tutandiwaddeyo okubeera omu ku abo! Owange, ka nkwegayirire, Omukristaayo omwagalwa. Jjangu, olegeeko olabe nga Mukama bw’ali omulungi. Alina ebintu eby’ekitalo by’aterekedde abo “abagondera ebiragiro bye, era abakola ebimusanyusa.” “Bw’onoogonderanga Mukama Katonda wo n’okwatanga amateeka ge gonna ge nkuwa leero, Mukama Katonda wo alikugulumiza n’akuteeka waggulu w’amawanga gonna ag’oku nsi. Emikisa gino gyonna onoogifunanga n’obeeranga nagyo, bw’onoowuliranga eddoboozi lya Mukama Katonda wo.”

“Onooweebwanga omukisa bw’onoobeeranga mu kibuga ne bw’onoobeeranga mu kyalo. Abaana ab’omu nda yo banaaweebwanga omukisa, n’ebisimbe eby’omu ttaka lyo, n’ebisibo byo ebinaazaalibwanga, Ennyana z’ente ez’amagana go, n’obwana bw’endiga ez’ebisibo byo. Ekibbo kyo mw’onookuŋŋaanyizanga, n’olutiba lwo mw’onoogoyeranga nabyo binaabanga n’omukisa. Onoobanga n’omukisa ng’oyingira era onoobanga n’omukisa ng’ofuluma. Mukama anaakuwanga okuwangula abalabe bo abanaakulumbanga. Banajjiranga mu kkubo limu okukulumba, naye ne basaasaanira mu makubo musanvu mu maaso go nga bawanguddwa. (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 28:3-7) “Mukama anaawanga amawanika go omukisa, ne buli ky’onookwatangako engalo zo okukikola anaakiwanga omukisa. Mukama Katonda wo anaakuwanga omukisa ng’oli mu nsi gy’akuwa. Mukama agenda kukufuula eggwanga lye ettukuvu nga bwe yakusuubiza n’ekirayiro, bw’onookwatanga amateeka ga Mukama Katonda wo n’otambuliranga mu makubo ge.” (Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 28:8-9) “Kale nno abantu ab’omu mawanga gonna ag’ensi balitegeera nga bw’oyitibwa erinnya lya Mukama era banaakutyanga. Mukama anaakugaggawazanga nnyo mu byonna: mu zadde ery’enda yo, ne mu baana ab’ebisibo byo by’onoolundanga, ne mu bibala eby’omu ttaka lyo, ng’oli mu nsi Mukama gye yalayirira bajjajjaabo okugikuwa. Mukama alikuggulirawo eggwanika lye ery’obugagga bwe ery’eggulu, n’atonnyesanga enkuba mu ttaka lyo, mu biseera byayo, ne buli kintu kyonna ky’onookolanga anaakiwanga omukisa. Onoowolanga amawanga mangi, kyokka ggwe toogeewolengako n’akatono. Mukama anaakufuulanga mutwe so si mukira. Bw’onoogonderanga ebiragiro bya Mukama Katonda wo bye nkutegeeza leero, n’obigobereranga n’obwegendereza, onoobanga ku ntikko waggulu, so tookooberenga.”(Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 28:10-13) Eri Abayisirayiri, gwali gwa kungulu era gwa kiseera. Eri ffe, gwa munda era gwa mwoyo. Era gwa kitiibwa nnyo okusingawo. Okusalawo kwaffe okwewaddeyo ka kubuuke okwaniriza omukisa ogwo mu bujjuvu bwagwo bwonna!
fields.body_text: Nnasoma olumu nti: “Obuwulize obutuukiridde bwandireese essanyu erituukiridde, singa twali n’okwesiga okutuukiridde mu buyinza bwe tugondera.” Kyankwatako nnyo. Kyandaga ekkubo ery’okufuna essanyu erisoboka, wadde nga nnali sirirootangako. Oluvannyuma, wadde nga nnali mujeemu, ekigambo ekyo kyagenda kinkomako buli kiseera. Kyasuubiza ekiwummulo n’ekkubo ery’okukula. Kyakkakkanya era ne kimatiza okwegomba kwange. Nteekwa okugamba nti ekiwummulo kino nkizudde, si ng’ekirooto, wabula ng’ekintu ekiriwo ddala. Nkirabye mu Mukama Yesu, Mukama waffe. Tusobola okwewaayo gy’ali ne tusitula ekikoligo kye okufuna ekiwummulo ekituukiridde. Ggwe, omwoyo omwagalwa ogulonzalonza, tomanyi ssanyu ly’ofiirwa. Mukama yeeraze gy’oli. Akuyita okwewaayo kwonna. Weekwata era olonzalonza. Okwewaayo okw’ekigero oli mwetegefu okukukola, era olowooza nti mazima kisaanidde era kituufu okukukola. Naye olabika ng’olowooza nti okwewaayo okujjuvu, awatali kusigaza kintu, kungi nnyo okusabibwa. Kukutiisa. Kizingiramu bingi nnyo, bw’olowooza, era mulimu munene nnyo. Kye wandyagadde kwe kugonda mu kigero; ekirowoozo eky’okugonda mu bujjuvu kikutiisa nnyo. Olaba n’abalala. Batambulira mu kkubo eddene okusinga eryo eryakulambikibwa ggwe, ng’emitima gyabwe tegibalumiriza. Weebuuza nti, lwaki kino? Kirabika ng’ekyewuunyisa, era oboolyawo nga kizibu, nti oteekwa okukola ebyo bo bye batalina kukola. Era nti oteekwa okulekayo ebyo bo bye balina eddembe okukola. Owange! Omukristaayo omwagalwa, enjawulo eno yennyini wakati wammwe kye kirabo kyo eky’enjawulo, newaakubadde nga tonnakimanya. Mukama wo agamba nti, “Buli anjagala anaagonderanga ebiragiro byange; era kubanga anjagala, ne Kitange anaamwagalanga. Era nange nnaamwagalanga, era nnaamulabikiranga.”(Yokaana 14:21) Ggwe olina ebiragiro bye; abo b’okwatirwa obuggya tebabirina. Omanyi Mukama wo ky’alowooza ku bintu bingi, bo mwe bakyatambulira mu kizikiza. Kino si kirabo kya njawulo? Kya kunakuwalira nti omwoyo gwo guli kumpi nnyo ne Mukama wo? Ayinza okukubuulira ebintu abo abali ewala bye batamanyi. Tolaba nti kino kitegeeza omukwano ogw’okumpi ennyo era ogw’ekisa? Enkolagana nnyingi mu bulamu zeetaaga okwewaayo okw’ekigero kyokka okuva ku njuyi zombi. Tuyinza okuba n’emikwano eminene. Kyokka obulamu bwaffe obusinga tubumala mu mirimu egy’enjawulo egyawukana. Bwe tuba awamu, tuyinza okunyumirwa okubeera awamu. Tuyinza okuzuula ebintu bingi bye twagala ffembi. Naye okwawukana tekutunakuwaza. Emikwano emirala egy’okumpi tegitaataaganya. Tetulina kwagala kumala kutuwa ddembe oba kwegomba kugabana ku nsonga zaffe ezisingayo okuba ez’ekyama. Twewulira nti okwekuumako n’okubeera ebbanga kye kisaanidde. Naye waliwo enkolagana endala mu bulamu nga bino byonna bikyuka. Omukwano gufuuka okwagala. Emitima ebiri gyewaayo eri ginnaagyo, ne gitaba ebiri nate wabula kimu. Wabaawo okwegatta kw’emyoyo, okufuula byonna eby’omu okuba eby’omunne. Ebyo bye baagala eby’enjawulo n’amakubo ag’enjawulo mu bulamu tebikyasoboka. Ebintu ebyali bikkirizibwa edda kaakano tebikkirizibwa. Kiri bwe kityo olw’obunywevu bw’omukago ogubasiba. Okwekuumako n’ebbanga ebisaanira omukwano obwabwo bifuuka bya kabi mu kwagala. Okwagala kuwaayo byonna, era kuteekwa okufuna byonna mu kuddamu. Omu by’ayagala bisiba omunne. Buli mutima gwegomba okumanya ebyo omunne by’ayagala mu kyama. Gwagala okubuukira ku mpewo okubituukiriza. Abantu ng’abo bawulira nga bakooye olw’omugugu okwagala gwe kubatikka? Bakwatirwa obuggya emikwano egy’ebbugumu ettono egy’obukkakkamu gye balaba? Bejjusa okubeera okumpi n’omwagalwa waabwe olw’obuvunaanyizibwa bwe kuleeta? Tebeenyumiriza mu buvunaanyizibwa buno bwennyini? Era, n’essanyu ery’obukkakkamu n’ery’okujaguza, tebasaasira abo abaavu abali ewala abatya okusemberera okumpi bwe batyo? Buli kubikkulirwa okupya okw’ebirowoozo by’omunne si ssanyu? Era waliwo ekkubo lyonna erizibu okwagala kwabwe lye kubawaliriza okutambuliramu? Owange! Emyoyo emyagalwa, bwe muba nga kino mwali mukimanyi, ne bwe kiba kya ssaawa ntono; bwe muba nga mwali mwagalako omuntu okutuuka n’okufuna essanyu mu kwefiiriza ku lulwe; bwe muba nga mwali mwegombyeko okukwasa omulala okusalawo kwammwe ng’ekirabo ekiwoomu, kale, ku lw’okwagala kwonna okwa Mukama wammwe ow’omu ggulu, mbakubiriza okukola bwe mutyo eri Katonda! Akwagala n’okwagala okusinga okw’omukwano. Nga omugole omusajja bwasanyukira oyo gw’awasizza, bw’atyo naye bw’akusanyukira ggwe. Okwewaayo okujjuvu kwokka kwe kuyinza okumumatiza. Akuwadde byonna, era akusaba byonna mu kuddamu. Okwekuumako kwonna, ne bwe kuba kutono nnyo, kujja kumunakuwaza okutuuka ku mutima. Ye teyeesaasira yennyini, kale ggwe oyinza otya okwesaasira? Ku lulwo, yawaayo byonna bye yalina. Ku lulwe, naawe oteekwa okukola kye kimu. Owange, beera mugabi mu kwewaayo kwo! Okwewaayo kwe gy’oli okutaliiko kigero kusisinkane n’okwewaayo gy’ali okutaliiko kigero. Sanyuka era yanguwa okwesuula mu mikono gye egy’omukwano, n’okumukwasa enkoba z’obufuzi. Kyonna ky’oli, mukkirize abe nakyo kyonna. Lekulira emirembe gyonna buli kintu ekyawukana ku ye. Ndekulira eddembe lyange ery’okwerondera. Nsanyukira okwegatta kwaffe. Kufuula okwewaayo kwange si kya kusoboka kyokka, wabula kya bwetaavu. Tewegombangako kwagala muntu ali ewala? Tewali kumpi kimala okusemberera mu ngeri ey’okumpi ennyo. Towulirangako kwegomba okw’amaanyi okwewaayo gy’ali? Naye nga tolina muntu gw’oyinza kuwa kwagala okwo. Emikono gyo tegibaddemu eccupa ez’omuwendo omungi ez’amafuta ag’akaloosa? Tobangako kumpi kimala n’omutima gwonna okugafuka. Bw’owulira eddoboozi eriwoomu erya Mukama wo, akuyita mu kifo eky’okumpi ennyo naye. Kyetaagisa okwawukana n’ebirala byonna. Kijja kufuula okwewaayo kwo si kya kusoboka kyokka, wabula kya bwetaavu. Onooddirira oba onoolonzalonza? Onoolaba nga kizibu nti akubikkulira by’alowooza okusinga abalala? Tajja kukuganya kusanyukira kintu kyonna ekikwawula ku ye. Oyagala okugenda gy’atasobola kugenda naawe, oba okubeera n’emirimu gy’atasobola kugabanako? Nedda! Nedda, emirundi lukumi, nedda! Ojja kubuuka okusisinkana by’ayagala n’essanyu eringi. Ne by’ayagala ebisingayo obutono bijja kufuuka gy’oli etteeka erikusiba, lye kyandikumenya omutima okujeemera. Ojja kusanyukira obufunda bw’ekkubo ly’akuteerawo. Ojja kusaasira, n’ennaku etaliiko kkomo, abo abaavu abali ewala abaafiirwa essanyu lino. Obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okwagala bujja kuba bye birabo byakwo ebisingayo obuwoomi. Eddembe lyo ery’okuwa Mukama wo byonna by’olina lijja kuwulira ng’akuyimusa mu nsi ey’ekitiibwa ekitayogerekeka. Essanyu erituukiridde lijja kuva mu buwulize obutuukiridde. Olwo ojja kumanyako katono Yesu kye yategeeza bwe yagamba nti, “Nsanyukira okukola ky’oyagala, Ayi Katonda wange, kubanga amateeka go gali mu mutima gwange.”(Zabbuli 40:8) Era olowooza nti essanyu lino lijja kuba ku ludda lwo lwokka? Mukama talina ssanyu mu abo abeewaddeyo gy’ali bwe batyo, era abaagala okumugondera? Owange, mikwano gyange, tetusaanira kwogera ku kino. Naye Ebyawandiikibwa bitulaga ku bitundutundu by’essanyu, okumatira n’okusanyuka Mukama waffe by’alina mu ffe. Bisikiriza omwoyo n’obubonero bwabyo obw’ekitalo obw’omukisa. Nti ffe tumwetaaga, kyangu okutegeera; nti ye atwetaaga, kirabika nga tekitegeerekeka. Kya butonde okumwegomba. Naye nti ye atwegomba, kizibu okukikkiriza. Kyokka, emirundi n’emirundi, akyogera, era kiki kye tuyinza okukola okuggyako okumukkiriza? Yatonda emitima gyaffe nga gisobola okuwulira okwagala kuno okunene. Yeewaddeyo okuba kye kwolekera. Kwa muwendo nnyo gy’ali okutayogerekeka. Agamba nti, “Buli anjagala anaagonderanga ebiragiro byange; era kubanga anjagala, ne Kitange anaamwagalanga. Era nange nnaamwagalanga, era nnaamulabikiranga”(Yokaana 14:21). Akonkona ku buli mutima, ng’anoonya okuba okwagala kwagwo okusingayo. “Onkkiriza okuba owuwo?” bw’agamba omukkiriza, “Okuba omwagalwa wo, onoongoberera mu kubonaabona ne mu kubeera wekka? Onoogumiikiriza obuzibu ku lwange? Tosaba mpeera yonna okuggyako okumwenya kwange n’okutenderezebwa kwange. Onooyesuula n’okwewaayo okujjuvu mu bye njagala? Onompa obufuzi obujjuvu ku ggwe ne ku byonna by’oli? Onoomatira okunsanyusa nze nzekka? Nkole nga bwe njagala munda mu ggwe mu byonna? Onooyingira mu kwegatta nange okw’okumpi ennyo okutuuka okwetaagisa okwawukana n’ensi? Onoonzikiriza nga Mukama wo omu yekka, n’olekayo abalala bonna, okunywerera ku nze nzekka?” Mu ngeri lukumi, awa buli mukkiriza ekisuubizo kino eky’okuba omu naye. Naye si bonna abamugamba “Weewaawo,” mu kuddamu. Okwagala okulala n’ebirala bye baagala bibalabikira nga bya muwendo nnyo okubisuula. Tebafiirwa ggulu lwa kino. Naye bafiirwa essanyu eritayogerekeka. Ggwe, naye, toli omu ku bo. Okuva ku lubereberye omwoyo gwo gukaabidde n’obwagazi n’essanyu eri byonna by’akuwa nti, “Weewaawo, Mukama; weewaawo!” Oli mwetegefu nnyo okumufukako eby’obugagga byo byonna ebisingayo obulungi eby’okwagala n’okwewaayo. Obunyiikivu bwo mu kwewaayo buyinza okutaataaganya Abakristaayo abamu ab’ekigero. Okwagala kwo kwetaagisa okwawukana n’ensi, okwagala okwa wansi kwe kutayinza na kulowooza. Ssaddaaka n’obuweereza bisoboka era biwoomera ggwe. Tebiyinza kuva mu mutima ogwewaddeyo ekitono. Obulamu bw’oyingiddemu bukuwa eddembe ery’okufuka byonna by’olina n’omutima omugabi ku mwagalwa wo. Obuweereza emyoyo egiri ewala bwe gitamanyiiko kintu, kaakano bufuuka kirabo kyo ekisingayo obuwoomi. Mukama wo akwetaagako, olw’okwegatta kwo naye, ebingi nnyo okusinga by’abetaagako bo. Ekikkirizibwa gye bali, okwagala kukufuulidde ekitakkirizibwa. Ggwe asobola okukumanyisa ebyama bye, era ggwe gw’asuubira okuddamu amangu ago buli okwagala kwe kye kwetaaga. Owange, kya kitalo! Ekirabo eky’ekitiibwa ekitayogerekeka ky’oyingiddemu! Tekirina nnyo kye kigasa abantu bwe banaakukyawa. Bayinza okukwewala, okukuvuma, n’okusiiga erinnya lyo enziro ku lulwe! “Musanyukanga ku lunaku olwo ne mujaguza, kubanga empeera yammwe nnene mu ggulu, bwe tubonaabonera awamu naye, tulyoke tuweerwe wamu naye ekitiibwa.” Mu ggwe alaba ku ebyo ebiva mu kubonaabona kwe, omutima gwe ne gutereera. Okwagala kwo n’okwewaayo kwo y’empeera ye ey’omuwendo olw’ebyo byonna by’akukoledde. Kiwoomera nnyo gy’ali okutayogerekeka. Kale totya kwesuula mu kwewaayo eri Mukama wo n’omutima gwonna, okutagumiikiriza kwekuumako kwonna. Abalala bayinza obutakisiima, naye ye ajja kukisiima, era ekyo kimala. Tobalirira buwulize bwo wadde obuweereza bwo. Omutima gwo n’omukono gwo bibeere ebyeyagalire okumuweereza, ng’omutima gwe n’omukono gwe bwe byali ebyeyagalire okukuweereza ggwe. Mukkirize abe na byonna by’oli, omubiri, emmeeme n’omwoyo, ebiseera, ebitone, eddoboozi, buli kintu. Bikkula obulamu bwo bwonna mu maaso ge alyoke abufuge. Mugambenga buli lunaku nti, “Mukama, nnaategeka ntya olunaku luno ndyoke nkusanyuse? Nnaagenda wa? Nnaakola ki? Nnaakyalira ani? Nnaayogera ki?” Kwasa amagezi go mu buyinza bwe ogambe nti, “Mukama, ndaga engeri y’okulowoozaamu ndyoke nkusanyuse?” Muwe by’osoma, by’onoonya, n’emikwano gyo. Olwo ogambe nti, “Mukama, mpa okutegeera okusalira ebintu bino omusango n’amagezi go.” Waleme okubaawo olunaku wadde essaawa mw’otakolera by’ayagala n’okutegeera, ng’omugoberera mu bujjuvu. Okumuweereza kujja kuwa obulamu bwo ekitiibwa ekikwetoolodde. Kujja kumasamasa ne ku bulamu obusingayo okuba obwa bulijjo n’ekitangaala eky’omu ggulu. Wali onakuwadde nti obulungi obw’ekirooto obw’obuvubuka buggwaawo mangu mu bintu ebikakali eby’ensi? Leeta Katonda mu bulamu bwo ne mu buli kantu kaabwo. Essanyu erisingako lijja kukankanya omwoyo gwo okusinga ennaku z’obuvubuka ezisingayo okumasamasa bwe zaali ziyinza okumanya. Tewali kintu kijja kuddamu kulabika nga kizibu oba kikakali. Obulamu obusingayo obutaba na kitiibwa bujja kugulumizibwa olw’ekyo. Bwe nnali ntunuulira omukazi omwavu ng’ayoza engoye mu bbaafu, nnalowooza ku bintu by’obulamu bwe ebimalamu amaanyi. Neebuuza lwaki obulamu ng’obwo buteekwa okubaawo. Olwo, n’essanyu eryankankanya, ne nzijukira nti nabwo busobola okugulumizibwa. Ne neegamba nti, n’obulamu buno, nga bubeerwamu mu Kristo era wamu naye, nga bumugoberera yonna gy’akulembera, bwandibadde bwa kitiibwa. Buli ssaawa yaabwo yandijjudde obunyiikivu. Kinsanyusa okumanya nti emikisa gya Katonda egisingayo obunene giri n’obulamu obusingayo obwavu n’obuwombeefu. “Kubanga,” bw’agamba Mukama waffe yennyini, “buli muntu,” ka abe mugagga oba mwavu, mukadde oba muto, muddu oba wa ddembe. Kubanga buli muntu akola Katonda by’asiima ye muganda wange, ye mwannyinaze era ye mmange. Lowooza akaseera katono ku bigambo bino ebyangu naye eby’ekitalo. Muganda we, mwannyina, ne nnyina! Kiki kye tutandiwaddeyo okubeera omu ku abo! Owange, ka nkwegayirire, Omukristaayo omwagalwa. Jjangu, olegeeko olabe nga Mukama bw’ali omulungi. Emikisa gino gyonna onoogifunanga n’obeeranga nagyo, bw’onoowuliranga eddoboozi lya Mukama Katonda wo.” “Onooweebwanga omukisa bw’onoobeeranga mu kibuga ne bw’onoobeeranga mu kyalo.
